小儿心率按年龄分层。: Pediatric heart rate is stratified by age.

新生儿 SVT 心率极快、窄 QRS。: Neonatal SVT has a very fast rate and narrow QRS.

术后传导阻滞可能迟发。: Postoperative conduction block may be delayed.

钠通道阻滞剂需专科评估。: Sodium channel blockers require specialist evaluation.

同一导联 P 波形态 ≥3 种、PP 间期不等、心率不快；QRS 多窄。: P wave morphology in the same lead ≥3 types, PP intervals unequal, rate not fast; QRS mostly narrow.

导联位置错误可制造假性抬高或压低，复查时标记电极位置。: Lead misplacement can create false elevation or depression; mark electrode positions on repeat ECG.

常成对；可诱发心动过速。: Often occur in pairs; can induce tachycardia.

房速伴阻滞、室早、ST 鱼钩。: Atrial tachycardia with block, PVCs, ST fishhook.

无症状患者风险分层个体化，需电生理\/遗传咨询。: Risk stratification for asymptomatic patients is individualized; electrophysiology/genetic counseling is needed.

T 波：反映 3 相复极方向，通常与 QRS 主向量大致一致。: T wave: reflects the direction of phase 3 repolarization and is usually roughly concordant with the main QRS vector.
V5\/V6、I、aVL 出现 ST 压低与 T 波倒置，ST 段下斜；V1\/: ST depression and T-wave inversion in V5/V6, I, and aVL, with downsloping ST segments; reciprocal ST elevation may appear in V1/V2.
一度房室传导阻滞是房室传导延迟，使 PR 间期恒定超过 0.20 s，但每个心房: First-degree AV block is delayed AV conduction that makes the PR interval constantly exceed 0.20 s, but every atrial impulse still conducts to the ventricles without dropped QRS complexes. It reflects prolonged AV conduction time rather than conduction interruption and can be seen with increased vagal tone, drugs, ischemia, myocarditis, or degenerative changes of the conduction system.
下壁 II\/III\/aVF，侧壁 I\/aVL\/V5\/V6，前壁 V1–: Inferior leads II/III/aVF, lateral leads I/aVL/V5/V6, anterior leads V1–V4.
不稳定：同步电复律，房颤通常 120–200 J 起始；有意识者镇静。: Unstable: synchronized cardioversion; for atrial fibrillation, usually start at 120–200 J; sedate if conscious.
与旧图比较判断新旧；新发 LBBB 伴胸痛按急性冠脉综合征处理并动态复查。: Compare with old ECGs to determine whether new or old; new-onset LBBB with chest pain should be managed as acute coronary syndrome with serial reassessment.
交界性逸搏心律是长间歇后的替代节律，而非停搏本身。: Junctional escape rhythm is a replacement rhythm after a long pause, not the pause itself.
先看患者与多导联。: First look at the patient and multiple leads.
冲动经希氏束-浦肯野系统下传心室，故 QRS 多窄；逆传心房时可产生逆行 P 波: Impulses conduct down to the ventricles via the His-Purkinje system, so the QRS is usually narrow; when conducting retrogradely to the atria, it can produce retrograde P waves, often located after the QRS.
加速性室性自主心律是心室异位起搏点以高于其固有频率、但低于室速频率发放冲动，形成: Accelerated idioventricular rhythm is a rhythm in which an ectopic ventricular pacemaker fires at a rate higher than its intrinsic rate but lower than the ventricular tachycardia rate, producing a rhythm at approximately 50–110 beats/min with QRS ≥0.12 s. It often competes with sinus rhythm, resulting in isorhythmic AV dissociation, ventricular fusion beats, or capture beats; it is commonly seen after reperfusion of acute myocardial infarction and can also be caused by digitalis toxicity, myocarditis, and electrolyte disturbances.
单导联、P 波不清、运动时噪声；阳性提示需医疗级 ECG 确认，尤其抗凝决策前。: Single lead, unclear P waves, motion noise; a positive result indicates the need for confirmation with a medical-grade ECG, especially before anticoagulation decisions.
只看 T 波，忽略 P 波变平与 QRS 增宽。: Looking only at T waves while ignoring flattened P waves and QRS widening.
右冠状动脉闭塞占比: Proportion of right coronary artery occlusion
右胸\/后壁导联需要标记清楚，避免与标准导联混淆；放置位置偏差会显著影响 ST: Right chest/posterior wall leads need to be clearly labeled to avoid confusion with standard leads; inaccurate placement can significantly affect ST-segment interpretation.
呼吸性窦性心律不齐就是迷走张力随呼吸周期变化的表现，属于正常现象，尤其在儿童和年: Respiratory sinus arrhythmia is a manifestation of vagal tone varying with the respiratory cycle; it is a normal phenomenon, especially prominent in children and young adults.
定标、纸速与测量误差: Calibration, paper speed, and measurement error
宽 QRS 心动过速，心室率约 158 次\/分，QRS ≥0.12 s，可见房: Wide QRS tachycardia, ventricular rate approximately 158 beats/min, QRS ≥0.12 s, with visible AV dissociation, consistent with ventricular tachycardia.
心室率 <60 次\/分；PR 间期通常正常。: Ventricular rate <60 beats/min; PR interval is usually normal.
心电图报告的读者是临床医生；写他们能用来做决定的话，而不是堆术语。: The readers of ECG reports are clinicians; write what they can use to make decisions, rather than piling on jargon.
心肌肥厚与纤维化改变除极\/复极；异常 Q 波并非梗死，而是肥厚心肌除极向量改变: Myocardial hypertrophy and fibrosis alter depolarization/repolarization; abnormal Q waves are not due to infarction but reflect altered depolarization vectors of hypertrophied myocardium.
急性心肌梗死合并一度阻滞者密切监护，警惕向高度阻滞演变。: Patients with acute myocardial infarction complicated by first-degree block should be closely monitored for progression to high-grade block.
把 U 波并入 T 波，导致 QT 假性延长。: Including the U wave in the T wave causes spurious QT prolongation.
抗凝决策不能只看负荷。: Anticoagulation decisions cannot be based on burden alone.
新发 LBBB 合并典型症状按 STEMI 同等处理，并结合 Sgarbossa: New-onset LBBB with typical symptoms should be managed as STEMI and assessed using the Sgarbossa criteria.
无症状房颤仍有卒中风险。: Asymptomatic atrial fibrillation still carries a stroke risk.
最具特异性的是“原有窦性 P 波突然消失的长间歇，且间歇与基础 PP 间期不成整: The most specific finding is “a long pause with sudden disappearance of the pre-existing sinus P wave, and the pause is not an integer multiple of the underlying PP interval”; carefully exclude a non-conducted P′ hidden in the T wave.
有脉：静脉硫酸镁 2 g（可重复），纠正低钾\/低镁，停用延长 QT 药物。: With pulse: intravenous magnesium sulfate 2 g (may repeat), correct hypokalemia/hypomagnesemia, and discontinue QT-prolonging drugs.
查缺血、药物、电解质；永久起搏评估。: Assess for ischemia, medications, and electrolytes; evaluate for permanent pacing.
深度学习从大量 ECG-标签配对中学习特征；分布偏移、导联差异与伪差会影响性能。: Deep learning learns features from large numbers of ECG-label pairs; distribution shift, lead differences, and artifacts can affect performance.
电轴偏移 + 宽 QRS：先判断室性起源、预激或束支阻滞。: Axis deviation + wide QRS: first determine ventricular origin, pre-excitation, or bundle branch block.
症状性心动过缓：监护 + 阿托品（房室结病变更有效）。: Symptomatic bradycardia: monitoring + atropine (more effective for AV node disease).
相邻导联 + 新发 + 镜像改变 = STEMI 定位的基本逻辑。: Adjacent leads + new onset + reciprocal changes = basic logic for localizing STEMI.
睡眠呼吸暂停可导致夜间窦性心动过缓\/停搏、房颤、室早与低氧相关 ST 改变；心: Sleep apnea can cause nocturnal sinus bradycardia/pauses, atrial fibrillation, PVCs, and hypoxia-related ST changes; ECG abnormalities often occur with respiratory events.
磁铁通过霍尔传感器触发预设模式，绕过感知与跟踪；是急诊临时处理工具，不是治疗本身: A magnet triggers a preset mode via the Hall sensor, bypassing sensing and tracking; it is a temporary emergency management tool, not the treatment itself.
窦速最常见；S1Q3T3 不特异。: Sinus tachycardia is most common; S1Q3T3 is nonspecific.
结合临床评估结构性心脏病、缺血、电解质与药物。: Evaluate structural heart disease, ischemia, electrolytes, and medications in the clinical context.
老年 ECG 异常常见但非都良性。: ECG abnormalities are common in older adults but not all are benign.
脱漏前没有 PR 进行性延长，脱漏后 PR 与脱漏前相同。: There is no progressive PR prolongation before the dropped beat, and the PR after the dropped beat is the same as before.
观察 QRS 宽度，判断逸搏来自交界区还是心室。: Observe QRS width to determine whether the escape beat originates from the junction or ventricles.
评估晕厥、进展风险与起搏指征。: Assess syncope, risk of progression, and indications for pacing.
起搏钉后无 P\/QRS；自身逸搏可能很慢；患者可晕厥、低血压；起搏器程控显示高: No P/QRS after pacing spikes; intrinsic escape may be very slow; the patient may have syncope and hypotension; pacemaker programming shows high threshold or abnormal lead impedance.
连续记录多搏，逐搏测量 PR，寻找“渐长—脱漏—重置”的周期。: Record multiple beats continuously, measure PR beat by beat, and look for the cycle of “progressive lengthening—dropped beat—reset.”
钠通道阻滞减慢 0 相，QRS 增宽；抗胆碱\/α 阻滞导致心动过速、低血压；碳: Sodium channel blockade slows phase 0 and widens the QRS; anticholinergic/alpha blockade causes tachycardia and hypotension; sodium bicarbonate provides sodium loading and alkalinization.
阿托品无效时经皮起搏或肾上腺素 2–10 μg\/min 泵入，维持血压与灌注。: If atropine is ineffective, use transcutaneous pacing or epinephrine infusion at 2–10 μg/min to maintain blood pressure and perfusion.
静息心电图正常不能排除 CPVT；需要运动试验或基因检测。: A normal resting ECG does not exclude CPVT; exercise testing or genetic testing is required.
高电压、深窄 Q、T 倒置。: High voltage, deep narrow Q waves, T-wave inversion.
55 岁男性，少尿、乏力；心电图 T 高尖、P 波低平、QRS 110 ms，血: 55-year-old man with oliguria and fatigue; ECG shows peaked T waves, flattened P waves, QRS 110 ms, serum potassium 6.9, creatinine 480.
I 正\/aVF 正=正常；I 正\/aVF 负=可能左偏；II 负=病理性左偏: I positive/aVF positive = normal; I positive/aVF negative = possible left axis deviation; II negative = pathological left axis deviation.
R-on-T 现象、多源 PVC、成对 PVC 或非持续性室速。: R-on-T phenomenon, multifocal PVCs, paired PVCs, or nonsustained ventricular tachycardia.
ST 段压低、T 波低平或倒置，U 波振幅增高（V2–V3 最明显）。: ST-segment depression, T-wave flattening or inversion, and increased U-wave amplitude (most prominent in V2–V3).
V1 高 R、R\/S>1；电轴右偏。: Tall R in V1, R/S > 1; right axis deviation.
aVR P 波倒置是正常导联位置的重要线索。: P-wave inversion in aVR is an important clue to normal lead placement.
一度：PR>0.20 s 且每个 P 均下传；二度 I 型：PR 渐长后脱落，多: First-degree AV block: PR > 0.20 s and every P is conducted; second-degree type I: PR progressively lengthens then a beat is dropped, usually at the AV node; second-degree type II: PR is fixed with sudden dropped beats, usually below the His bundle; third-degree: complete dissociation of P and QRS, with ventricular rate determined by the escape pacemaker.
下壁与后壁、右室常由同一罪犯血管供血，定位时要同时评估三个区域；右室梗死合并后壁: The inferior, posterior, and right ventricular walls are often supplied by the same culprit vessel; all three regions should be assessed together for localization; when right ventricular infarction coexists with posterior infarction, V1 may appear atypical because the vectors cancel each other.
二度 II 型 PR 恒定、突然脱漏；文氏现象 PR 渐长后脱漏。: Mobitz type II: PR interval constant with sudden dropped beat; Wenckebach phenomenon: PR progressively lengthens then a beat is dropped.
传导顺序：窦房结 → 心房 → 房室结 → 希氏束 → 束支 → 浦肯野 → 心: Conduction sequence: SA node → atria → AV node → bundle of His → bundle branches → Purkinje → ventricular myocardium.
体表心电图给“区域”，心内电图给“点”；消融把点变成治疗。: Surface ECG provides a “region”; intracardiac electrograms provide a “point”; ablation turns the point into treatment.
先处理患者，再补记录。: Treat the patient first, then complete the documentation.
前壁心内膜下缺血也可 V1–V3 压低，但通常缺乏高 R、直立 T 与下壁抬高。: Anterior subendocardial ischemia can also cause ST depression in V1–V3, but it usually lacks tall R waves, upright T waves, and inferior ST elevation.
危重患者的电解质、药物、缺氧与血流动力学变化可快速诱发心律失常；连续监测能缩短发: In critically ill patients, electrolyte abnormalities, drugs, hypoxia, and hemodynamic changes can rapidly trigger arrhythmias; continuous monitoring shortens time to detection.
发热、使用钠通道阻滞剂后出现 1 型 Brugada 波。: Type 1 Brugada pattern appears after fever or use of sodium-channel blockers.
可穿戴设备提高无症状房颤检出率，但阳性结果需用医疗级设备确认，尤其是抗凝决策前。: Wearable devices increase detection of asymptomatic atrial fibrillation, but positive results must be confirmed with medical-grade devices, especially before anticoagulation decisions.
固定顺序：定标与导联→心率→节律→电轴→PR\/QRS\/QT→P 波→QRS: Fixed sequence: calibration and leads → heart rate → rhythm → axis → PR/QRS/QT → P waves → QRS morphology → ST-T → U waves → comparison with prior ECG/clinical context.
复极早期心外膜与心内膜电位差增大，形成 J 波；高危者存在复极异质性，易诱发室颤: In early repolarization, increased potential difference between epicardium and endocardium forms the J wave; high-risk individuals have repolarization heterogeneity, predisposing to ventricular fibrillation.
夺获波是室速中窦性冲动成功下传、产生窄 QRS 的搏动；证明房室结与希氏-浦肯野: A capture beat is a beat in ventricular tachycardia in which a sinus impulse successfully conducts downward and produces a narrow QRS; it proves that the AV node and His-Purkinje system can still conduct.
宽 QRS 心动过速伴极度电轴偏移，支持室速。: Wide QRS tachycardia with extreme axis deviation supports ventricular tachycardia.
小儿晕厥伴抽搐需与癫痫鉴别；长 QT 可表现为抽搐。: Syncope with convulsions in children must be differentiated from epilepsy; long QT can present as convulsions.
左前降支急性闭塞：V1–V4 相邻导联 ST 段抬高，下壁导联出现镜像性压低，必: Acute left anterior descending artery occlusion: ST-segment elevation in adjacent leads V1–V4 and reciprocal depression in inferior leads; immediate reperfusion is mandatory.
广泛高频噪声，与寒战同步。: Widespread high-frequency noise synchronized with shivering.
心室率 <30 次\/分、QRS 进行性增宽或节律不稳定，可随时进展为室颤或停搏: Ventricular rate <30 beats/min, progressively widening QRS, or unstable rhythm may progress to ventricular fibrillation or asystole at any time.
心房肌或肺静脉口附近的异位灶自律性增高，或触发\/折返机制提前放电。: Ectopic foci in atrial muscle or near pulmonary vein ostia show increased automaticity, or trigger/reentry mechanisms discharge prematurely.
心电轴、胸导联 R 波递增、预激 delta 波方向，本质都是向量投影问题；理解: The ECG axis, precordial R-wave progression, and direction of the pre-excitation delta wave are essentially all problems of vector projection; understanding projection is more reliable than memorizing patterns.
忽略后壁心梗：V1–V3 ST 压低伴高 R 波时应加做 V7–V9。: Ignoring posterior MI: when V1–V3 show ST depression with tall R waves, add V7–V9.
慢心室率\/灌注差需起搏。: Slow ventricular rate/poor perfusion requires pacing.
手表说“房颤”，先做 12 导联；确认之前不要开始抗凝。: Watch says “AF”; do a 12-lead first; do not start anticoagulation before confirmation.
把动作电位的 0\/2\/3 相与 QRS\/ST\/T 对应起来: Correlate phases 0/2/3 of the action potential with QRS/ST/T
新生儿血钾正常上限约 6.0–6.5 mmol\/L（因标本而异）；心电图改变: The upper limit of normal neonatal serum potassium is about 6.0–6.5 mmol/L (varies by specimen); ECG changes + hyperkalemia require emergency management.
早期复极、幼稚型 T 波、体位性 ST 改变、运动员心脏都可表现为“异常”图形；: Early repolarization, juvenile T waves, positional ST changes, and athlete’s heart can all present as “abnormal” patterns; symptoms, age, and dynamic changes must be integrated.
最具特异性的是“QT 间期缩短、ST 段缩短”；T 波通常无明显改变。QT 缩短: The most specific findings are “shortened QT interval and shortened ST segment”; T waves usually show no obvious change. The degree of QT shortening roughly correlates with elevated serum calcium, but not in a precise linear relationship.
标记未下传的 P 波，确认其后没有 QRS。: Mark the non-conducted P waves and confirm there is no QRS after them.
正常 QT 与心率匹配，不缩短。: Normal QT matches heart rate and is not shortened.
理解 ST 段抬高\/压低的方向性: Understand the directionality of ST-segment elevation/depression
病例：女性非典型胸痛: Case: atypical chest pain in a woman
窄 QRS 心动过速机制不清→食管导联；阵发性晕厥\/心悸→Holter\/事件: Narrow-complex tachycardia with unclear mechanism → esophageal lead; paroxysmal syncope/palpitations → Holter/event recorder; exercise-related → exercise test.
窦性心律不齐 = P 波正常 + RR 渐变；房早 = P′ 提前 + 间歇。: Sinus arrhythmia = normal P waves + gradual RR variation; PAC = premature P′ + pause.
结合症状日志与起搏器记录。: Correlate with the symptom log and pacemaker records.
肥胖、肺气肿、胸廓畸形会降低电压；不能仅凭单导联 ST 改变作出再灌注决策。: Obesity, emphysema, and chest wall deformity can reduce voltage; reperfusion decisions should not be made based on ST changes in a single lead alone.
胸痛患者首份心电图应在 10 分钟内完成；ST 抬高\/压低、T 波动态、后壁\: The first ECG in a patient with chest pain should be completed within 10 minutes; ST elevation/depression, dynamic T-wave changes, and posterior/right ventricular leads determine the reperfusion strategy.
设备靠近时出现噪声。: Noise occurs when equipment is nearby.
起搏器患者突然心率掉到下限以下，先想感知过度，再想导线\/电池。: In a pacemaker patient whose heart rate suddenly drops below the lower limit, first consider oversensing, then lead/battery issues.
超急性期（数分钟至数小时）：缺血心肌先出现复极异常，T 波高尖、基底宽、不对称，: Hyperacute phase (minutes to hours): ischemic myocardium first shows repolarization abnormalities, with tall, broad-based, asymmetric T waves and beginning ST-segment elevation; Q waves may not yet be present. Reperfusion benefit is greatest at this stage, but the pattern is most easily mistaken for hyperkalemia or early repolarization.
逆行 P 位于 QRS 之前时 PR 间期 <0.12 s；位于 QRS 之后时: When a retrograde P wave precedes the QRS, the PR interval is <0.12 s; when it follows the QRS, the RP interval is short, and the P wave often falls on the ST segment or the beginning of the T wave.
遇到“为什么这个导联是负的”，先画导联轴与向量方向；比记“某病某导联倒置”更可靠: When encountering "why is this lead negative," first draw the lead axis and vector direction; this is more reliable than memorizing "in a certain disease, a certain lead is inverted."
长-短周期后宽 QRS。: Wide QRS after a long-short cycle.
震颤伪差可模拟房扑\/房颤。: Tremor artifact can mimic atrial flutter/atrial fibrillation.
高质量 CPR：100–120 次\/分，深度 5–6 cm，完全回弹，中断 <: High-quality CPR: 100–120 compressions/min, depth 5–6 cm, full recoil, interruptions <10 s.
0 相钠内流、2 相钙内流、3 相钾外流。: Phase 0 sodium influx, phase 2 calcium influx, phase 3 potassium efflux.
Frank 导联用 X、Y、Z 三个正交轴重建心电向量；它不同于标准 12 导联: Frank leads use three orthogonal axes, X, Y, and Z, to reconstruct the cardiac electrical vector; they differ from the standard 12-lead ECG but remain valuable in vector analysis and research.
LQT2：声音\/情绪诱发，T 波切迹。: LQT2: triggered by sound/emotion, notched T waves.
PR 延长定位在房室结\/希氏束，QRS 增宽定位在束支\/浦肯野；把“间期”与: PR prolongation localizes to the AV node/His bundle, and QRS widening localizes to the bundle branches/Purkinje; correlate "intervals" with "anatomy."
QRS ≥0.12 s 加 I、V5、V6 宽钝或切迹 R 波、同导联无 q 波: QRS ≥0.12 s plus broad, blunt, or notched R waves in leads I, V5, and V6, with no q wave in the same leads, and R peak time >60 ms in V5/V6; when myocardial infarction is present, the most specific findings are “ST elevation ≥1 mm in leads with a positive QRS” in the Sgarbossa criteria or an ST/S ratio ≤−0.25 in the modified criteria.
QT 明显延长但未校正心率，可能漏诊或过度诊断。: Markedly prolonged QT without heart rate correction may lead to underdiagnosis or overdiagnosis.
V1 出现“兔耳”样 rsR′，I 与 V6 出现宽钝 S 波，QRS ≥0.1: A “rabbit-ear” rsR′ in V1 and broad, blunt S waves in I and V6 with QRS ≥0.12 s indicate complete right bundle branch block.
V1：P 波直立或双相，提示右房增大。: V1: an upright or biphasic P wave suggests right atrial enlargement.
WPW 的危险不在“delta 波好看”，而在“房颤时旁路能跑多快”。: The danger in WPW is not the “nice-looking delta wave” but “how fast the accessory pathway can conduct during atrial fibrillation.”
下壁 STEMI + 低血压 + 肺清 → 右室梗死；避免硝酸酯，优先补液并尽快: Inferior STEMI + hypotension + clear lungs → right ventricular infarction; avoid nitrates, prioritize fluid resuscitation, and reperfuse as soon as possible.
与缺血鉴别靠病史与动态。: Differentiation from ischemia relies on the history and dynamic changes.
伪差可模拟房颤、ST 改变甚至室颤。: Artifacts can mimic atrial fibrillation, ST changes, and even ventricular fibrillation.
低血压持续时加用正性肌力药，必要时机械循环支持。: If hypotension persists, add positive inotropes and, if necessary, mechanical circulatory support.
停搏为平线，不可除颤，处理为 CPR+肾上腺素。: Asystole appears as a flat line and is not shockable; management is CPR + epinephrine.
先看患者\/脉搏。: Look at the patient/check the pulse first.
动作电位与体表波形的时相对应: Temporal correspondence between the action potential and the surface waveform
反复搏动指冲动在房室结或旁路内折返，产生一次“回波”搏动；可见于 AVNRT、A: A reciprocal beat refers to an impulse re-entering the AV node or accessory pathway, producing one “echo” beat; it can be seen in AVNRT, AVRT, or with a pacemaker.
只看 I 导联就判断电轴，忽略 aVF 与 II。: Judging the axis from lead I alone and ignoring aVF and II.
右冠状动脉（约 80%）或回旋支闭塞，导致下壁、后壁及部分右室心肌缺血；下壁损伤: Occlusion of the right coronary artery (about 80%) or circumflex artery causes ischemia of the inferior wall, posterior wall, and part of the right ventricle; the inferior injury vector points downward, with the ST vector directed toward II, III, and aVF.
合并心肌梗死时用 Sgarbossa 标准：QRS 正向导联 ST 抬高 ≥1: In the presence of myocardial infarction, use the Sgarbossa criteria: ST elevation ≥1 mm in leads with a positive QRS, ST depression ≥1 mm in V1–V3, or ST elevation disproportionate to the S wave depth (modified criteria ST/S ≤−0.25).
在 V2–V4 观察 T 波高度、对称性与基底宽度。: Observe T wave height, symmetry, and base width in V2–V4.
婴儿 SVT 可导致心衰\/休克；迷走刺激\/腺苷为急性处理，持续者需复律与专科: Infant SVT can cause heart failure/shock; vagal stimulation/adenosine is the acute management, and persistent cases require cardioversion and specialist evaluation.
室早 QRS 形态定位起源。: PVC QRS morphology localizes the origin.
宽 QRS 逸搏 + 偶发窄 QRS 夺获。: Wide QRS escape beats + occasional narrow QRS capture beats.

左主干\/多支病变可表现为 aVR ST 抬高 + 广泛压低；不要只找单个 ST: Left main/multivessel disease can present as aVR ST elevation + widespread depression; do not look only for a single ST elevation.
弥漫 ST 抬高、PR 压低，无单一血管分布与 V4R 局灶抬高。: Diffuse ST elevation, PR depression, no single-vessel distribution and no focal V4R elevation.
心梗相关阻滞：结合梗死部位与持续时间判断。: Infarction-related block: judge based on infarct location and duration.
心肌细胞在一次动作电位后有绝对不应期、有效不应期与相对不应期；不应期决定哪些冲动: After an action potential, myocardial cells have an absolute refractory period, effective refractory period, and relative refractory period; the refractory period determines which impulses can conduct, which are blocked, or which undergo aberrant conduction.
急性期（数小时至数天）：ST 段显著抬高，Q 波逐渐形成，T 波开始倒置；镜像导: Acute phase (hours to days): marked ST-segment elevation, gradual Q-wave formation, and beginning T-wave inversion; reciprocal leads show ST depression. During this phase necrosis and injury coexist, and it is the critical window for reperfusion decisions in STEMI.
房室结是唯一正常心房到心室的电通路；房室结以上的传导被阻断可产生房室阻滞。: The AV node is the only normal electrical pathway from the atria to the ventricles; conduction block above the AV node can produce AV block.
房颤缓慢心室率需查药物过量、房室结病变、高钾\/甲减；有症状考虑起搏。: Slow ventricular rate in atrial fibrillation requires evaluation for drug overdose, AV node disease, hyperkalemia/hypothyroidism; consider pacing if symptomatic.
把窦性心动过速误认为 PSVT：窦速有 P 波且逐渐起止。: Mistaking sinus tachycardia for PSVT: sinus tachycardia has P waves and gradually starts and stops.
提前出现的 QRS 波群，形态与窦性 QRS 相同或相近（窄）。: Premature QRS complex with morphology identical or similar to sinus QRS (narrow).
新生儿心电图正弦波 + 血钾高，先静脉钙剂，同时找溶血\/肾功能\/肾上腺原因。: Neonatal ECG sine wave + high potassium: give IV calcium first while investigating causes of hemolysis/renal function/adrenal.
晕厥 + 三度阻滞 = 起搏，不是反复加阿托品。: Syncope + third-degree block = pacing, not repeated atropine.
最早激动点\/舒张期电位是靶点。: Earliest activation site/diastolic potential is the target.
核对 V2–V3 的阈值与患者年龄、性别，避免把 1–2 mm 的早期复极误判为: Check V2–V3 thresholds against patient age and sex to avoid misjudging 1–2 mm early repolarization as infarction.
正常 T 波不对称、基底较宽，不伴 P\/QRS 改变。: Normal T waves are asymmetric and broad-based, without P/QRS changes.
治疗浓度即可出现“洋地黄效应”；中毒时迷走张力增高、传导抑制与触发活动导致心律失: A “digitalis effect” can occur at therapeutic concentrations; in toxicity, increased vagal tone, conduction suppression, and triggered activity lead to arrhythmias.

看到洋地黄效应，先查钾镁与肾功能。: When a digitalis effect is seen, first check potassium, magnesium, and renal function.
短 QT 综合征：QTc <340 ms + 高尖 T。: Short QT syndrome: QTc <340 ms + tall peaked T waves.
窦性心律不齐为渐进性 RR 变化，无提前 P′。: Sinus arrhythmia shows gradual RR changes, without premature P′.
窦速 + 胸痛\/呼吸困难 + 右心负荷 = 想到肺栓塞，查 CTPA。: Sinus tachycardia + chest pain/dyspnea + right heart strain = think of pulmonary embolism, order CTPA.
纠正钾镁，停药；严重用抗体。: Correct potassium and magnesium, discontinue the drug; use antibody in severe cases.
缺血导致心内膜下损伤电流，体表表现为 ST 压低；运动量、心率与血压反应提供附加: Ischemia causes a subendocardial injury current, manifested on the body surface as ST depression; exercise workload, heart rate, and blood pressure response provide additional information.
胎儿期可发现。: Can be detected in the fetal period.
节律基本规则，也可轻度不规则，常在长间歇后出现。: The rhythm is basically regular, but may be mildly irregular, and often appears after a long pause.
观察 ST 段是否缩短、T 波是否正常。: Observe whether the ST segment is shortened and whether the T wave is normal.
输出概率，不是诊断。: Outputs a probability, not a diagnosis.
进展为高度或三度阻滞，或新发宽 QRS。: Progression to high-grade or third-degree block, or new-onset wide QRS.
需结合既往束支阻滞、预激、药物与电解质情况；宽 QRS 不能单独确诊。: Must be correlated with prior bundle branch block, pre-excitation, drugs, and electrolyte status; a wide QRS alone cannot establish the diagnosis.
频发交界性早搏伴洋地黄中毒表现（恶心、视觉异常、缓慢性心律失常）。: Frequent junctional premature beats with manifestations of digitalis toxicity (nausea, visual disturbances, bradyarrhythmias).
高钙看 QT：短 QT + 短 ST，T 波往往正常。: Hypercalcemia and QT: short QT + short ST, with the T wave often normal.
2:1 房室阻滞：每两个 P 波只有一个下传，仅凭 PR 不能分型。QRS 宽、: 2:1 AV block: only one of every two P waves conducts; PR alone cannot determine the type. Wide QRS, fixed PR, and no improvement on exercise or drug challenge favor infranodal disease; narrow QRS and prolonged PR are more likely to be at the AV node. Electrophysiology study may be needed.
AV 间期由程控设置。: AV interval is set by programming.
HCM 心电图可模拟心梗；不能仅凭 Q 波诊断陈旧性心梗。: HCM ECG can mimic MI; do not diagnose old MI based on Q waves alone.
MONA-B 的现代边界：氧疗仅用于 SpO₂ <90%；硝酸酯禁用于右室梗死、: Modern boundaries of MONA-B: oxygen only for SpO₂ <90%; nitrates are contraindicated in right ventricular infarction, hypotension, and recent PDE5 inhibitor use; morphine only for refractory pain; beta-blockers orally within 24 hours in the absence of heart failure, shock, or bradycardia.
PR 间期恒定 >0.20 s，且每个 P 波后均有 QRS，是一度房室阻滞最直: PR interval constant >0.20 s, with a QRS after every P wave, is the most direct diagnostic clue for first-degree AV block; if QRS is also widened, consider concomitant bundle branch block or more distal disease.
QTc 显著延长，T 波晚尖。: QTc markedly prolonged, T wave late-peaked.
RR 间期随呼吸渐长渐短，但每个 P 波都是窦性、PR 固定。: RR interval gradually lengthens and shortens with respiration, but every P wave is sinus and PR is fixed.
X 轴左右、Y 轴上下、Z 轴前后；通过正交导联可计算空间向量环，理解标准导联的: X axis left-right, Y axis up-down, Z axis front-back; orthogonal leads allow calculation of the spatial vector loop and understanding of the projection relationships of standard leads.
一个窦性\/起搏搏动后紧跟一个逆行 P 或窄 QRS；回波搏动常成对出现；需与早: A sinus/paced beat immediately followed by a retrograde P wave or narrow QRS; echo beats often occur in pairs; must be differentiated from premature beats.
下壁心肌梗死的 Q 波可使下壁呈 QS 型，掩盖 rS 图形，需结合 ST-T: Q waves of inferior myocardial infarction can produce a QS pattern in the inferior leads, masking the rS pattern; correlate with dynamic ST-T changes and history.
与右室起搏心律、预激、高钾血症导致的宽 QRS 鉴别。: Differentiate from wide QRS due to right ventricular pacing rhythm, pre-excitation, and hyperkalemia.
伴胸痛、晕厥、低血压、呼吸困难、意识改变。: With chest pain, syncope, hypotension, dyspnea, altered consciousness.
低钾：T 波低平、ST 压低、U 波明显、QT(U) 延长。: Hypokalemia: T-wave flattening, ST depression, prominent U waves, QT(U) prolongation.
先看定标：纸速 25 mm\/s、增益 10 mm\/mV 时，一小格 0.04: First check the calibration: at paper speed 25 mm/s and gain 10 mm/mV, one small box is 0.04 s and one large box is 0.20 s.
刺激迷走神经或 Adenosine 可暂时增加房室阻滞，使 F 波更清晰。: Vagal stimulation or Adenosine can temporarily increase AV block, making F waves clearer.
单个 PVC 是二联律的组成单位；二联律强调 1:1 交替模式。: A single PVC is the constituent unit of bigeminy; bigeminy emphasizes a 1:1 alternating pattern.
只看 ST 抬高而忽略 PR 段，漏掉心包炎的关键线索。: Looking only at ST elevation and ignoring the PR segment misses the key clue to pericarditis.
右心负荷→RBBB、右胸 T 倒置、电轴右偏。: Right heart strain → RBBB, right precordial T inversion, right axis deviation.

大面积肺栓塞可导致低血压、休克甚至心脏骤停。: Massive pulmonary embolism can cause hypotension, shock, and even cardiac arrest.
定位总则：面对梗死、镜像确认: General localization principle: when facing infarction, confirm with reciprocal changes
宽 QRS 心动过速鉴别中，Brugada 四步法报告敏感性约 98.7%、特异: In the differential diagnosis of wide QRS tachycardia, the Brugada four-step method reports sensitivity of about 98.7% and specificity of about 96.5%; among these, “absence of RS pattern in all precordial leads” has specificity 100% and sensitivity about 21%, and AV dissociation, RS interval >100 ms, and specific morphology combinations can improve accuracy.
导联脱落可表现为平线或高幅噪声；患者活动、CPR、电刀、肌肉震颤都会产生伪差。: Lead detachment can present as a flat line or high-amplitude noise; patient movement, CPR, electrocautery, and muscle tremor all produce artifact.
川崎病心电图正常不能排除冠脉瘤；需超声与随访。: A normal ECG in Kawasaki disease cannot exclude coronary aneurysm; echocardiography and follow-up are needed.
弥漫凹面 ST 抬高加 PR 段压低，除 aVR\/V1 外没有镜像改变；治疗靠: Diffuse concave ST elevation plus PR segment depression, with no reciprocal changes except in aVR/V1; treatment is NSAID plus colchicine, and anticoagulation should be avoided.
心室节律基本规则，但逸搏频率可漂移。: The ventricular rhythm is basically regular, but the escape rate can drift.
心电图敏感度有限，需超声确认。: ECG has limited sensitivity and requires echocardiography for confirmation.
忽略高钾或药物中毒：宽 QRS 缓慢节律可能是可逆的代谢或中毒原因。: Ignoring hyperkalemia or drug toxicity: a wide QRS slow rhythm may be a reversible metabolic or toxic cause.
急性缺血、心肌瘢痕、电解质紊乱、触电、溺水、药物毒性等诱发心室多发微折返。: Acute ischemia, myocardial scar, electrolyte disturbance, electric shock, drowning, drug toxicity, etc. induce multiple ventricular microreentry.
房室结、希氏束与束支: AV node, His bundle, and bundle branches
房扑伴缓慢规则心室率需排除药物\/阻滞。: Atrial flutter with a slow regular ventricular rate requires ruling out drugs/block.
房颤三要素：无 P、RR 绝对不规则、f 波。: Three key features of atrial fibrillation: absent P waves, absolutely irregular RR intervals, and f waves.

文氏现象 = PR 渐长 → 脱漏 → 重置，像“越走越慢，最后停一拍”。: Wenckebach phenomenon = progressive PR lengthening → dropped beat → reset, like “slowing down more and more, then pausing for one beat.”
无症状的短暂交界性逸搏可见于睡眠、迷走张力高或药物作用；持续缓慢的室性逸搏、宽: Asymptomatic transient junctional escape beats can be seen during sleep, with high vagal tone, or due to drugs; persistent slow ventricular escape with wide QRS and low rate often indicates severe conduction system disease.
晕厥先查心电图红线。: For syncope, first check the ECG red flags.
有 P 波，与房颤不同。: P waves are present, unlike atrial fibrillation.
未询问家族史与药物史，漏诊先天性 LQTS。: Failure to ask about family history and medication history led to missed diagnosis of congenital LQTS.
正常 ECG 不排除 ACS。: A normal ECG does not exclude ACS.
治疗基础病：急性冠脉综合征按再灌注策略处理，肺栓塞抗凝，右心负荷病因相应处理。: Treat the underlying disease: manage acute coronary syndrome according to reperfusion strategy, anticoagulate pulmonary embolism, and treat the cause of right heart strain accordingly.
电轴偏转：I、aVF、II 快速判断: Axis deviation: rapid assessment using I, aVF, and II

碳酸氢钠是治疗关键。: Sodium bicarbonate is key to treatment.

胸外按压会产生节律性高幅伪差，可模拟室速\/室颤；电击后短暂平直也常是设备\/肌: Chest compressions produce rhythmic high-amplitude artifact that can mimic VT/VF; a brief flat line after a shock is often also a device/muscle response and does not necessarily indicate asystole.
补液、盐、运动、药物个体化。: Individualize fluid replacement, salt, exercise, and medication.
解释房室结延迟的生理意义: Explain the physiological significance of AV nodal delay
起搏决策：谁需要、谁可以等: Pacing decisions: who needs it and who can wait
适用于 LBBB + 低 EF 心衰。: Indicated for LBBB + heart failure with low EF.

钝性胸部创伤可损伤心肌\/冠脉\/心包；气胸\/血胸改变胸腔阻抗与心脏位置。: Blunt chest trauma can injure the myocardium/coronary arteries/pericardium; pneumothorax/hemothorax alters thoracic impedance and cardiac position.
阳性可复制症状与血压\/心率下降。: A positive test reproduces symptoms and a drop in blood pressure/heart rate.
预激合并房颤\/房扑，宽 QRS、极快心室率，有室颤风险。: Pre-excitation with atrial fibrillation/flutter, wide QRS, extremely fast ventricular rate, and risk of ventricular fibrillation.
食管导联靠近左房，可清晰记录 P 波，用于窄 QRS 心动过速鉴别、房室分离判断: An esophageal lead lies close to the left atrium and can clearly record P waves; it is used to differentiate narrow-QRS tachycardias, assess AV dissociation, and localize atrial flutter/atrial tachycardia.
逆行 P 波常隐藏在 QRS 终末部，易被忽略为“无 P 的房早”。: Retrograde P waves are often hidden in the terminal portion of the QRS and are easily overlooked as “atrial premature beats without a P wave.”

《不应期与传导》的最具特异性的线索：不应期随心率、药物和电解质变化；房颤时快速房: Most specific clue for “Refractoriness and Conduction”: Refractoriness varies with heart rate, drugs, and electrolytes; during atrial fibrillation, rapid atrial impulses often fall within the AV nodal refractory period, producing a “filtering” effect.
《交界性期前收缩》的最具特异性的线索：最具特异性的是“提前的窄 QRS 前无窦性: Most specific clue for “Junctional Premature Contraction”: The most specific finding is “a premature narrow QRS with no preceding sinus P wave and a retrograde P wave visible after the QRS (inverted in II, III, and aVF)”; if the retrograde P wave is buried in the QRS, it presents as a premature narrow QRS with no preceding P wave.
《低钾血症》的定义：低钾血症使心肌细胞复极延迟、兴奋性增高，心电图上表现为 ST: Definition of “Hypokalemia”: Hypokalemia delays myocardial repolarization and increases excitability; on ECG it manifests as ST-segment depression, flattened or inverted T waves, prominent U waves, and prolonged QT/U interval, and can provoke atrial/ventricular arrhythmias.
《加速性室性自主心律》关键数值：50–110次\/分（心室率）: Key value for “Accelerated Idioventricular Rhythm”: 50–110 beats/min (ventricular rate)

《心房颤动》危险信号：血流动力学不稳定、胸痛、心衰加重、意识改变。: “Atrial Fibrillation” Red flags: hemodynamic instability, chest pain, worsening heart failure, altered consciousness.
《心电图研究方法入门》学习目标：研究需明确终点与验证。: “Introduction to ECG Research Methods” Learning objective: research requires clear endpoints and validation.

Impulses propagate along the atrial myocardium and internodal tracts to the atrioventricular node, simultaneously activating the right and left atria to form the surface P wave.
《急性心包炎》属于“缺血、梗死与 ST-T”板块。: “Acute Pericarditis” belongs to the “Ischemia, Infarction, and ST-T” section.

《洋地黄效应》的一句话描述：勺状 ST 段压低、QT 缩短、T 波低平\/倒置；: “Digitalis Effect” One-sentence description: scooped ST-segment depression, shortened QT, flat/inverted T waves; effect does not equal toxicity.

《融合波》的一句话描述：融合波是室上性冲动与室性异位\/起搏冲动同时激动心室，Q: “Fusion Beat” One-sentence description: a fusion beat occurs when a supraventricular impulse and a ventricular ectopic/pacing impulse simultaneously activate the ventricles, producing a QRS morphology intermediate between the two; it supports VT or pacing.

分层定位：先看 PR，再看 QRS: Stratified localization: first look at PR, then QRS

血流动力学不稳定、胸痛、心衰加重、意识改变。: Hemodynamic instability, chest pain, worsening heart failure, altered consciousness.
解释 Ashman 现象与差异性传导: Explain Ashman phenomenon and aberrant conduction

食管导联靠近左房，P 波清晰。: The esophageal lead is close to the left atrium, and P waves are clear.

可穿戴适合筛查，不替代诊断。: Wearables are suitable for screening, not as a substitute for diagnosis.
右束支阻滞：QRS ≥120 ms，V1 呈 rsR′（兔耳征），V6 与 I: Right bundle branch block: QRS ≥120 ms, rsR′ in V1 (rabbit-ear sign), wide slurred S waves in V6 and lead I, and T waves often opposite to the terminal vector. 后壁梗死常与下壁或侧壁梗死合并，提示回旋支或右冠闭塞；不要因 V1–V3 压低而: Posterior infarction often coexists with inferior or lateral infarction, suggesting circumflex or right coronary artery occlusion; do not misinterpret V1–V3 depression as anterior ischemia.

常伴房颤、左室肥厚或二尖瓣病变。: Often accompanied by atrial fibrillation, left ventricular hypertrophy, or mitral valve disease.

房颤时 DDD 转 VVI\/DDIR。: In atrial fibrillation, switch DDD to VVI/DDIR.
把右室肥厚伴劳损的高 R 与 ST 压低误认为后壁梗死。: Mistaking the tall R waves and ST depression of right ventricular hypertrophy with strain for posterior infarction.
持续胸痛伴动态 ST 压低 ≥2 mm，或广泛压低加 aVR 抬高。: Persistent chest pain with dynamic ST depression ≥2 mm, or widespread depression with aVR elevation.
新生儿心电图以右室优势、电轴右偏、V1 高 R、心率快为特征；出生后数周至数月逐: Neonatal ECG is characterized by right ventricular dominance, right axis deviation, high R in V1, and a fast heart rate; it gradually transitions over weeks to months after birth.
最具特异性的是“QTc 延长 + T 波形态异常（双相、切迹、倒置）”；QTc: The most specific finding is "QTc prolongation + abnormal T-wave morphology (biphasic, notched, inverted)"; when QTc >500 ms or increases >60 ms from baseline, the risk of torsades de pointes is significantly increased.

用 I\/aVF 快速确定电轴象限: Use I/aVF to quickly determine the axis quadrant

结合血压、瓣膜病、肥厚型心肌病家族史与超声。: Correlate with blood pressure, valvular disease, family history of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, and echocardiography.
胸导联错位可造成 R 波递增异常或“假性前壁心梗”；读图时先确认 aVR P 波: Chest lead misplacement can cause abnormal R-wave progression or "pseudo-anterior myocardial infarction"; when interpreting the ECG, first confirm inverted P waves in aVR and upright P waves in I/II.
若为 Brugada 表型，避免诱发药物与发热，转诊电生理评估。: If there is a Brugada phenotype, avoid provoking drugs and fever, and refer for electrophysiology evaluation.
观察 QRS 宽度与形态，宽 QRS 提示更远端病变或合并束支阻滞。: Observe QRS width and morphology; a wide QRS suggests a more distal lesion or concomitant bundle branch block.

过敏性休克优先肾上腺素、补液、气道；心电图 ST-T 改变可来自低血压\/缺氧\: Anaphylactic shock prioritizes epinephrine, fluids, and airway; ECG ST-T changes may result from hypotension/hypoxia/catecholamines and require repeat ECG.
进展为高度或三度阻滞，或脱漏比例增加（如 3:1、2:1）。: Progression to high-grade or third-degree block, or an increased dropout ratio (e.g., 3:1, 2:1).

随年龄逐渐转为成人型。: Gradually converts to adult type with age.
频率约 150–250 次\/分，可短阵或持续。: Rate about 150–250 beats/min, may be short-lived or sustained.
高负荷 PVC、非持续性室速或伴左室功能下降：心内科评估，必要时导管消融。: High-burden PVCs, non-sustained VT, or with decreased left ventricular function: cardiology evaluation, catheter ablation if necessary.
2:1 阻滞不能仅凭 PR 分型，需结合 QRS 与临床。: 2:1 block cannot be classified by PR alone; QRS and clinical context must be considered.

P 波在 aVR 应倒置；若 aVR P 波直立，要考虑导联接错或异位房性心律。: P wave should be inverted in aVR; if the P wave is upright in aVR, consider lead reversal or an ectopic atrial rhythm.
QTc >480 ms 高疑；LQT1\/2\/3 诱因不同；晕厥、家族猝死、耳: QTc >480 ms is highly suspicious; LQT1/2/3 have different triggers; syncope, family history of sudden death, and deafness (Jervell-Lange-Nielsen) are suggestive.
RVH 与后壁 MI 都可出现 V1 高 R，但 RVH 常伴电轴右偏、右房增大: Both RVH and posterior MI can show a tall R in V1, but RVH often has right axis deviation, right atrial enlargement, and right precordial strain; posterior MI often has ST depression in V1–V3 with upright T waves.
“没有症状”不是停抗凝的理由；房颤的卒中风险是长期的。: “No symptoms” is not a reason to stop anticoagulation; stroke risk in atrial fibrillation is long-term.
下壁 STEMI 有 II\/III\/aVF 抬高加 aVL 压低，心包炎 a: Inferior STEMI has elevation in II/III/aVF plus depression in aVL; in pericarditis aVL is also elevated.
不能确定时按室速处理，避免使用维拉帕米等房室结阻滞剂。: When uncertain, manage as VT and avoid AV nodal blockers such as verapamil.
事件记录器用于少见阵发性事件。: Event recorders are used for infrequent paroxysmal events.
交界区也不出手时，心室以 20–40 次\/分被动起搏：宽 QRS、无 P、T: When the junctional area also fails to fire, the ventricles pace passively at 20–40 beats/min: wide QRS, absent P waves, and inverted T waves—a sign of a critically endangered conduction system.
伴尖端扭转型室速：静脉硫酸镁，纠正电解质，必要时起搏\/除颤。: With torsades de pointes: intravenous magnesium sulfate, correct electrolytes, and pace/defibrillate if necessary.
低钾\/肾功能不全增加中毒风险。: Hypokalemia/renal insufficiency increases the risk of toxicity.
先找药物、电解质、缺血、感染、迷走等可逆因素。: First look for reversible factors such as drugs, electrolytes, ischemia, infection, and vagal causes.
全身血管炎损伤冠脉，形成动脉瘤\/血栓；心肌炎也可导致 ST-T 改变。: Systemic vasculitis damages the coronary arteries, causing aneurysms/thrombi; myocarditis can also cause ST-T changes.
加做右胸\/后壁导联可帮助定位。: Adding right chest/posterior leads can help with localization.
危急值不是“心电图很吓人”，而是“如果不马上处理，患者可能出事”。: A critical value is not “the ECG looks scary,” but “if not treated immediately, the patient may deteriorate.”
变异\/减速模式比单次数字重要。: Variability/deceleration patterns are more important than a single value.
右室肥厚常伴 V1 高 R、电轴右偏和右胸导联劳损；左后分支阻滞呈 I、aVL: Right ventricular hypertrophy often presents with tall R in V1, right axis deviation, and right precordial strain; left posterior fascicular block shows rS in I and aVL, and qR in II, III, and aVF.
哮喘者腺苷可诱发支气管痉挛。: In patients with asthma, adenosine can induce bronchospasm.
在相邻两个及以上导联出现 ST 抬高，V2–V3 按年龄与性别采用不同阈值（男: ST elevation in two or more contiguous leads, with different thresholds for V2–V3 by age and sex (men ≥40 years ≥2 mm, men <40 years ≥2.5 mm, women ≥1.5 mm), and ≥1 mm in other leads; if concomitant reciprocal ST depression in the inferior leads is present, diagnostic specificity is further increased.
多源性房速：同样多变但心率快。: Multifocal atrial tachycardia: also variable but with a fast rate.
室颤无任何可辨 QRS，TdP 仍可辨宽 QRS 的扭转。: Ventricular fibrillation has no discernible QRS; TdP still has discernible wide QRS twisting.
宽 QRS 节律，QRS ≥0.12 s（图例 0.16 s），心室率 20–4: Wide QRS rhythm, QRS ≥0.12 s (example 0.16 s), ventricular rate 20–40 beats/min.
希氏束以下：QRS 宽、二度 II 型、三度宽逸搏、晕厥、风险高。: Below the His bundle: wide QRS, second-degree type II, third-degree wide escape rhythm, syncope, high risk.
广泛压低加 aVR 抬高，是左主干或三支病变的危险暗号。: Widespread depression plus aVR elevation is a dangerous signal of left main or three-vessel disease.
心室率可快速（>100）、正常或缓慢（<60）；慢而规则需警惕三度阻滞。: The ventricular rate can be fast (>100), normal, or slow (<60); a slow and regular rate should raise suspicion of third-degree block.
心悸先分窄\/宽、规则\/不规则。: For palpitations, first classify as narrow/wide and regular/irregular.
心电图学的未来不是“机器取代人”，而是“人用机器看得更远”；基础越牢，工具越有用: The future of electrocardiology is not “machines replacing people,” but “people using machines to see farther”; the stronger the foundation, the more useful the tools.
心脏记忆可模拟缺血性 T 波倒置；结合近期起搏\/心律失常史与动态变化。: Cardiac memory can mimic ischemic T-wave inversion; correlate with recent pacing/arrhythmia history and serial changes.
患者状态与波形不一致。: The patient's condition is inconsistent with the waveform.
房室结慢传导造成 PR 段，并过滤过快房性冲动。: Slow conduction through the AV node creates the PR segment and filters out excessively rapid atrial impulses.
房速 2:1 传导时心室率约 140–150 次\/分，易误诊为窦性心动过速。: With 2:1 conduction of atrial tachycardia, the ventricular rate is about 140–150 beats/min, making it easily misdiagnosed as sinus tachycardia.
房颤无 P 波，RR 绝对不规则。: Atrial fibrillation has no P waves, and the RR intervals are absolutely irregular.
把 ST 延长误认为缺血性 ST 改变；低钙的 T 波通常正常。: Mistaking ST prolongation for ischemic ST changes; the T wave in hypocalcemia is usually normal.
新生儿心电图异常需结合血氧、灌注、血糖、电解质与先心病筛查；不能单凭图形诊断。: Abnormal neonatal ECG findings must be interpreted together with oxygen saturation, perfusion, glucose, electrolytes, and congenital heart disease screening; do not diagnose based on the tracing alone.
最具特异性的是“短 PR + delta 波（QRS 起始部粗钝）+ QRS 增: The most specific findings are “short PR + delta wave (slurred initial portion of the QRS) + widened QRS + secondary ST-T changes”; intermittent pre-excitation suggests a longer accessory pathway refractory period and a relatively lower risk.
正常变异应稳定、无动态演变、无病理性 Q。: Normal variants should be stable, show no dynamic evolution, and have no pathologic Q waves.
洋地黄效应：ST 段鱼钩样下垂、T 波低平\/倒置、QT 缩短；中毒：恶心、视觉: Digitalis effect: fishhook-like ST depression, flattened/inverted T waves, and shortened QT; toxicity: nausea, visual disturbances, and arrhythmias (atrial tachycardia with block, premature ventricular contractions).
用阿托品后 PR 缩短就认为治愈，忽略病因和进展风险。: Assuming cure just because the PR interval shortens after atropine, while ignoring the cause and risk of progression.
电轴本身不是治疗对象；处理其背后的传导、肥厚或缺血原因。: The axis itself is not the treatment target; address the underlying conduction, hypertrophy, or ischemic cause.
监护仪报警不等于患者心律失常；先看人，再看图。: A monitor alarm does not equal an arrhythmia in the patient; look at the patient first, then the tracing.
确认节律是否绝对规则、QRS 是否窄。: Confirm whether the rhythm is absolutely regular and whether the QRS is narrow.
窦性 P 波，PR 恒定（通常正常或轻度延长），周期性出现 P 后无 QRS。: Sinus P waves, constant PR (usually normal or slightly prolonged), and periodic P waves not followed by a QRS.
窦房结停摆时交界区接班：窄 QRS、40–60 次\/分，P 波缺失或逆行，关键: When the SA node pauses, the junctional pacemaker takes over: narrow QRS, 40–60 beats/min, absent or retrograde P waves; the key is to find “why it is slow.”
糖皮质激素仅用于 NSAID 与秋水仙碱禁忌或无效者，因复发率较高，不作为常规。: Glucocorticoids are only used when NSAIDs and colchicine are contraindicated or ineffective; because of the higher recurrence rate, they are not routine.
结合血气、超声与临床。: Correlate with blood gas, ultrasound, and clinical findings.
自主神经发育与代谢率影响心率；新生儿交感张力高、迷走张力低，心率快。: Autonomic nervous system development and metabolic rate affect heart rate; neonates have high sympathetic tone and low vagal tone, so heart rate is fast.
血清地高辛浓度与心电图改变不一定平行，需结合临床。: Serum digoxin concentration and ECG changes are not necessarily parallel; interpret in clinical context.
解释 V7–V9 的后壁定位: Explain the posterior wall localization of V7–V9
起搏器心电图异常时，不要只调参数；先问“导线、心肌、电池、干扰”四件事。: When the pacemaker ECG is abnormal, do not just adjust parameters; first ask about the four things: “lead, myocardium, battery, interference.”
运动晕厥是红线。: Exertional syncope is a red flag.
遇到突然的长间歇，先把前后每一个 P 波标出来：如果某个 P 波提前且形态不同、: When encountering a sudden long pause, first mark every P wave before and after: if a P wave is premature with a different morphology and is not followed by a QRS, it is a nonconducted premature atrial contraction; only if P waves appear on time but simply fail to conduct should AV block be considered.
阿托品无效时经皮起搏或肾上腺素 2–10 μg\/min 维持灌注。: If atropine is ineffective, use transcutaneous pacing or epinephrine 2–10 μg/min to maintain perfusion.
需排除未下传的房性早搏：后者可在前一个 T 波中看到提前的 P′。: Rule out nonconducted premature atrial contractions: the latter may show a premature P′ in the preceding T wave.
预激旁路绕开房室结，PR 缩短并出现 delta 波。: A pre-excitation accessory pathway bypasses the AV node, shortening the PR interval and producing a delta wave.
高危：晕厥、家族猝死、下壁高 J 波。: High risk: syncope, family history of sudden death, inferior high J waves.
0 相 ≈ QRS，2 相 ≈ ST 段，3 相 ≈ T 波；QT 覆盖 0 相: Phase 0 ≈ QRS, phase 2 ≈ ST segment, phase 3 ≈ T wave; QT covers phase 0 through the end of phase 3.
AIVR 本身不需阿托品；若合并症状性窦性心动过缓，阿托品 1 mg 静脉推注，: AIVR itself does not require atropine; if complicated by symptomatic sinus bradycardia, give atropine 1 mg IV push, repeat every 3–5 minutes up to a maximum of 3 mg; if ineffective, use transcutaneous pacing or epinephrine 2–10 μg/min.
DDD 起搏心电图可见 A 钉—P—V 钉—QRS；AV 间期由程控设置，需结合: DDD pacing ECG shows A spike—P—V spike—QRS; the AV interval is set by programming and should be optimized with ultrasound and clinical findings.
LQT2 由 KCNH2 突变导致 IKr 减少，T 波低平\/切迹，事件常由情: LQT2 is caused by KCNH2 mutations leading to reduced IKr, with flattened/notched T waves; events are often triggered by emotional stress or sudden sounds (alarm clock/telephone).
Mobitz II = PR 不变、QRS 突然“掉队”；病变在结下，起搏优先级: Mobitz II = PR interval unchanged, QRS suddenly 'drops out'; the lesion is infranodal, and pacing is a high priority.
P 与 QRS 各走各的：心房率高于心室率，PR 无固定关系；伴晕厥就是起搏指征: P waves and QRS complexes are independent: atrial rate is higher than ventricular rate, with no fixed PR relationship; syncope is an indication for pacing.
P 波缺失，或窦性 P 波按自身频率出现但与 QRS 无关（房室分离）。: Absent P waves, or sinus P waves occurring at their own rate but unrelated to QRS complexes (AV dissociation).
QT 间期延长是心室复极时间延长，按心率校正后 QTc 超过正常范围；可导致早期: Prolonged QT interval is prolonged ventricular repolarization; after heart-rate correction, QTc exceeds the normal range; it can cause early afterdepolarizations and torsades de pointes, and is an important risk marker for sudden death.
ST 抬高伴 aVR 抬高与广泛 ST 压低，提示左主干或三支血管病变。: ST elevation with aVR elevation and widespread ST depression suggests left main or three-vessel disease.
一度房室阻滞：PR 间期大于 0.20 s，但每个 P 波都能下传产生 QRS。: First-degree AV block: PR interval greater than 0.20 s, but every P wave is conducted to produce a QRS. It usually does not cause symptoms by itself and is more often a clue to degenerative conduction system disease, drugs (β-blockers, non-dihydropyridine calcium channel blockers, digoxin, amiodarone), or electrolyte abnormalities.
下壁 STEMI 看三件事：III 与 II 比较判断血管、aVL 找镜像、V4: For inferior STEMI, look at three things: compare III with II to determine the vessel, aVL for reciprocal changes, and V4R for right ventricular involvement.
不要仅凭监护仪 ST 报警诊断 STEMI；标准 12 导联与临床是关键。: Do not diagnose STEMI based solely on monitor ST alarms; the standard 12-lead ECG and clinical picture are key.
低钙血症延长心肌动作电位平台期，心电图上表现为 ST 段延长、QT 间期延长，T: Hypocalcemia prolongs the plateau phase of the myocardial action potential; on ECG it manifests as ST segment prolongation and QT interval prolongation, with T wave morphology usually normal; severe cases can cause arrhythmias.
儿童感冒后胸痛\/乏力\/心率快，别只当“恢复期”；查心电图和心肌标志物。: After a cold in a child, chest pain/fatigue/rapid heart rate should not be dismissed as just the 'recovery phase'; check ECG and cardiac markers.
先看患者再看监护。: Look at the patient first, then the monitor.
出现高度房室阻滞或晕厥者评估起搏治疗。: Evaluate pacing therapy in patients with high-grade AV block or syncope.
双分支阻滞无症状者随访；伴晕厥或 HV 间期延长者考虑起搏器。: Asymptomatic bifascicular block: follow up; consider pacemaker if accompanied by syncope or prolonged HV interval.
只能从后续变化推断。: Can only be inferred from subsequent changes.
右室心尖起搏使心室从右室向左侧除极，QRS 宽、呈 LBBB 形态；起搏钉是人工: Right ventricular apical pacing depolarizes the ventricles from the right ventricle toward the left, producing a wide QRS with LBBB morphology; the pacing spike is the hallmark of artificial electrical stimulation.
合并后壁梗死时只看 V1，忽略 V7–V9 与右胸导联。: When there is concomitant posterior infarction, looking only at V1 and ignoring V7–V9 and right precordial leads.
在 II、V1 寻找 QRS 终末的逆行 P、假 s 波或假 r′ 波。: Look for retrograde P waves, pseudo-s waves, or pseudo-r′ waves at the end of the QRS in leads II and V1.
多导联贴片能抓到更多房颤，但如果没有团队审核，报警只是噪音。: Multi-lead patches can capture more atrial fibrillation, but without team review, alarms are just noise.
室性逸搏心律是窦房结与房室交界区均不能及时发放或下传冲动时，心室起搏点被动发放冲: Ventricular escape rhythm occurs when neither the sinoatrial node nor the atrioventricular junction can discharge or conduct impulses in a timely manner; the ventricular pacing focus then passively discharges impulses, forming a wide-QRS rhythm at about 20–40 beats/min. The impulse conducts slowly between ventricular myocardial cells, with QRS ≥0.12 s and ST-T direction opposite to the main QRS vector; it often indicates severe conduction system disease, metabolic disturbance, or a terminal state.
宽 QRS 节律，QRS ≥0.12 s，心室率 50–110 次\/分（图例约: Wide QRS rhythm, QRS ≥0.12 s, ventricular rate 50–110 beats/min (illustrated example about 84 beats/min).
尽快再灌注：直接 PCI 首选，不能及时 PCI 时评估溶栓。: Reperfusion as soon as possible: primary PCI is preferred; if timely PCI is not available, evaluate for thrombolysis.
常见原因：利尿剂、呕吐\/腹泻、胰岛素、β2 激动剂、醛固酮增多、低镁。: Common causes: diuretics, vomiting/diarrhea, insulin, β2 agonists, hyperaldosteronism, hypomagnesemia.
心室率过快导致低血压、胸痛、呼吸困难或意识改变。: Ventricular rate too fast causing hypotension, chest pain, dyspnea, or altered consciousness.
心电图提示电解质异常时，不要只查一种离子；纠正要缓慢并监测。: When the ECG suggests an electrolyte abnormality, do not test only one ion; correction should be slow and monitored.
心脏记忆：激动顺序改变后的 T 波倒置。: Cardiac memory: T-wave inversion after a change in activation sequence.
急性肾衰竭、横纹肌溶解、肿瘤溶解综合征背景下的快速升钾。: Rapid rise in potassium in the setting of acute renal failure, rhabdomyolysis, or tumor lysis syndrome.
房室结传导纤维相对不应期延长，每次下传后恢复不完全，下一次冲动传导更慢，PR 逐: The relative refractory period of AV nodal conduction fibers is prolonged; recovery after each conducted impulse is incomplete, the next impulse conducts more slowly, and the PR interval progressively lengthens.
把 U 波误认为 T 波，导致 QT 测量错误。: Mistaking the U wave for the T wave, leading to incorrect QT measurement.
最具特异性的是“多形性宽 QRS + 振幅围绕基线扭转 + 发作前 QT\/QT: The most specific feature is “polymorphic wide QRS + amplitude twisting around the baseline + QT/QTc prolongation before onset (often >500 ms)”; it must be differentiated from polymorphic VT (without long QT).
未上移 V1\/V2 导联而漏诊。: Missed diagnosis because V1/V2 leads were not moved upward.
每个 P 波后均有 QRS 波群，每个 QRS 前均有 P 波。: Each P wave is followed by a QRS complex, and each QRS is preceded by a P wave.
环境电磁场被导联线拾取，叠加到心电信号；高阻抗电极更易受影响。: Environmental electromagnetic fields are picked up by the lead wires and superimposed on the ECG signal; high-impedance electrodes are more susceptible.
电轴多正常；若电轴右偏，需考虑合并右室肥厚、肺栓塞或左后分支阻滞。: Axis is usually normal; if right axis deviation is present, consider concurrent right ventricular hypertrophy, pulmonary embolism, or left posterior fascicular block.
病例：房颤伴缓慢心室率: Case: atrial fibrillation with slow ventricular rate
症状性心动过缓：阿托品 1 mg 静脉推注，每 3–5 分钟重复，最大 3 mg: Symptomatic bradycardia: atropine 1 mg IV push, repeat every 3–5 minutes, maximum 3 mg; often effective for AV nodal block.
相邻导联 ST 抬高→再灌注。: ST elevation in adjacent leads → reperfusion.
短 PR、δ 波，宽 QRS 由预激造成，而非左束支阻滞。: Short PR, δ wave; wide QRS is caused by pre-excitation, not left bundle branch block.
窦性心律，II、III、aVF ST 抬高，aVL 镜像压低，V1 轻度抬高；结: Sinus rhythm, ST elevation in II, III, aVF, reciprocal depression in aVL, mild elevation in V1; with hypotension and clear lungs, additional V4R shows ST elevation, supporting right ventricular infarction.
窦速有正常 P 波与等电位线，频率随病因变化。: Sinus tachycardia has normal P waves and an isoelectric baseline; rate varies with the cause.
结合利尿剂、呕吐、腹泻、胰岛素与低镁病史。: Consider diuretic use, vomiting, diarrhea, insulin, and a history of hypomagnesemia.
老年人跌倒不都是骨科问题；一张心电图可能发现长间歇。: Falls in older adults are not always orthopedic problems; an ECG may reveal long pauses.
观察 ST 段是否为勺状而非水平型\/下斜型缺血性压低。: Observe whether the ST segment is spoon-shaped rather than horizontal/downsloping ischemic depression.
识别 P 波埋藏在 T 波或 QRS 终末的隐匿表现: Recognize hidden manifestations of P waves buried in the T wave or at the end of the QRS.
起搏钉极短高频，监护仪算法可能误识别；起搏器感知线路可拾取外界电磁信号。: Pacing spikes are very short and high-frequency, and monitor algorithms may misidentify them; pacemaker sensing circuits can pick up external electromagnetic signals.
长-短周期后的宽 QRS 先想 Ashman 差异性传导。: For a wide QRS after a long-short cycle, first consider Ashman aberrancy.
陈旧期：ST 正常、Q\/QS 遗留、T 可正常或倒置。: Old stage: ST normal, Q/QS persists, T may be normal or inverted.
需排除药物、甲减、电解质与缺血。: Need to exclude drugs, hypothyroidism, electrolyte abnormalities, and ischemia.
静脉补液扩容，促进钙排泄；袢利尿剂仅在扩容后谨慎使用。: IV fluid replacement to expand volume and promote calcium excretion; loop diuretics should be used cautiously only after volume expansion.
额面电轴 −45°～−90°：I、aVL 主波向上，II、III、aVF 主波向: Frontal plane axis −45° to −90°: main waves upright in I and aVL, and downward in II, III, and aVF.
58 岁男性，胸痛 1 小时，血压 82\/50，肺野清；II\/III\/aV: 58-year-old man, chest pain for 1 hour, BP 82/50, clear lung fields; ST elevation in II/III/aVF and ST elevation in V4R.
AIVR 常是再灌注的“信号灯”，血流动力学稳定时多数不需要抗心律失常药。: AIVR is often a 'signal light' of reperfusion; when hemodynamically stable, most cases do not require antiarrhythmic drugs.
CRT 双室起搏，QRS 可变窄。: CRT biventricular pacing; QRS may narrow.
II、III、aVF 中至少两个相邻导联 ST 抬高 ≥1 mm，伴 aVL（最: ST elevation ≥1 mm in at least two adjacent leads among II, III, and aVF, with reciprocal depression in aVL (most sensitive); greater ST elevation in lead III than in lead II suggests right coronary artery occlusion. Add V4R when right ventricular infarction is suspected; ST elevation ≥1 mm is diagnostically valuable.
I 正、aVF 正=正常；I 正、aVF 负=可能左偏；I 负、aVF 正=右偏: I positive, aVF positive = normal; I positive, aVF negative = possible left axis deviation; I negative, aVF positive = right axis deviation.
PR <0.12 s、QRS 正常、无 delta 波；阵发性窄 QRS 心动过: PR <0.12 s, normal QRS, no delta wave; paroxysmal narrow-QRS tachycardia; need to exclude WPW, AVNRT, and normal variant.
PVC 宽大畸形、前无 P、T 波方向与 QRS 主波相反，代偿间歇完全。: PVC is wide and bizarre, without a preceding P wave, T wave direction opposite to the main QRS wave, with a fully compensatory pause.
V1 高 R 先看电轴与 ST-T。: For tall R in V1, first assess axis and ST-T.
aVR P 直立\/I 倒置。: P wave upright in aVR/inverted in I.
三度 AVB 伴慢逸搏：阿托品可能无效，准备经皮起搏；寻找下壁缺血\/药物\/电: Third-degree AVB with slow escape rhythm: atropine may be ineffective; prepare for transcutaneous pacing; look for reversible causes such as inferior ischemia/drugs/electrolytes.
下壁心梗加低血压加肺部清晰等于右室梗死，要补液而不是用硝酸酯。: Inferior MI plus hypotension plus clear lungs equals right ventricular infarction; give fluids rather than nitrates.

使用不合适的导联或把 U 波计入 T 波，导致 QT 测量误差。: Use of inappropriate leads or inclusion of the U wave in the T wave, leading to QT measurement error.
先天畸形改变心室容量\/压力负荷与传导系统，心电图反映这些血流动力学后果。: Congenital malformations alter ventricular volume/pressure load and the conduction system; the ECG reflects these hemodynamic consequences.

整个心室除极过程中，瞬时向量首尾相接形成 QRS 向量环；复极形成 T 向量环。: During the entire ventricular depolarization, instantaneous vectors connected head-to-tail form the QRS vector loop; repolarization forms the T vector loop. Surface leads are projections of the vector loop at different angles.

早期复极常见 J 点抬高、凹面向上 ST 抬高、T 波高耸，多见于年轻男性与运动: Early repolarization commonly shows J-point elevation, concave-upward ST elevation, and tall T waves, mostly in young men and athletes; most are asymptomatic and require no specific treatment.

术前 ECG 异常不等于取消手术；需评估严重程度、可逆因素与麻醉风险。: An abnormal preoperative ECG does not mean surgery should be canceled; severity, reversible factors, and anesthetic risk need to be assessed.
正常变异与缺血的差别，往往不在单个波形，而在“动态、镜像、临床背景”三件事。: The difference between normal variant and ischemia often lies not in a single waveform but in three things: “dynamic changes, reciprocal changes, and clinical context.”
测量 QT 间期，注意与心率匹配（QTc）。: Measure the QT interval and ensure it is matched to heart rate (QTc).
用 PR 与 QRS 宽度把传导阻滞分层定位: Use PR and QRS width to stratify and localize conduction blocks
看 QRS 主波方向，而不是单个小波。: Look at the direction of the main QRS wave, not an individual small wave.
确认走纸速度（25 mm\/s 或 50 mm\/s）与增益（10 mm\/mV: Confirm paper speed (25 mm/s or 50 mm/s) and gain (10 mm/mV or 5 mm/mV).
窦性心律不齐有清晰 P 波，RR 变化渐进。: Sinus arrhythmia has clear P waves and gradual RR variation.
立即高质量 CPR，尽快非同步除颤，双相 120–200 J（按厂商），单相 3: Immediate high-quality CPR and prompt asynchronous defibrillation, biphasic 120–200 J (per manufacturer), monophasic 360 J.
结合药物史（洋地黄）、电解质和心肌缺血评估病因。: Evaluate the cause in conjunction with medication history (digitalis), electrolytes, and myocardial ischemia.

起搏器故障先看钉与夺获。: For pacemaker malfunction, first look at pacing spikes and capture.
超急性期：高尖 T、ST 开始抬高、尚无 Q 波。: Hyperacute phase: tall peaked T waves, beginning ST elevation, no Q wave yet.
逆行 P 可埋于 QRS 终末: Retrograde P waves may be buried in the terminal portion of the QRS.
钉后应有 P 或 QRS。: There should be a P wave or QRS after the spike.
长-短周期启动、R-on-T 室早可触发尖端扭转型室速。: A long-short cycle initiates it, and R-on-T premature ventricular contractions can trigger torsades de pointes.
预激 + 房颤 = 宽 QRS 不规则极速心动过速；禁用单纯房室结阻滞剂。: Pre-excitation + atrial fibrillation = irregular, very rapid tachycardia with wide QRS; pure AV nodal blocking agents are contraindicated.
高钙 QT 缩短、ST 缩短。: Hypercalcemia shortens the QT interval and ST segment.
2:1 阻滞不能仅凭 PR 分型。: 2:1 block cannot be classified based on PR interval alone.

Holter 正常不能排除所有心律失常；阵发性事件可能需要事件记录器或植入式循环: A normal Holter does not exclude all arrhythmias; paroxysmal events may require an event recorder or implantable loop recorder.
LAFB 的记忆法：I、aVL“qR 高”，II、III、aVF“rS 深”，电: Mnemonic for LAFB: tall qR in I and aVL, deep rS in II, III, and aVF, with the axis pointing left superiorly.

PR 延长看房室结，QRS 增宽看束支\/分支。: PR prolongation points to the AV node; QRS widening points to bundle branch/fascicular block.
QRS 可窄（交界性逸搏）或宽（室性逸搏）；图例 QRS 0.14 s。: QRS may be narrow (junctional escape) or wide (ventricular escape); in the example, QRS is 0.14 s.
RBBB 有 rSR′，ST-T 通常继发改变，无穹隆型 ST 抬高。: RBBB has rSR′, ST-T changes are usually secondary, and there is no coved-type ST elevation.
ST 抬高仍需排除 ACS。: ST elevation still requires exclusion of ACS.
V1 是左房终末负向的关键导联。: V1 is the key lead for left atrial terminal negative deflection.

WPW 风险看旁路前传不应期。: WPW risk depends on the antegrade refractory period of the accessory pathway.
下壁 STEMI + 低血压 + 肺清：加做 V4R。: Inferior STEMI + hypotension + clear lungs: add V4R.

Its essential difference from type I second-degree block is that the block is below the AV node, rather than progressive fatigue within the AV node.
伴 QRS 增宽、束支阻滞、晕厥或黑矇。: With QRS widening, bundle branch block, syncope, or blackout.
低钾合并低镁、洋地黄中毒或 QT 延长。: Hypokalemia with hypomagnesemia, digitalis toxicity, or QT prolongation.
停用噻嗪类、维生素 D、含钙制剂；治疗原发病（甲旁亢、肿瘤）。: Discontinue thiazides, vitamin D, and calcium-containing preparations; treat the underlying disease (hyperparathyroidism, tumor).
先确认 QRS 宽度，再在 V1 找 rsR′、在 I 与 V6 找宽钝 S 波: First confirm QRS width, then look for rsR′ in V1 and a wide, slurred S wave in I and V6; a three-step approach can localize it.
出现房速、房颤或血流动力学异常：按相应流程处理。: If atrial tachycardia, atrial fibrillation, or hemodynamic instability occurs: manage according to the corresponding protocol.
勺状 ST 段压低、QT 缩短、T 波低平\/倒置；效应不等于中毒。: Scooped ST depression, shortened QT, and flattened/inverted T waves; effect does not equal toxicity.
反复症状性或已进展为三度阻滞伴晕厥：准备起搏，避免单纯阿托品替代。: Recurrent symptomatic episodes or progression to third-degree block with syncope: prepare for pacing; avoid substituting with atropine alone.
只给阿托品而不准备起搏：室性逸搏对阿托品反应差，延误可致心室停搏。: Giving atropine alone without preparing for pacing: ventricular escape responds poorly to atropine, and delay can lead to ventricular asystole.
右室梗死误用硝酸酯，导致严重低血压甚至休克。: Misuse of nitrates in right ventricular infarction can cause severe hypotension or even shock.
后壁 MI 看 V1–V3 压低、直立 T、V7–V9 抬高。: For posterior MI, look for depression in V1–V3, upright T waves, and elevation in V7–V9.
在宽 QRS 心动过速中，把室速误认为“连续 PVC”；连续 ≥3 个即应按室速: In wide-QRS tachycardia, misdiagnosing ventricular tachycardia as “consecutive PVCs”; consecutive ≥3 PVCs should be treated as ventricular tachycardia.
多数旁路为先天性；可伴 Ebstein 畸形、肥厚型心肌病。: Most accessory pathways are congenital; may be associated with Ebstein anomaly and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.
婴儿“吃奶差、呼吸快”可能是 SVT 心衰；心率 260 不是哭闹那么简单。: In infants, “poor feeding and rapid breathing” may indicate SVT heart failure; a heart rate of 260 is not just crying.
室早需查结构\/电解质。: PVCs require evaluation for structural disease/electrolytes.

左前分支阻滞：电轴左偏 + II\/III\/aVF rS。: Left anterior fascicular block: left axis deviation + rS in II/III/aVF.
常见原因：病态窦房结综合征、急性下壁心肌梗死、心肌炎、洋地黄\/β 阻滞剂过量、: Common causes: sick sinus syndrome, acute inferior myocardial infarction, myocarditis, digitalis/beta-blocker overdose, hyperkalemia, excessive vagal tone.
弥漫凹面 ST 抬高加 PR 压低，除 aVR\/V1 外无镜像压低，疼痛与体位: Diffuse concave ST elevation with PR depression, no reciprocal depression except in aVR/V1, pain related to posture.
心率可正常或偏慢，常伴窦性心动过缓。: Heart rate may be normal or slow, often accompanied by sinus bradycardia.

急性期：ST 抬高、Q 波形成、T 波开始倒置。: Acute phase: ST elevation, Q-wave formation, and T waves begin to invert.

Wide QRS + sudden dropped beats + syncope is a combination requiring prompt management.
把胸导联改变与右\/左室病变联系: Correlate precordial lead changes with right/left ventricular pathology.
按 PR 与脱落规律区分一度、二度 I 型、二度 II 型与三度房室阻滞: Distinguish first-degree, second-degree type I, second-degree type II, and third-degree AV block by PR interval and dropped-beat pattern.
数字孪生用患者影像\/电生理数据构建心脏电活动模型，模拟心律失常与治疗反应；目前: Digital twins use patient imaging/electrophysiology data to build models of cardiac electrical activity and simulate arrhythmias and treatment responses; currently mostly used in research.
新生儿高钾可致正弦波。: Hyperkalemia in neonates can cause sine waves.
晕厥 + 心率 28 + 宽 QRS，先经皮起搏，再找可逆原因。: Syncope + heart rate 28 + wide QRS: start transcutaneous pacing first, then look for reversible causes.
有症状或严重低钙：静脉葡萄糖酸钙（如 10% 葡萄糖酸钙 10–20 mL）缓慢: Symptomatic or severe hypocalcemia: intravenous calcium gluconate (e.g., 10% calcium gluconate 10–20 mL) by slow IV injection, with continuous ECG monitoring.
梗死对侧导联记录到镜像性 ST 压低；前降支近端闭塞可累及间隔支与传导系统，出现: Reciprocal ST depression is recorded in leads opposite the infarction; proximal left anterior descending artery occlusion can involve the septal branches and conduction system, producing RBBB, left anterior fascicular block, or AV block.
正常变异通常稳定、无对应导联的镜像改变、无病理性 Q 波；缺血性改变常有动态演变: Normal variants are usually stable, without reciprocal changes in corresponding leads and without pathological Q waves; ischemic changes often have dynamic evolution and clinical context.
用向量解释导联波形方向: Explain lead waveform direction using vectors
看多导联与患者。: Look at multiple leads and the patient.
窄 QRS + 规则 + 心率 150：先找 F 波，排除 2:1 房扑。: Narrow QRS + regular + heart rate 150: first look for F waves, rule out 2:1 atrial flutter.
窦性心律，ST 段压低，T 波低平，V2–V3 可见明显 U 波，QT(U) 延: Sinus rhythm, ST segment depression, flat T waves, prominent U waves visible in V2–V3, prolonged QT(U), consistent with ECG changes of hypokalemia.
窦速 P 波形态正常，频率随病因变化，常有逐渐起止。: In sinus tachycardia, P wave morphology is normal, rate varies with the cause, and onset/termination is often gradual.
细胞外钾升高使静息膜电位接近阈值，初期兴奋性增高（T 波高尖），进一步升高则钠通: Elevated extracellular potassium brings the resting membrane potential closer to threshold; initially excitability increases (peaked T waves), and further elevation causes sodium channel inactivation and slowed conduction (flattened P waves, prolonged PR, widened QRS).
缺血性 ST 改变应动态、可逆、与症状\/活动相关；ST 趋势需人工复核，避免伪: Ischemic ST changes should be dynamic, reversible, and related to symptoms/activity; ST trends require manual review to avoid artifacts.
节律基本规则，起止常较突然，多为短阵发作。: The rhythm is basically regular, onset and termination are often abrupt, mostly short episodes.
观察 V1–V4 T 波倒置、电轴右偏与顺钟向转位。: Observe T wave inversion in V1–V4, right axis deviation, and clockwise rotation.
识别右束支、左束支、左前与左后分支阻滞的图形: Recognize the patterns of right bundle branch block, left bundle branch block, left anterior and left posterior fascicular block
过感知→起搏抑制、心率慢。: Oversensing → pacing inhibition, slow heart rate.
连续记录中联律关系相对固定；若 PVC 与窦性搏动比例 2:1 则为三联律。: In continuous recordings, the coupling relationship is relatively fixed; if the PVC-to-sinus beat ratio is 2:1, it is trigeminy.
部分 SIDS 与长 QT 相关。: Some SIDS cases are associated with long QT.
除颤后立即恢复按压 2 分钟，不要停顿查看心律；每 2 分钟评估。: After defibrillation, immediately resume compressions for 2 minutes; do not pause to check the rhythm; assess every 2 minutes.
需结合超声心动图；运动员心脏可有电压增高但无病理劳损改变。: Correlate with echocardiography; athlete's heart may show increased voltage but no pathological strain changes.
频率 >100–110 次\/分、QRS 进一步增宽或节律不齐，可能为室速。: Rate >100–110 beats/min, further QRS widening, or irregular rhythm may indicate ventricular tachycardia.
高钙缩短动作电位平台期，复极加快，QT 间期缩短。: Hypercalcemia shortens the action potential plateau, accelerates repolarization, and shortens the QT interval.
2:1 阻滞需与二度 I 型鉴别，必要时行电生理检查。: 2:1 block must be differentiated from second-degree type I block; perform electrophysiological study if necessary.
Ashman 现象：长-短周期后出现宽 QRS（常 RBBB 型），是功能性差异: Ashman phenomenon: a wide QRS (often RBBB pattern) after a long-short cycle is functional aberrant conduction, not a premature ventricular contraction.
HCM 是青少年运动猝死的重要原因；心电图可高电压、深 Q、T 倒置，也可正常。: HCM is an important cause of sudden cardiac death during sports in adolescents; ECG may show high voltage, deep Q waves, and T-wave inversion, or may be normal.
I 正\/aVF 正：正常电轴（约 −30° 至 +90°）；I 正\/aVF: I positive/aVF positive: normal axis (about −30° to +90°); I positive/aVF negative: possible left axis deviation; I negative/aVF positive: right axis deviation; both negative: extreme right axis deviation/indeterminate axis.

QRS 前无窦性 P 波；若出现 P 波，多为逆行 P（II、III、aVF 倒: No sinus P wave before the QRS; if a P wave is present, it is usually retrograde (inverted in II, III, aVF) and may be located before the QRS (very short PR), within the QRS, or after the QRS.
QT 从 QRS 起点到 T 波终点，T 波终点用切线法；心率快时 QT 缩短，: QT is measured from the QRS onset to the T-wave end, with the T-wave end determined by the tangent method; QT shortens at faster heart rates and requires correction.
S1Q3T3 可见于肺栓塞，也可见于 COPD。: S1Q3T3 may be seen in pulmonary embolism and also in COPD.
TdP 导致短暂脑缺血，可出现抽搐；脑电图不一定异常。: TdP causes transient cerebral ischemia and may cause seizures; EEG is not necessarily abnormal.
下壁梗死合并 V1–V3 压低时，优先考虑后壁扩展而不是前壁缺血。: When inferior infarction is accompanied by V1–V3 depression, consider posterior extension rather than anterior ischemia first.
与室速鉴别靠 P\/形态\/病史。: Differentiation from ventricular tachycardia relies on P waves/morphology/history.
二度 II 型、三度宽 QRS：进展风险高，评估起搏指征。: Second-degree type II and third-degree with wide QRS: high risk of progression; evaluate indications for pacing.
伴血流动力学不稳定、晕厥或进展为交界性心动过速。: Accompanied by hemodynamic instability, syncope, or progression to junctional tachycardia.
先看患者与脉搏，再判读。: Assess the patient and pulse before interpreting the ECG.
前壁 STEMI 有缺血症状、动态 ST 改变与心肌标志物升高。: Anterior STEMI has ischemic symptoms, dynamic ST changes, and elevated cardiac biomarkers.
双极起搏钉可能很小。: Bipolar pacing spikes may be very small.
只看心室率慢就诊断，未确认 P 与 QRS 完全分离。: Diagnosing solely based on slow ventricular rate without confirming complete P-QRS dissociation.
右房增大使 P 波振幅增高，II、III、aVF 出现高尖“肺型 P 波”；常见: Right atrial enlargement increases P-wave amplitude, producing tall, peaked “P pulmonale” waves in II, III, and aVF; commonly seen in cor pulmonale, pulmonary hypertension, and tricuspid valve disease.

左室肥厚可伴电轴左偏。: Left ventricular hypertrophy may be accompanied by left axis deviation.

持续胸痛超过 20 分钟，伴低血压、肺水肿、心源性休克（Killip III–I: Persistent chest pain for more than 20 minutes, accompanied by hypotension, pulmonary edema, cardiogenic shock (Killip class III–IV).
旁路、房速、室早\/室速标测。: Mapping of accessory pathways, atrial tachycardia, and premature ventricular complexes/ventricular tachycardia.

查先心病\/电解质。: Evaluate for congenital heart disease/electrolyte abnormalities.

用于窄 QRS 心动过速与房室分离。: Used for narrow QRS tachycardia and AV dissociation.

窦性心律，约 72 次\/分，记录中可见一次提前出现的 P′ 波后跟窄 QRS，: Sinus rhythm at approximately 72 beats/min; the recording shows one premature P′ wave followed by a narrow QRS, with an incomplete compensatory pause.
结论分级；危急值电话通知。: Conclusion grading; critical values notified by telephone.

远程监测提高设备随访效率。: Remote monitoring improves device follow-up efficiency.

高负荷（>10–15%）或疑心动过速性心肌病：心内科评估导管消融。: High burden (>10–15%) or suspected tachycardia-induced cardiomyopathy: cardiology evaluation for catheter ablation.
10 mm\/mV、25 mm\/s 是默认标准。: 10 mm/mV, 25 mm/s are the default standard.

ICD 可起搏、抗心动过速起搏（ATP）与除颤；心电图可见起搏钉、ATP 快速刺: ICD can pace, deliver antitachycardia pacing (ATP), and defibrillate; ECG may show pacing spikes, rapid ATP bursts, or a brief pause after defibrillation.

伴晕厥、休克或急性心肌缺血。: Associated with syncope, shock, or acute myocardial ischemia.
低钾有 U 波与 QT 延长；洋地黄 QT 缩短。: Hypokalemia has U waves and QT prolongation; digitalis shortens QT.
创伤患者心电图异常需结合 FAST\/超声、生命体征；不要因“心电图正常”排除严: In trauma patients, abnormal ECG findings should be interpreted together with FAST/ultrasound and vital signs; do not exclude severe injury based on a normal ECG.
双心房增大同时具备右房高 P 波与左房宽\/双峰 P 波；P 波可既高又宽，V1: Biatrial enlargement has both tall right atrial P waves and broad/bifid left atrial P waves; P waves may be both tall and broad, with biphasic P waves in V1.

四个阶段：从高尖 T 到陈旧 Q 波: Four stages: from tall peaked T waves to old Q waves.

The premature P wave differs in morphology from the sinus P wave and is not followed by a QRS; because the P wave is premature, the next sinus P wave is often also disrupted, and the pause is usually incompletely compensatory. The long pause itself predisposes to an escape beat or delay of the next sinus P wave.

常见于 STEMI 溶栓或 PCI 再灌注、洋地黄中毒、心肌炎、高钾血症和缺氧，: Commonly seen in reperfusion after thrombolysis or PCI for STEMI, digitalis toxicity, myocarditis, hyperkalemia, and hypoxia; it can also occur as short episodes in patients without structural heart disease.
异位间期有公约数。: Ectopic intervals have a common divisor.

忽略年轻患者 LVH 可能提示肥厚型心肌病或 Fabry 病。: Ignoring LVH in a young patient may miss hypertrophic cardiomyopathy or Fabry disease.
患者移动、转运、抽搐可产生高幅不规则伪差，模拟室速\/室颤；常见于急诊与院前。: Patient movement, transport, and seizures can produce high-amplitude irregular artifact mimicking VT/VF; commonly seen in the emergency department and prehospital settings.
房室结细胞动作电位上升支依赖 L 型钙电流，传导速度慢，形成 PR 段。这种延迟: The upstroke of the action potential in AV nodal cells depends on L-type calcium current, with slow conduction velocity, forming the PR segment. This delay allows the atria to complete filling before ventricular contraction.
房颤无规则 F 波，基线细颤，RR 绝对不规则。: Atrial fibrillation has no regular F waves, fine baseline fibrillation, and absolutely irregular RR intervals.

纠正缺血、低钾、低镁、甲亢与药物诱因；急性心梗后 PVC 按指南管理。: Correct ischemia, hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia, hyperthyroidism, and drug triggers; manage PVCs after acute MI according to guidelines.

肢体导联看额面，胸导联看水平面。: Limb leads view the frontal plane; precordial leads view the horizontal plane.

避免单纯追求“降心率”而掩盖感染、休克或出血。: Avoid simply pursuing "heart rate reduction" and masking infection, shock, or bleeding.
除颤后短暂停顿需恢复按压\/评估。: After defibrillation, a brief pause requires resumption of compressions/assessment.
需确认左室导线夺获。: Need to confirm left ventricular lead capture.

高尖 T 波、晕厥\/家族猝死。: Peaked T waves, syncope/family history of sudden death.

ILR 连续监测数年。: ILR provides continuous monitoring for several years.
