V1 的 R′ 峰时间 >50 ms、R′ 宽于初始 r，且 I 与 V6 的: R′ peak time in V1 >50 ms, R′ wider than the initial r, and S wave duration in I and V6 >40 ms or wider than the R wave in the same lead; the combination of these three distinguishes true RBBB from normal variant and ventricular rhythm.
WPW 三联：短 PR、delta 波、宽 QRS。: WPW triad: short PR, delta wave, wide QRS.
一度阻滞 = PR 延长但“一个都不少”。: First-degree block = PR prolongation but “none are missing.”
下壁导联直接抬高；后壁梗死常与之并存，需加做 V7–V9 确认扩展。: Direct elevation in inferior leads; posterior infarction often coexists and requires additional V7–V9 to confirm extension.
不要因“波形乱”诊断房颤；寻找可辨认的 QRS 与 P 波。: Do not diagnose AF because the “waveform is messy”; look for identifiable QRS and P waves.
久站\/闷热\/疼痛诱发。: Induced by prolonged standing/hot stuffy environment/pain.
代码不能说明起搏器当前工作模式；程控后实际模式可能改变，需查起搏器记录。: The code cannot indicate the pacemaker’s current operating mode; the actual mode may change after programming, so pacemaker records must be checked.
低钾 T 波低平、U 波明显，QT 延长。: Hypokalemia: flat T waves, prominent U waves, QT prolongation.
先天性 AVB 与母体抗体相关。: Congenital AVB is associated with maternal antibodies.
先看患者意识、脉搏、血压与其他导联；真实室颤应无脉且多导联一致。: First check the patient’s consciousness, pulse, blood pressure, and other leads; true VF should be pulseless and consistent across multiple leads.
双室起搏时 QRS 常较单腔右室起搏窄；V1 可能仍呈负向，但电轴与形态改变；需: During biventricular pacing, QRS is often narrower than with single-chamber right ventricular pacing; V1 may still be negative, but the axis and morphology change; pacemaker records are needed to confirm biventricular capture.
可伴心动过缓、交界性\/室性逸搏、室速\/室颤或停搏。: May be accompanied by bradycardia, junctional/ventricular escape beats, VT/VF, or asystole.
右室心肌被纤维脂肪替代，传导延迟与折返形成室速；运动可加速疾病进展。: Right ventricular myocardium is replaced by fibrofatty tissue; delayed conduction and reentry form VT; exercise can accelerate disease progression.
同一导联中 P′ 形态和联律间期相对固定，提示单源房早。: In the same lead, P′ morphology and coupling interval are relatively fixed, suggesting unifocal premature atrial contractions.
在长间歇前确认基础 P 波为窦性，测量基础 PP 间期。: Before the long pause, confirm the underlying P waves are sinus and measure the baseline PP interval.
多形性 VT、尖端扭转型、R-on-T、长 QT 背景。: Polymorphic VT, torsades de pointes, R-on-T, long QT background.
室性逸搏心律是节律本身；三度阻滞强调 P 与 QRS 分离，可由交界性或室性逸搏: Ventricular escape rhythm is the rhythm itself; third-degree block emphasizes P and QRS dissociation, which may be maintained by junctional or ventricular escape.
寻找 QRS 增宽、P 波消失、正弦波等危重表现。: Look for widened QRS, absent P waves, sine wave, and other critical findings.
局部电极记录到高频、双相或碎裂电位；标测以最早激动点、舒张期电位、起搏标测为核心: Local electrodes record high-frequency, biphasic, or fractionated potentials; mapping centers on earliest activation, diastolic potentials, and pace mapping.
常见诱因：发热、疼痛、焦虑、运动、低血容量、贫血、甲状腺功能亢进、肺栓塞、缺氧、: Common triggers: fever, pain, anxiety, exercise, hypovolemia, anemia, hyperthyroidism, pulmonary embolism, hypoxia, heart failure, drugs, or withdrawal.
心搏停止\/PEA：CPR + 肾上腺素，禁止除颤，寻找 Hs & Ts。: Cardiac arrest/PEA: CPR + epinephrine, defibrillation contraindicated, look for Hs & Ts.
心电图测量包括纸速、增益、心率、PR、QRS、QT\/QTc、电轴与振幅。标准纸: ECG measurements include paper speed, gain, heart rate, PR, QRS, QT/QTc, axis, and amplitude. At standard paper speed 25 mm/s, one small box is 0.04 s and one large box is 0.20 s; at standard gain 10 mm/mV, 10 mm represents 1 mV.
心脏除极可看作无数电偶向量的瞬时叠加；体表导联记录的是这些向量在该导联轴上的投影: Cardiac depolarization can be viewed as the instantaneous summation of countless electrical dipole vectors; surface leads record the projection of these vectors onto that lead's axis.
急性胸痛、心悸伴新发频发房早，应评估心肌缺血、电解质紊乱与甲亢。: Acute chest pain and palpitations with new-onset frequent premature atrial contractions should prompt evaluation for myocardial ischemia, electrolyte disturbances, and hyperthyroidism.
房室阻滞先用 PR 与脱落规律分度，再用 QRS 宽度与阻滞类型定位；症状性高度: For AV block, first grade by PR and dropped beats, then localize by QRS width and block type; symptomatic high-grade block and infranodal disease require pacing evaluation.
把二联律的“脉搏强弱交替”误认为交替脉（后者见于严重左心衰）。: Mistaking the "alternating strong and weak pulse" of bigeminy for pulsus alternans (the latter seen in severe left heart failure).
报告要结构化，结论分级。: The report should be structured, with graded conclusions.
新生儿右室优势是生理。: Right ventricular dominance in neonates is physiological.
最具特异性的是“提前出现的 P′ 波且形态与窦性 P 不同”；若 P′ 隐藏在: The most specific finding is a "premature P′ wave with a morphology different from the sinus P wave"; if P′ is hidden in the T wave, compare its morphology with the preceding T wave, and if necessary use multiple leads or a longer recording to find it.
未下传的 P 波常埋藏在 T 波或 QRS 终末，表现为 T 波形态改变、T 波: Non-conducted P waves are often buried in the T wave or at the end of the QRS, manifesting as a change in T-wave morphology, a notch on the T wave, or a seemingly "extra" small deflection between two QRS complexes. Comparing other T waves in the same lead is key to detecting it.
标准定标下的正常窦性心律，用于练习 PR、QRS、QT 与心率测量。: Normal sinus rhythm under standard calibration, for practicing PR, QRS, QT, and heart rate measurement.
比较不同导联的 delta 极性，粗略判断旁路位置（需电生理确认）。: Compare delta-wave polarity in different leads to roughly estimate accessory pathway location (requires electrophysiological confirmation).
现代监护仪可连续分析 ST 段趋势，但受基线漂移、导联位置与滤波影响；ST 报警: Modern monitors can continuously analyze ST-segment trends, but are affected by baseline wander, lead position, and filtering; ST alarms must be confirmed by 12-lead ECG or clinical findings.
电轴显著左偏（−45°～−90°），I、aVL 呈 qR，II、III、aVF: Marked left axis deviation (−45° to −90°), qR in I and aVL, rS in II, III, and aVF, with a narrow QRS.
症状性高度阻滞先支持、找可逆原因，再评估起搏。: For symptomatic high-grade block, provide support first, identify reversible causes, then evaluate pacing.
相邻导联水平型或下斜型 ST 压低 ≥1 mm；肌钙蛋白决定 NSTEMI 还是: Horizontal or downsloping ST depression ≥1 mm in adjacent leads; troponin determines NSTEMI versus unstable angina, and risk stratification determines the timing of angiography.
短 QT 综合征表现为 QTc <340 ms，伴高尖 T 波、室颤\/猝死风险: Short QT syndrome presents with QTc <340 ms, tall peaked T waves, and risk of ventricular fibrillation/sudden death; it is a rare ion channel disorder.
窄 QRS + 慢 + 无直立 P = 交界性逸搏；看到它先找长间歇背后的病因。: Narrow QRS + slow + no upright P = junctional escape beat; when you see it, first look for the cause behind the long pause.
窦性心律，ST 段延长，QT 间期约 0.52 s，T 波形态相对正常，符合低钙: Sinus rhythm, prolonged ST segment, QT interval about 0.52 s, relatively normal T-wave morphology, consistent with ECG changes of hypocalcemia.
第一位起搏腔（A\/V\/D），第二位感知腔，第三位反应（I\/T\/D），第四: First pacing chamber (A/V/D), second sensed chamber, third response (I/T/D), fourth rate adaptation (R), fifth multisite pacing.
结合病史：再灌注、洋地黄、心肌炎、电解质紊乱。: Correlate with history: reperfusion, digitalis, myocarditis, electrolyte disturbance.
老年人转头晕厥，问衣领、刮胡子、转头；但按摩试验要先看颈动脉。: An elderly person with syncope on turning the head; ask about tight collar, shaving, and head turning; but before a massage test, examine the carotid arteries first.
若为三度房室阻滞伴晕厥，应直接准备起搏，不要用单纯阿托品替代。: If third-degree AV block is accompanied by syncope, prepare for pacing directly; do not substitute atropine alone.
观察有无镜像压低：aVR\/V1 以外出现明显镜像压低，应警惕 STEMI。: Look for reciprocal depression: marked reciprocal depression in leads other than aVR/V1 should raise suspicion of STEMI.
识别可疑后壁心梗的间接征象并正确加做 18 导联: Recognize indirect signs of suspected posterior myocardial infarction and correctly add an 18-lead ECG.
起搏钉由起搏器电容放电产生，持续时间极短；现代双极起搏钉更小，易被滤波。: Pacing spikes are generated by discharge of the pacemaker capacitor and have a very short duration; modern bipolar pacing spikes are smaller and easily filtered out.
逆行 P 波被心房导线感知，起搏器按 AV 间期起搏心室，形成“起搏器—房室结”: The retrograde P wave is sensed by the atrial lead, the pacemaker paces the ventricle according to the AV interval, forming “pacemaker–AV node” reentry.
避免抗凝与抗血小板（除非另有强指征），以防出血性心包积液。: Avoid anticoagulation and antiplatelet therapy (unless there is another strong indication) to prevent hemorrhagic pericardial effusion.
长 QT 导致的晕厥\/抽搐可被误诊为癫痫；查心电图与家族史，避免 QT 延长药: Syncope/convulsions due to long QT can be misdiagnosed as epilepsy; check ECG and family history, and avoid QT-prolonging drugs.
隐匿性传导指冲动进入房室结但未穿透至心室，却改变了房室结的不应期，影响后续传导。: Concealed conduction refers to an impulse entering the AV node but not penetrating to the ventricles, yet altering the AV node refractory period and affecting subsequent conduction.
需排除高钙、洋地黄、发热等。: Need to exclude hypercalcemia, digitalis, fever, etc.
食管导联用于即时机制鉴别（窄 QRS 心动过速、房室分离），Holter 用于长: Esophageal lead is used for immediate mechanism differentiation (narrow QRS tachycardia, AV dissociation); Holter is used to capture paroxysmal events over a long period; the two are complementary.
高钾 T 高尖\/QRS 宽；低钾 U 波\/ST 低；高钙 QT 短；低钙 Q: Hyperkalemia: tall peaked T waves/wide QRS; hypokalemia: U waves/ST depression; hypercalcemia: short QT; hypocalcemia: long QT; hypomagnesemia: long QT + TdP.
2\/3 型：马鞍型 ST 抬高，需药物激发试验或移位导联确认。: Type 2/3: saddleback ST elevation, requiring drug provocation test or lead repositioning to confirm.
70 岁男性，COPD 急性加重，喘憋；心电图窦速、肺型 P 波、电轴右偏、V1: 70-year-old male with acute exacerbation of COPD and dyspnea; ECG shows sinus tachycardia, P pulmonale, right axis deviation, tall R in V1, and new-onset atrial fibrillation.
AI 可筛查房颤\/低 EF\/高钾等。: AI can screen for atrial fibrillation/low EF/hyperkalemia, etc.
II、III、aVF 镜像 ST↓ 1 mm: Reciprocal ST depression of 1 mm in II, III, aVF
LBBB 看“三无一宽”：I、V5、V6 无 q，R 波宽钝，V1 深 S。: LBBB shows the “three absences and one wide”: no q in I, V5, V6; broad and slurred R wave; deep S in V1.
PR >0.20 s 本身不是起搏指征，症状与进展风险才是。: PR >0.20 s by itself is not an indication for pacing; symptoms and risk of progression are.
QTc <340 ms（部分标准 <360 ms）、T 波高尖、无 ST 段；晕: QTc <340 ms (some criteria <360 ms), tall peaked T waves, absent ST segment; history of syncope/family sudden death/ventricular fibrillation supports the diagnosis.
RVH 看电轴右偏与右胸劳损。: RVH: look for right axis deviation and right precordial strain.
TdP = 多形性 VT + 长 QT + 扭转；看到扭转先找 QT。: TdP = polymorphic VT + long QT + twisting; when you see twisting, look for QT first.
V1 高 R 是“向量问题”，不是“右室肥厚”的同义词；先问哪个方向的向量变大了: Tall R in V1 is a “vector problem,” not a synonym for “right ventricular hypertrophy”; first ask which direction of vector has become larger.
delta 波方向定位旁路。: The direction of the delta wave localizes the accessory pathway.
三度 AVB 的宽 QRS 逸搏不稳定；不要只等阿托品，准备起搏。: Wide QRS escape beats in third-degree AVB are unstable; do not just wait for atropine—prepare for pacing.
下壁心梗阻滞多可逆；前壁心梗宽 QRS 三度阻滞预后差。: Conduction block in inferior MI is mostly reversible; wide QRS third-degree block in anterior MI has a poor prognosis.
不要用 Holter 回答“这个心动过速的机制”；也不要用电生理检查回答“一天有: Do not use Holter monitoring to answer "what is the mechanism of this tachycardia"; nor should you use an electrophysiology study to answer "how much AF burden is there in a day".
交界区是心脏的“第二梯队”，它出场说明窦房结这一级已经失守。: The junctional area is the heart's "second tier"; its appearance indicates that the sinoatrial node level has already failed.
低电压 + 电轴右偏 + 右房增大。: Low voltage + right axis deviation + right atrial enlargement.
先心病术后晕厥\/心悸需动态监测；不能只看静息 ECG。: Syncope/palpitations after congenital heart disease surgery require ambulatory monitoring; do not rely only on a resting ECG.
双分支：RBBB + LAFB 最常见，QRS 宽且电轴左偏。: Bifascicular block: RBBB + LAFB is the most common, with wide QRS and left axis deviation.
只在一个导联测量 QT，忽略导联间差异。: Measuring QT in only one lead and ignoring differences between leads.
右室扩张使室间隔左移，进一步降低左室充盈与心输出量，形成低血压；肺部通常清晰，因: Right ventricular dilation shifts the interventricular septum to the left, further reducing left ventricular filling and cardiac output, causing hypotension; the lungs are usually clear because left heart filling pressures are not elevated.
同一向量在不同导联上的投影大小不同：投影 = |V| × cos(夹角)，朝向为: The same vector projects with different magnitudes onto different leads: projection = |V| × cos(angle); toward the lead is positive, away is negative.
地高辛中毒的心电图不是“鱼钩样 ST”那么简单；房速伴阻滞是危险信号。: The ECG of digoxin toxicity is not simply "fishhook ST"; atrial tachycardia with block is a danger signal.
多形性宽 QRS、尖端扭转、长 QT。: Polymorphic wide QRS, torsades de pointes, long QT.
寻找并纠正诱因：甲亢、电解质、咖啡因、酒精。: Identify and correct triggers: hyperthyroidism, electrolytes, caffeine, alcohol.
希氏束与束支: Bundle of His and bundle branches
心室除极的综合向量方向决定各肢体导联 QRS 的极性；左前分支阻滞、左室肥厚等使: The direction of the overall ventricular depolarization vector determines QRS polarity in each limb lead; left anterior fascicular block, left ventricular hypertrophy, etc., shift the vector leftward.
心梗从超急性高尖 T、ST 抬高到 Q 波形成、T 波倒置，最后遗留 Q 波；导: Myocardial infarction evolves from hyperacute peaked T waves and ST elevation to Q wave formation and T wave inversion, and finally leaves a Q wave; lead combinations (III>II, V4R, aVR, etc.) help identify the culprit vessel.
心肌缺血与 ST 段压低指冠状动脉供血不足导致心内膜下心肌缺血，心电图上出现水平: Myocardial ischemia and ST-segment depression refer to subendocardial myocardial ischemia caused by insufficient coronary blood supply, with horizontal or downsloping ST-segment depression and T wave inversion on ECG, with or without elevated cardiac troponin. Elevated troponin indicates NSTEMI; normal troponin indicates unstable angina; both are collectively called non-ST-elevation acute coronary syndrome.
急性 ACS、严重主动脉瓣狭窄是禁忌。: Acute ACS and severe aortic stenosis are contraindications.
房室分离是“现象”，不是“诊断”；先问谁控制谁、谁更快。: AV dissociation is a "phenomenon," not a "diagnosis"; first ask who controls whom and who is faster.
把 2:1 阻滞都当文氏型：2:1 无法仅凭 PR 分型，宽 QRS 更支持 I: Do not treat every 2:1 block as Wenckebach: 2:1 cannot be classified by PR alone; a wide QRS favors type II.
把每一个波都当成“向量在某导联轴上的投影”，而不是孤立的起伏。: Treat every wave as "a projection of a vector onto a lead axis," not as an isolated deflection.
持续性窦缓 <40、窦性停搏 >3 s、窦房阻滞、心动过缓与房颤\/房速交替；晕: Persistent sinus bradycardia <40, sinus pause >3 s, sinoatrial block, alternating bradycardia and AF/atrial tachycardia; syncope/amaurosis fugax is key to treatment.
斑块破裂或侵蚀继发不完全闭塞血栓，或固定狭窄在运动、贫血、感染时需氧增加，造成可: Plaque rupture or erosion leading to incomplete occlusive thrombus, or fixed stenosis with increased oxygen demand during exercise, anemia, or infection, causing reversible ischemia.
旁路绕过房室结，形成折返环；婴儿旁路可随发育退化。: The bypass tract bypasses the AV node, forming a reentry circuit; infant accessory pathways may regress with development.
晕厥\/家族猝死\/NSVT 是风险。: Syncope/family history of sudden death/NSVT are risks.
最具特异性的是“窦性 P 波形态一致 + PR 恒定 + RR 渐短渐长的周期性: The most specific finding is "consistent sinus P-wave morphology + constant PR + cyclical RR shortening then lengthening"; there is no premature P′ or compensatory pause.
术后房颤先找“为什么现在发生”：感染、缺氧、容量、电解质，而不是只给 β 阻滞剂: Postoperative AF: first look for "why now": infection, hypoxia, volume, electrolytes, rather than only giving beta-blockers.
检查 I、III、V1 导联的 S1Q3T3 与右束支阻滞。: Check S1Q3T3 and right bundle branch block in leads I, III, and V1.
正常激动：窦房结 → 心房 → 房室结 → 希氏束 → 束支 → 浦肯野 → 心: Normal activation: SA node → atria → AV node → His bundle → bundle branches → Purkinje → ventricular myocardium.
测量 QT，寻找 T 波低平\/倒置。: Measure QT and look for flattened/inverted T waves.
电交替+低电压要快查超声。: Electrical alternans + low voltage: quickly obtain echocardiography.
看到 QT 长 + U 波，别只补钾；查镁，低镁是 TdP 的共犯。: Long QT + U waves: do not just replace potassium; check magnesium—hypomagnesemia is an accomplice in TdP.
窄 QRS 心动过速，心室率约 170 次\/分，每个 QRS 前可见形态异常的: Narrow-QRS tachycardia, ventricular rate approximately 170 bpm, with abnormal P′ waves visible before each QRS, suggesting atrial tachycardia.
窦性心律，V1–V2 导联穹隆型 ST 段抬高 ≥2 mm，伴 T 波倒置，符合: Sinus rhythm, coved ST-segment elevation ≥2 mm in leads V1–V2 with T-wave inversion, consistent with Brugada type 1 ECG.
第二步：任一胸导联 RS 间期 >100 ms → 支持室速。: Step 2: RS interval >100 ms in any precordial lead → supports VT.
结合超声评估积液与填塞，听诊摩擦音，检测炎症指标与肌钙蛋白。: Combine with ultrasound to assess effusion and tamponade, auscultate for a friction rub, and check inflammatory markers and troponin.
肺动脉高压与右室负荷导致右心扩张、传导延迟与复极异常；小栓塞心电图可完全正常。: Pulmonary hypertension and right ventricular load lead to right heart dilation, conduction delay, and repolarization abnormalities; the ECG can be completely normal in small emboli.
脑心综合征可 ST-T\/QT 改变。: Brain-heart syndrome can cause ST-T/QT changes.
表现为突然的 PR 延长、P 波脱漏、房颤心室率不规则；只能通过后续传导变化推断: Presents as sudden PR prolongation, dropped P waves, and an irregular ventricular rate in atrial fibrillation; it can only be inferred from subsequent conduction changes.
评估心动过速发作时 QRS 宽度与规则性。: Assess QRS width and regularity during tachycardia episodes.
说明交感\/迷走神经对窦房结的影响: Explain the effects of sympathetic/vagal nerves on the sinoatrial node
起搏心电图上的 AV 间期是“设置值”，但血流动力学效果要看超声与症状。: The AV interval on a paced ECG is a set value, but hemodynamic effects depend on ultrasound and symptoms.
运动中晕厥\/家族猝死是红线。: Syncope during exercise/family history of sudden death is a red flag.
逆行 P 或窄 QRS。: Retrograde P waves or narrow QRS.
避免不必要的减慢传导药物，定期复查心电图与超声心动图。: Avoid unnecessary conduction-slowing drugs, and regularly recheck ECG and echocardiography.
钉后无波形=失夺获。: No waveform after the spike = loss of capture.
长 QT 可表现为抽搐。: Long QT can present as seizures.
预激可引起电轴偏移，但 PR 短、有 δ 波。: Pre-excitation can cause axis deviation, but PR is short with a δ wave.
62 岁女性，乏力、恶心、上腹不适，无典型胸痛；心电图 V2–V5 ST 压低、: A 62-year-old woman with fatigue, nausea, and epigastric discomfort, without typical chest pain; ECG shows ST depression and T-wave inversion in V2–V5, and troponin is elevated.
COPD 急性加重常伴窦速\/房颤\/右心负荷；先纠正低氧、感染、电解质，再考虑: Acute exacerbation of COPD is often accompanied by sinus tachycardia/atrial fibrillation/right heart strain; first correct hypoxia, infection, and electrolytes, then consider rate control.
Holter 的 ST 改变假阳性率高；不要仅凭趋势诊断冠心病。: ST changes on Holter have a high false-positive rate; do not diagnose coronary heart disease based on trends alone.
MAT：多形 P + 心率快。: MAT: polymorphic P waves + fast heart rate.
PVC 负荷 >10–15%，或伴左室功能下降，需评估心动过速性心肌病。: PVC burden >10–15%, or with decreased left ventricular function, requires evaluation for tachycardia-induced cardiomyopathy.

找 P 波：在 II 导联确认 P 波直立，测量 PR 间期与 P 波宽度。: Find P waves: confirm upright P waves in lead II and measure the PR interval and P wave width.
抗凝看卒中风险，不看症状。: Anticoagulation is guided by stroke risk, not symptoms.
按冠脉供血区域定位导联: Localize leads according to coronary artery supply territories
提示高度\/三度 AVB 但传导未完全中断。: Suggests high-grade/third-degree AVB, but conduction is not completely interrupted.
新生儿心率 150 可能是正常，成人 150 是心动过速；年龄决定正常范围。: A neonatal heart rate of 150 may be normal; in an adult, 150 is tachycardia; age determines the normal range.
无症状的慢性 LBBB 无特异治疗，重点治疗基础心脏病与危险因素。: Asymptomatic chronic LBBB has no specific treatment; focus on treating underlying heart disease and risk factors.
晕厥、心脏骤停复苏史或家族猝死史。: Syncope, a history of resuscitation from cardiac arrest, or a family history of sudden death.
有症状的心动过缓（晕厥、低血压、休克、缺血、急性心衰、意识改变）需要立即处理：建: Symptomatic bradycardia (syncope, hypotension, shock, ischemia, acute heart failure, altered consciousness) requires immediate management: establish IV access, cardiac monitoring, correct hypoxia and electrolytes; atropine 1 mg IV, repeatable every 3–5 minutes (total 3 mg) is indicated for AV nodal disease and may be ineffective for infranodal (below the His bundle) block.
标准 12 导联可能漏诊右室和后壁梗死；V3R–V5R 与 V7–V9 可扩展观: Standard 12-lead ECG may miss right ventricular and posterior wall infarction; V3R–V5R and V7–V9 can extend assessment to the right ventricle and posterior wall.
洋地黄中毒、严重高钾血症或急性心肌缺血背景。: In the setting of digitalis toxicity, severe hyperkalemia, or acute myocardial ischemia.
游走性心房起搏点指起搏点在心房内移动，P 波形态逐搏变化，心率通常 <100 次: Wandering atrial pacemaker means the pacemaker site moves within the atria, P-wave morphology changes from beat to beat, and the heart rate is usually <100 beats/min.
电极移动改变接触阻抗，产生低频高幅信号；导线摆动也会产生伪差。: Electrode movement changes contact impedance and produces low-frequency, high-amplitude signals; lead wire swinging can also produce artifact.
病例：年轻卒中与房颤: Case: Young stroke and atrial fibrillation
确认 QRS 宽 ≥0.12 s，且其前没有固定 PR 的 P 波。: Confirm QRS duration ≥0.12 s and no preceding P wave with a fixed PR interval.
窦缓\/传导阻滞\/房颤常见。: Sinus bradycardia/conduction block/atrial fibrillation are common.
结合宫缩与临床。: Correlate with contractions and clinical findings.
肌电干扰为高频、不规则细碎波，可掩盖 P 波或模拟房颤；寒战、紧张、甲亢、帕金森: EMG interference consists of high-frequency, irregular fine waves that can obscure P waves or mimic atrial fibrillation; it is common in patients with shivering, anxiety, hyperthyroidism, or Parkinson's disease.
脓毒症患者的心电图是“灌注的镜子”；先复苏，再解释波形。: In patients with sepsis, the ECG is a "mirror of perfusion"; resuscitate first, then interpret the waveforms.
药物过量、甲状腺功能减退、电解质紊乱等按病因处理；病态窦房结综合征反复症状者考虑: Treat drug overdose, hypothyroidism, electrolyte disturbances, etc. according to the cause; consider a pacemaker for recurrent symptoms in sick sinus syndrome.
规则、窄 QRS、频率 150–250 次\/分，P′ 波形态异常且与窦性 P: Regular, narrow QRS, rate 150–250 beats/min, abnormal P′ wave morphology different from sinus P waves; often 1:1 or 2:1 AV conduction.
起搏钉规律、与 QRS 关系固定；过感知时起搏钉消失\/心率慢；程控可确认。: Pacing spikes are regular and have a fixed relationship with QRS; with oversensing, pacing spikes disappear/slow heart rate; confirmed by programming.
运动试验阳性标准: Positive criteria for exercise stress test
透析患者“透析后心悸\/晕厥”，查钾钙镁与 ECG，别只当容量问题。: In dialysis patients with "post-dialysis palpitations/syncope," check potassium, calcium, magnesium, and ECG; do not treat it merely as a volume problem.
部分 SIDS 与长 QT、离子通道病相关；新生儿 ECG 筛查仍有争议，但家族: Some SIDS cases are associated with long QT and channelopathies; neonatal ECG screening remains controversial, but infants with family history/syncope need evaluation.
间歇长度不是判断严重程度的唯一标准，症状与逸搏是否出现同样关键。: Pause length is not the only criterion for severity; symptoms and whether escape beats occur are equally key.
隐匿表现：P 埋在前一 T 波上，T 波变尖、出现切迹或不对称。: Concealed presentation: P wave buried in the preceding T wave, with T wave peaking, notching, or asymmetry.
频率 >100–110 次\/分且持续存在时考虑室速；频率 <50 次\/分为室: Consider VT when rate >100–110 bpm and persistent; rate <50 bpm is a ventricular escape rhythm.
高密度图很漂亮，但靶点要靠拖带与起搏确认；图不等于成功。: High-density maps are beautiful, but target sites must be confirmed by entrainment and pacing; a map does not equal success.
3 相钾外流增加，细胞复极，形成 T 波。复极顺序从心外膜向心内膜，与除极方向相: Phase 3 increased potassium efflux repolarizes the cell, forming the T wave. Repolarization proceeds from epicardium to endocardium, opposite to the depolarization direction, so the T wave is usually concordant with the main QRS deflection.
AI 是工具，不是替代。: AI is a tool, not a replacement.
II 导联 P 波宽度 ≥0.12 s、双峰间距 ≥0.04 s；V1 P 波终: In lead II, P wave width ≥0.12 s and inter-peak distance ≥0.04 s; in V1, terminal negative portion of P wave ≥0.04 s × 0.1 mV (P wave terminal force).
PR 延长先想房室结；QRS 增宽先想束支\/浦肯野或心室肌起源。: For PR prolongation, think AV node first; for QRS widening, think bundle branch/Purkinje or ventricular myocardial origin first.
QRS 多窄；伴差异性传导或原有束支阻滞时可宽。: QRS is usually narrow; it may be wide with aberrant conduction or preexisting bundle branch block.
QT 一定要校正心率；看到 U 波先分清 T 与 U。: QT must be corrected for heart rate; when a U wave is seen, first distinguish T from U.
RR 变异伴随长间歇 >2.5–3 s、晕厥或黑矇。: RR variability accompanied by long pauses >2.5–3 s, syncope, or amaurosis.
SIDS 是排除性诊断；不能把所有婴儿猝死都归为长 QT。: SIDS is a diagnosis of exclusion; not all sudden infant deaths should be attributed to long QT.
T 波高尖、对称、基底窄，常见于 V2–V4；血钾 5.5–6.5 mmol\/: Tall, peaked, symmetric T waves with a narrow base, commonly in V2–V4; most typical when serum potassium is 5.5–6.5 mmol/L.
V1–V3 ST↓ 2 mm（后壁镜像）: V1–V3 ST↓ 2 mm (reciprocal to posterior wall)
VVI：心室起搏、心室感知、抑制。: VVI: ventricular pacing, ventricular sensing, inhibition.
三导联监护常选择 II、V1 与改良 V5；II 导联对 P 波和节律友好，V1: For 3-lead monitoring, leads II, V1, and modified V5 are commonly selected; lead II is favorable for P waves and rhythm, and V1 is helpful for supraventricular tachycardia and PVC morphology.
不同设备 ST 不一致。: ST measurements are inconsistent across different devices.
与二度房室阻滞的区别：房早的 P 波提前且形态异常。: Distinction from second-degree AV block: in atrial premature beats, the P wave is premature and abnormal in morphology.
交感神经提高窦房结自律性并缩短房室结传导时间，迷走神经则相反；因此频率与 PR: Sympathetic nerves increase sinoatrial node automaticity and shorten AV node conduction time, while the vagus nerve does the opposite; therefore, heart rate and PR interval change dynamically with respiration, exercise, and emotion.
伪差常见，需复核。: Artifacts are common and require review.
体表心电图记录的是大量心肌细胞电活动在体表的电位差：除极波朝向电极产生正向波，背: A surface ECG records the potential difference at the body surface produced by the electrical activity of many myocardial cells: a depolarization wave moving toward an electrode produces a positive wave, and moving away produces a negative wave; repolarization has the opposite direction.
偶发未下传房早多见于健康人，尤其夜间或迷走张力高时，本身不需要特殊治疗。频发、成: Occasional nonconducted atrial premature beats are common in healthy individuals, especially at night or when vagal tone is high, and do not require specific treatment. When frequent, paired, or accompanied by significant symptoms, triggers should be sought: caffeine, alcohol, sleep deprivation, infection, anemia, hyperthyroidism, electrolyte disturbances, and drugs.
动作电位时程（与 QT 间期相关）受心率、血钾\/血钙和药物影响：高钾使 T 波: Action potential duration (related to the QT interval) is affected by heart rate, serum potassium/calcium, and drugs: hyperkalemia causes tall peaked T waves and QRS widening; hypokalemia causes U waves and QT prolongation; drugs that affect repolarization alter T-wave morphology and QT.
危急值包括 STEMI、无脉 VT\/VF、三度 AVB 伴长间歇、TdP、严重: Critical values include STEMI, pulseless VT/VF, third-degree AVB with long pauses, TdP, sine wave from severe hyperkalemia, very rapid atrial fibrillation with pre-excitation, long QT + syncope, etc.
可伴 AVRT 发作（窄 QRS 或宽 QRS 逆向型）。: May be accompanied by AVRT episodes (narrow QRS or wide QRS antidromic type).
右房增大：下壁导联 P 高尖 ≥2.5 mm。: Right atrial enlargement: tall peaked P waves ≥2.5 mm in inferior leads.
后壁位于心脏后方，标准 12 导联没有直接面向它的电极。后壁损伤向量背离 V1–: The posterior wall lies behind the heart, and no electrode in the standard 12-lead ECG directly faces it. The posterior wall injury vector points away from V1–V3, so these three leads show ST depression, increased R-wave amplitude, and upright T waves; this triad is more specific than ST depression alone.
基础窦性心律，约 64 次\/分，记录中段 P 波消失 2.6 s，间歇与 PP: Baseline sinus rhythm at about 64 beats/min; in the middle of the recording, P waves disappear for 2.6 s, and the pause is not a multiple of the PP interval, consistent with sinus arrest.
大面积肺栓塞、右心功能不全或心脏骤停。: Massive pulmonary embolism, right ventricular dysfunction, or cardiac arrest.
家族筛查与避免 QT 延长药物。: Family screening and avoidance of QT-prolonging drugs.
对关键间期用多个导联、多个搏动复核。: Recheck key intervals using multiple leads and multiple beats.
左右臂反接时 I 导联 P\/QRS\/T 全部倒置，aVR 与 aVL 互换；: When the right and left arm leads are reversed, P/QRS/T in lead I are all inverted, and aVR and aVL are swapped; right arm/left leg reversal may cause II and III to be swapped.
干扰性房室分离不是三度 AVB；三度 AVB 通常心房率 > 心室率，且有传导系: Interferential AV dissociation is not third-degree AVB; third-degree AVB usually has an atrial rate > ventricular rate and conduction system disease.
心内电图定位最早激动点。: Intracardiac electrograms localize the earliest activation site.
心房多个异位灶竞争，常与心房牵张、缺氧、低钾\/低镁、茶碱有关。: Multiple competing atrial ectopic foci, often associated with atrial stretch, hypoxia, hypokalemia/hypomagnesemia, and theophylline.
急性下壁 ST 段抬高型心肌梗死多由右冠状动脉或回旋支急性闭塞引起，心电图上 I: Acute inferior ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction is mostly caused by acute occlusion of the right coronary artery or circumflex artery. On ECG, ST-segment elevation is seen in adjacent leads II, III, and aVF, often with reciprocal depression in I and aVL, and may be complicated by right ventricular infarction and AV block. Early risk in inferior MI is closely related to right ventricular involvement, hypotension, and bradyarrhythmias.
房室结、希氏束或双侧束支的传导完全中断，心房冲动不能到达心室。: Complete interruption of conduction in the AV node, His bundle, or bilateral bundle branches, so atrial impulses cannot reach the ventricles.
房颤终止后出现 >3 s 长间歇、晕厥；平时窦缓；动态心电图可捕捉交替。: After termination of atrial fibrillation, a >3 s long pause and syncope occur; usual sinus bradycardia; Holter monitoring can capture the alternation.
把无脉性 VT 当有脉心动过速做同步复律，延误除颤。: Treating pulseless VT as tachycardia with a pulse and performing synchronized cardioversion, delaying defibrillation.
持续可致心衰；急性处理迷走\/腺苷。: Persistent cases can cause heart failure; acute management with vagal maneuvers/adenosine.
有症状低钙静脉补钙，先保心肌与神经肌肉稳定。: For symptomatic hypocalcemia, intravenous calcium supplementation, first ensuring myocardial and neuromuscular stability.
术前 ECG 的价值取决于是否能改变围术期管理；异常需结合症状、病史与进一步检查: The value of preoperative ECG depends on whether it can change perioperative management; abnormalities need to be interpreted with symptoms, history, and further testing.
检查侧壁导联有无 q 波；出现 q 波需怀疑 LBBB 诊断或合并梗死。: Check lateral leads for q waves; if q waves appear, suspect LBBB diagnosis or concomitant infarction.
治疗原发病：甲旁减、肾病、胰腺炎、输血相关枸橼酸中毒。: Treat the underlying disease: hypoparathyroidism, kidney disease, pancreatitis, transfusion-related citrate toxicity.
浦肯野纤维从心内膜向心室肌呈放射状分布，使左、右心室几乎同时除极。浦肯野传导受损: Purkinje fibers are distributed radially from the endocardium to the ventricular myocardium, causing the left and right ventricles to depolarize almost simultaneously. Impaired Purkinje conduction produces intraventricular conduction delay, with QRS widening but possibly atypical morphology.
甲状腺功能减退、低体温、颅内压增高、下壁心肌缺血也可通过神经或代谢机制抑制窦房结: Hypothyroidism, hypothermia, elevated intracranial pressure, and inferior myocardial ischemia can also suppress the sinus node through neural or metabolic mechanisms.
病变常为传导系统退行性变（Lenègre-Lev 病）、缺血、心肌炎或心脏术后，: The lesion is often degenerative disease of the conduction system (Lenègre-Lev disease), ischemia, myocarditis, or post-cardiac surgery, and may progress to third-degree block.
磁铁是“临时开关”，不是“修复起搏器”；用完必须程控。: A magnet is a “temporary switch,” not a “pacemaker repair”; after use, it must be reprogrammed.
窦性心动过速，约 112 次\/分，I 导联深 S、III 导联 Q 波与 T: Sinus tachycardia at approximately 112 beats/min, with a deep S wave in lead I, Q wave and T-wave inversion in lead III, and right heart strain changes in V1, consistent with the S1Q3T3 pattern.
窦房结频率最高，通过“超速抑制”压制下级起搏点。窦房结频率下降、房室传导中断或窦: The sinus node has the highest rate and suppresses lower pacemakers through “overdrive suppression.” Only when the sinus node rate decreases, AV conduction is interrupted, or sinus arrest occurs do lower pacemakers have a chance to manifest.
脓毒症 ECG：窦速、房颤、ST-T 改变。: Sepsis ECG: sinus tachycardia, atrial fibrillation, ST-T changes.
血钙 >3.5 mmol\/L 或出现意识改变、脱水、少尿。: Serum calcium >3.5 mmol/L or presence of altered consciousness, dehydration, or oliguria.
让患者放松、保暖、重新贴电极通常可改善；不要因“波形乱”直接诊断房颤。: Having the patient relax, keeping them warm, and reapplying the electrodes usually improves it; do not diagnose atrial fibrillation solely because the “waveform is messy.”
起搏器患者房颤时心室率突然变慢\/变规则，可能是模式转换，不一定是新发传导阻滞。: In a pacemaker patient with atrial fibrillation, a sudden slowing/regularization of the ventricular rate may be mode switching and not necessarily new-onset conduction block.
运动试验阳性通常指运动中或运动后出现 ≥0.1 mV 水平\/下斜型 ST 压低: A positive exercise test usually means ≥0.1 mV horizontal/downsloping ST depression, typical chest pain, a decrease in blood pressure, or serious arrhythmia during or after exercise.
逐条应用 Brugada 四步法，记录每一步。: Apply the four-step Brugada method step by step and document each step.
钉 + P\/QRS=夺获；只有钉=失夺获。: Spike + P/QRS = capture; spike alone = failure to capture.
间歇长度通常 >2.0 s（部分标准 >3.0 s）；窦性停搏的间歇与基础 PP: The pause duration is usually >2.0 s (some criteria >3.0 s); the pause in sinus arrest has no integer-multiple relationship with the underlying PP interval.
高电压≠LVH；低电压≠没有 LVH。: High voltage ≠ LVH; low voltage ≠ absence of LVH.
高钾危重：静脉钙剂稳定心肌 → 胰岛素+葡萄糖\/β₂ 激动剂 → 排钾\/透析: Severe hyperkalemia: intravenous calcium to stabilize the myocardium → insulin + glucose/β₂ agonists → potassium removal/dialysis.
70 岁男性，体检发现房颤，无心悸；CHA₂DS₂-VASc 3 分，HAS-B: A 70-year-old man with atrial fibrillation found on physical examination, no palpitations; CHA₂DS₂-VASc score 3, HAS-BLED score 1.
I 负向、aVF 正向：电轴右偏；结合右室肥厚、左后分支阻滞等。: Negative in I, positive in aVF: right axis deviation; consider right ventricular hypertrophy, left posterior fascicular block, etc.
PR 间期延长、P 波振幅降低甚至消失，提示 6.5–7.5 mmol\/L。: PR interval prolongation, decreased or even absent P-wave amplitude, suggesting 6.5–7.5 mmol/L.
QRS 多窄；伴束支阻滞、差异性传导或预激时可宽。: QRS is usually narrow; it can be wide with bundle branch block, aberrant conduction, or pre-excitation.
QT 延长\/T 倒置需复查。: QT prolongation/T-wave inversion requires repeat ECG.
ST 压低看三点：形态（水平或下斜）、幅度（≥1 mm）、分布（相邻或广泛）。: For ST depression, assess three points: morphology (horizontal or downsloping), amplitude (≥1 mm), and distribution (contiguous or widespread).
aVR P 波倒置、I\/II P 直立是位置正确的重要线索。: Inverted P wave in aVR and upright P wave in I/II are important clues to correct lead placement.
三度阻滞 P 与 QRS 完全分离；二度 II 型仍有固定 PR 的下传搏动。: Third-degree block: complete AV dissociation between P waves and QRS; second-degree type II still has conducted beats with a fixed PR.
严重 QT 延长者监测室性心律失常。: Monitor for ventricular arrhythmias in severe QT prolongation.
二度 I 型：PR 渐长→脱落，成组搏动。: Second-degree type I: progressive PR lengthening → dropped beat, group beating.
代偿间歇多不完全，即提前搏动前后两个窦性 P 波之间的距离小于两倍基础 PP 间: The compensatory pause is often incomplete, i.e., the distance between the two sinus P waves before and after the premature beat is less than twice the basic PP interval.
低血压或右心衰表现时加做 V3R–V4R，评估右室梗死。: Add V3R–V4R when hypotension or right heart failure signs are present to assess right ventricular infarction.
低钾：补钾并纠镁；严重者静脉补钾并监护。: Hypokalemia: replace potassium and correct magnesium; in severe cases, intravenous potassium with monitoring.
偶发无需治疗；频发时寻找诱因并评估房速\/房颤风险。: Occasional episodes require no treatment; for frequent episodes, identify triggers and assess the risk of atrial tachycardia/atrial fibrillation.
先找 P 波：II 导联直立、aVR 倒置支持窦性起源。: First look for P waves: upright in lead II and inverted in aVR supports sinus origin.
分度：看 PR 与脱落规律: Grading: assess PR and dropped-beat pattern
单形性 VT 形态固定，QT 通常不延长。: Monomorphic VT has a fixed morphology, and QT is usually not prolonged.
反复发作或药物无效者转诊心内科，评估导管消融。: For recurrent episodes or those unresponsive to medication, refer to cardiology for evaluation for catheter ablation.
可伴晕厥；记录显示噪声。: May be accompanied by syncope; the recording shows noise.
右胸导联镜像性 ST 抬高。: Reciprocal ST elevation in right precordial leads.
图形不符合解剖时重做。: Repeat if the pattern does not fit the anatomy.
夜间猝死家族史 + 长 QT，要想到 LQT3；诱因是睡眠，不是运动。: Family history of nocturnal sudden death + long QT should raise suspicion of LQT3; the trigger is sleep, not exercise.
室性心律失常发作按 ACLS 处理；奎尼丁等药物可用于特定患者。: Manage episodes of ventricular arrhythmia according to ACLS; drugs such as quinidine may be used in selected patients.
宽 QRS 心动过速指 QRS ≥0.12 s、频率 >100 次\/分的心动过: Wide QRS tachycardia refers to tachycardia with QRS ≥0.12 s and rate >100 beats/min, mainly including ventricular tachycardia, supraventricular tachycardia with aberrant conduction/bundle branch block, and pre-excited tachycardia.
寻找窦性 P 波：若 P 频率高于 QRS 且无固定关系，为三度阻滞伴室性逸搏。: Look for sinus P waves: if the P rate is higher than the QRS rate and there is no fixed relationship, it is third-degree block with a ventricular escape beat.
左室肥厚可有电轴左偏与侧壁高 R，但伴电压增高与劳损型 ST-T 改变。: Left ventricular hypertrophy may have left axis deviation and tall lateral R waves, but is accompanied by increased voltage and strain-type ST-T changes.
常见于心肌缺血、心肌病、心力衰竭、洋地黄中毒、低钾血症；也可见于健康人。: Commonly seen in myocardial ischemia, cardiomyopathy, heart failure, digitalis toxicity, and hypokalemia; it can also be seen in healthy individuals.
心室率 150 左右时，先找 F 波或 P′，不要默认窦速。: When the ventricular rate is around 150, first look for F waves or P′ waves; do not assume sinus tachycardia by default.
心电向量图（VCG）可用于束支阻滞、预激、心室肥厚的辅助分析，但对操作与设备要求: Vectorcardiography (VCG) can be used as an adjunct in analyzing bundle branch block, pre-excitation, and ventricular hypertrophy, but it has high requirements for operator skill and equipment.
心脏性晕厥可能由短暂心律失常导致，静息心电图可正常；需要动态监测\/电生理评估。: Cardiac syncope may be caused by transient arrhythmias, and the resting ECG can be normal; ambulatory monitoring/electrophysiologic evaluation is needed.
总钙受白蛋白影响，需校正或测离子钙。: Total calcium is affected by albumin and must be corrected or ionized calcium measured.

抗凝：按 CHA₂DS₂-VASc 评估，男性 ≥2、女性 ≥3 通常推荐口服抗: Anticoagulation: assess by CHA₂DS₂-VASc; oral anticoagulation is generally recommended for men ≥2 and women ≥3; paroxysmal atrial fibrillation should be assessed similarly.
按年龄解释，动态随访。: Interpret according to age and follow up dynamically.
无症状：观察，纠正可逆因素，避免不必要的减慢心率药物。: Asymptomatic: observe, correct reversible factors, and avoid unnecessary heart-rate-lowering drugs.
晕厥、抽搐、低血压、意识障碍，提示阿-斯综合征。: Syncope, convulsions, hypotension, impaired consciousness suggest Adams-Stokes syndrome.
未下传房早为提前的 P′ 后无 QRS，无 PR 渐长与周期性重置。: A non-conducted premature atrial contraction is an early P′ not followed by a QRS, without progressive PR lengthening or periodic resetting.
检查电解质（钾、镁、钙）与用药史。: Check electrolytes (potassium, magnesium, calcium) and medication history.
正常时窦房结频率最高，抑制下游起搏点；当窦房结频率下降或传导中断，房室交界区（4: Normally, the sinus node has the highest rate and suppresses downstream pacemakers; when the sinus node rate decreases or conduction is interrupted, the AV junction (40–60 beats/min) or ventricles (20–40 beats/min) can take over, forming an escape rhythm.
测量误差常来自基线、低振幅、T 波终点不清与心率变异；临床决策应留出测量误差的余: Measurement error often arises from baseline, low amplitude, unclear T-wave endpoint, and heart rate variability; clinical decisions should allow for measurement error.
电击后短暂平直常见。: Transient flat line after defibrillation is common.
确认无反应、无正常呼吸、无脉搏，启动急救系统。: Confirm unresponsiveness, no normal breathing, and no pulse, and activate the emergency response system.
窦性心律，心率约 92 次\/分，V1–V4 ST 段弓背向上抬高 2–4 mm: Sinus rhythm, heart rate about 92 beats/min, ST-segment elevation with upward convexity of 2–4 mm in V1–V4, tall peaked T waves, and 1 mm reciprocal depression in II, III, and aVF.
结合乳酸、灌注与超声。: Combine with lactate, perfusion, and ultrasound.
若为颅内压增高、洋地黄中毒等引起，处理原发病。: If caused by increased intracranial pressure, digitalis toxicity, etc., treat the underlying disease.
解释监护与诊断 12 导联的差别: Explain the difference between monitoring and diagnostic 12-lead ECGs.
询问晕厥、心悸、家族史，评估风险。: Ask about syncope, palpitations, and family history, and assess risk.
适应证：胸痛评估、已知冠心病风险分层、运动性心律失常；禁忌：急性 ACS、严重主: Indications: evaluation of chest pain, risk stratification in known coronary artery disease, exercise-induced arrhythmias; contraindications: acute ACS, severe aortic stenosis, uncontrolled heart failure/hypertension.
钙剂稳定心肌，不降钾。: Calcium stabilizes the myocardium and does not lower potassium.
需与其他缓慢心律鉴别：交界性心律无直立 P 或 P 在 QRS 后；二度以上房室: Must be differentiated from other slow rhythms: junctional rhythm has no upright P waves or P waves after the QRS; second-degree or higher AV block has dropped P waves.
静息 ST-T 异常、LBBB、起搏、WPW 会使运动心电图判读困难；需改用影像: Resting ST-T abnormalities, LBBB, pacing, and WPW make exercise ECG interpretation difficult; switch to imaging stress testing.
额面向量环投影到 I、II、III 等肢体导联；水平面向量环投影到 V1–V6: The frontal plane vector loop projects onto limb leads I, II, III, etc.; the horizontal plane vector loop projects onto chest leads V1–V6.
高钾伴肾功能不全：静脉钙剂稳定心肌，胰岛素+葡萄糖、β2、透析降钾；监测血糖与反: Hyperkalemia with renal insufficiency: IV calcium to stabilize the myocardium; insulin plus glucose, β2, and dialysis to lower potassium; monitor blood glucose and rebound.
48 岁女性，长途飞行后突发呼吸困难；窦速、S1Q3T3、V1–V4 T 倒置，: 48-year-old woman with sudden dyspnea after a long-haul flight; sinus tachycardia, S1Q3T3, T inversion in V1–V4, elevated D-dimer.
COPD 急性加重→窦速\/房颤\/右心负荷。: Acute exacerbation of COPD → sinus tachycardia/atrial fibrillation/right heart strain.
Holter 上“ST 压低”先看是不是体位\/基线；动态与症状关联才是关键。: On Holter, first check whether “ST depression” is due to position/baseline; the key is the association between dynamic changes and symptoms.
LBBB 不只是“QRS 宽”；在合适的心衰患者中，它可能是 CRT 的指征。: LBBB is not just “wide QRS”; in appropriate heart failure patients, it may be an indication for CRT.
P=心房除极，QRS=心室除极，T=心室复极。: P = atrial depolarization, QRS = ventricular depolarization, T = ventricular repolarization.
QRS 形态介于窦性与室性之间。: QRS morphology is intermediate between sinus and ventricular.
RBBB：V1 rsR′、V6 宽 S；LBBB：V1 QS\/rS、V6 宽: RBBB: V1 rsR′, wide S in V6; LBBB: V1 QS/rS, wide R in V6 without q.
STEMI 的导联定位基于心室壁与导联的空间关系；相邻导联 ST 抬高提示对应区: Lead localization in STEMI is based on the spatial relationship between ventricular walls and leads; ST elevation in adjacent leads suggests transmural ischemia in the corresponding region and can provide a preliminary inference of the culprit vessel and affected myocardium.
TdP：QT 长 + 多形性宽 QRS。: TdP: long QT + polymorphic wide QRS.
V5\/V6 高 R 与 V1\/V2 深 S，ST 抬高多不成比例且无动态演变: Tall R in V5/V6 and deep S in V1/V2; ST elevation is often disproportionate and without dynamic evolution.
下壁导联 II、III、aVF 至少两个相邻导联 ST 抬高。: In inferior leads II, III, and aVF, ST elevation in at least two adjacent leads.
两者不一致时结合临床与影像。: When the two are inconsistent, correlate with clinical findings and imaging.
亚急性期（数天至数周）：ST 段逐渐回落，T 波深倒置，Q 波持续存在；部分患者: Subacute phase (days to weeks): the ST segment gradually resolves, T waves become deeply inverted, and Q waves persist; in some patients, Q waves may become shallower or even disappear. This phase must be differentiated from ischemic T-wave changes such as Wellens.
低血压先找可逆心律失常\/缺血\/梗阻。: For hypotension, first look for reversible arrhythmia/ischemia/obstruction.
先分脉搏，再分同步；无脉 VF\/pVT 一律非同步。: First distinguish pulse, then synchrony; pulseless VF/pVT is always unsynchronized.
具体药物与剂量需由临床医生结合患者情况决定，本页仅作教学。: Specific drugs and doses must be determined by clinicians based on the patient's condition; this page is for teaching only.
前壁梗死多由前降支引起。aVR ST 抬高伴广泛导联 ST 压低、V1 抬高，提: Anterior infarction is mostly caused by the left anterior descending artery. ST elevation in aVR with widespread ST depression and V1 elevation suggests left main or proximal LAD disease; elevation in V2–V4 without aVR elevation is more consistent with mid-to-distal LAD. Posterior and right ventricular infarction often share the same origin as inferior infarction, and additional V7–V9 and V4R leads should be obtained.
发热 + V1 穹隆型 ST + T 倒置。: Fever + coved-type ST in V1 + T-wave inversion.
可伴房性\/室性期前收缩、室上速、室速或尖端扭转型室速。: May be accompanied by premature atrial/ventricular contractions, supraventricular tachycardia, ventricular tachycardia, or torsades de pointes.
右室梗死三联：低血压、肺清、颈静脉压高。: Triad of right ventricular infarction: hypotension, clear lungs, elevated jugular venous pressure.
右束支阻滞使右室最后除极，V1 出现 rsR′；左束支阻滞使左室最后除极，V6: Right bundle branch block causes the right ventricle to depolarize last, producing rsR′ in V1; left bundle branch block causes the left ventricle to depolarize last, producing a broad slurred R wave in V6 and QS/rS in V1.
基因结果需结合表型、家族史与变异解读；意义未明变异不能单独诊断。: Genetic results must be interpreted together with phenotype, family history, and variant interpretation; a variant of uncertain significance cannot establish a diagnosis alone.
多支病变、左主干病变可表现为广泛 ST 压低伴 aVR 抬高。: Multivessel disease and left main disease may present as widespread ST depression with aVR elevation.
女性 ACS 可无典型胸痛；心电图动态改变 + 肌钙蛋白 → NSTEMI\/不: Women with ACS may lack typical chest pain; dynamic ECG changes + troponin → evaluate for NSTEMI/unstable angina.
家族猝死史需评估。: Family history of sudden death should be assessed.
寒战产生持续高频肌电噪声，常见于术后、发热\/降温、输血反应；可掩盖 P 波与: Shivering produces continuous high-frequency electromyographic noise, commonly seen after surgery, with fever/cooling, and in transfusion reactions; it can obscure P waves and the ST segment.
左束支主干阻滞后，左心室失去快速同步激动；冲动经右束支先到右心室，再跨室间隔自右: After main left bundle branch block, the left ventricle loses rapid synchronous activation; the impulse travels via the right bundle branch to the right ventricle first, then crosses the interventricular septum from right to left.
年轻卒中查房颤。: In young stroke, look for atrial fibrillation.
心动过缓用阿托品，高度阻滞且不稳定时临时起搏。: Bradycardia is treated with atropine; temporary pacing is used for high-grade block when unstable.
心房血流淤滞增加血栓栓塞风险，卒中风险与年龄、心衰、高血压、糖尿病、卒中史等相关: Atrial blood stasis increases thromboembolic risk; stroke risk is associated with age, heart failure, hypertension, diabetes, history of stroke, etc.
心肌动作电位与离子通道: Myocardial action potential and ion channels
急性前壁心肌梗死、心肌炎或心脏术后新发二度 II 型。: New-onset second-degree type II block in acute anterior myocardial infarction, myocarditis, or after cardiac surgery.
感知不足指起搏器未识别自身 P\/QRS，导致在自身搏动后仍发放起搏钉，可能落在: Undersensing means the pacemaker fails to recognize intrinsic P/QRS, causing it to deliver pacing spikes after intrinsic beats, which may fall in the refractory period or trigger competition.
房室阻滞的定位与处理边界: Localization and management boundaries of AV block
房早前有 P′，QRS 多窄，代偿间歇多不完全。: Premature atrial complexes are preceded by a P′ wave, the QRS is usually narrow, and the compensatory pause is often incomplete.
房颤常与呼吸事件相关。: Atrial fibrillation is often associated with respiratory events.
把 S1Q3T3 当作肺栓塞的特异性标志；其敏感性\/特异性均有限。: Using S1Q3T3 as a specific marker of pulmonary embolism; its sensitivity/specificity are both limited.
把运动员或睡眠中的迷走性 PR 延长过度治疗。: Over-treating vagal PR prolongation in athletes or during sleep.
新生儿 QRS 较窄、PR 较短；QTc 随年龄略有变化；不能直接套成人阈值。: In neonates, QRS is narrower and PR is shorter; QTc varies slightly with age; adult thresholds cannot be directly applied.
无脉性 VT：按 VF 处理，非同步除颤 + CPR。: Pulseless VT: manage as VF, unsynchronized defibrillation + CPR.
最具特异性的是“P′ 波形态与窦性 P 不同 + 心房率 150–250 次\/: The most specific finding is “P′ wave morphology differs from sinus P + atrial rate 150–250 beats/min + narrow QRS”; the polarity of P′ in II, III, and aVF may suggest the site of origin, but localization requires electrophysiologic study.
有症状：阿托品 1 mg 静脉注射，每 3–5 分钟可重复（总量 3 mg）；无: If symptomatic: atropine 1 mg IV, may repeat every 3–5 minutes (total 3 mg); if ineffective, transcutaneous pacing or epinephrine infusion at 2–10 μg/min.
正常窦性心律本身无需治疗。: Normal sinus rhythm itself requires no treatment.
测量 PR、P 波振幅与 QRS 时限，判断严重程度。: Measure PR interval, P-wave amplitude, and QRS duration to assess severity.
理解额面电轴与胸导联投影: Understand frontal plane axis and precordial lead projection
电轴必须结合 QRS 形态与临床，且先排除导联错接。: Axis must be interpreted together with QRS morphology and clinical context, and lead misconnection must be excluded first.
相邻两个导联水平型或下斜型 ST 压低 ≥1 mm（0.1 mV）；上斜型压低特: Horizontal or downsloping ST depression ≥1 mm (0.1 mV) in two adjacent leads; upsloping depression is less specific.
窦性心律，心率约 62 次\/分，QT 间期约 0.58 s，T 波双相，QTc: Sinus rhythm, heart rate about 62 beats/min, QT interval about 0.58 s, biphasic T waves, markedly prolonged QTc, indicating risk of torsades de pointes.
结合地高辛剂量、肾功能、钾镁水平与症状。: Consider digoxin dose, renal function, potassium and magnesium levels, and symptoms.
胸痛 + 下壁 ST 抬高 + 低血压 + 肺清：先想右室梗死，慎用硝酸酯。: Chest pain + inferior ST elevation + hypotension + clear lungs: first consider right ventricular infarction; use nitrates with caution.
观察 QRS 宽度及脱漏前最长 PR。: Observe QRS width and the longest PR before the dropped beat.
评估患者有无脉搏、血压与意识，决定处理路径。: Assess for pulse, blood pressure, and consciousness to determine the management pathway.
起搏器记录可确认模式。: Pacemaker records can confirm the mode.
运动试验不是“跑步机体检”；先问禁忌证，再看 ST 改变与症状。: An exercise test is not a 'treadmill physical'; first ask about contraindications, then look at ST changes and symptoms.
部分 P 无 QRS。: Some P waves have no QRS.
长 QT 的判断依赖正确的 QT\/QTc 测量。: Assessment of long QT depends on correct QT/QTc measurement.
需与加速性室性自主心律（50–110 次\/分）、室速（>100 次\/分）和高: Differentiate from accelerated idioventricular rhythm (50–110 beats/min), ventricular tachycardia (>100 beats/min), and hyperkalemic sine wave.
频率 60–100 次\/分应称为加速性交界性心律，超过 100 次\/分为交界: A rate of 60–100 beats/min should be called accelerated junctional rhythm; over 100 beats/min is junctional tachycardia; a rate <40 beats/min or widened QRS requires considering a lower pacemaker focus.
高密度图不是“自动答案”；瘢痕、接触与噪声可造成假低电压区。: High-density maps are not an 'automatic answer'; scar, contact, and noise can create false low-voltage areas.
高钾的完整课程与处理。: Complete course and management of hyperkalemia.
看到 QT 很短不要只写“正常”；结合 T 波形态、晕厥与家族史。: When you see a very short QT, do not just write 'normal'; correlate with T-wave morphology, syncope, and family history.

《交界性逸搏心律》属于“逸搏与缓慢性心律”板块。: 'Junctional Escape Rhythm' belongs to the 'Escape Rhythms and Bradyarrhythmias' section.
《先天性心脏病心电图》学习目标：先心病 ECG 反映血流动力学。: Learning objective for 'ECG in Congenital Heart Disease': ECG in congenital heart disease reflects hemodynamics.
《反复搏动与回波》学习目标：反复搏动=折返回波。: Learning objective for 'Reciprocal Beats and Echoes': reciprocal beat = reentrant echo beat.
《完全性右束支传导阻滞》的最具特异性的线索：V1 的 R′ 峰时间 >50 ms: Most specific clues of Complete Right Bundle Branch Block: R′ peak time in V1 >50 ms, R′ wider than the initial r, and S-wave duration in I and V6 >40 ms or wider than the R wave in the same lead; this combination distinguishes true RBBB from normal variant and ventricular rhythm.
《室性逸搏心律》与《三度房室传导阻滞》的鉴别点：三度阻滞有规律的窦性 P 与 Q: Differentiation between Ventricular Escape Rhythm and Third-Degree Atrioventricular Block: third-degree block has regular sinus P waves dissociated from QRS; ventricular escape rhythm is passive ventricular replacement, and P waves may be absent.
《心室颤动》的一句话描述：心室电活动完全紊乱，无可辨 QRS；患者无脉，立即 C: One-sentence description of Ventricular Fibrillation: completely chaotic ventricular electrical activity with no identifiable QRS; the patient is pulseless, start CPR + asynchronous defibrillation immediately.
《心电图学的未来路线》关键点：未来=AI + 可穿戴 + 远程 + 遗传。: Key points of The Future Roadmap of Electrocardiography: future = AI + wearables + remote + genetics.
《心电轴快速判断》的一句话描述：看 I 与 II 导联 QRS 主波：都向上为正: One-sentence description of Rapid ECG Axis Determination: look at the main QRS deflection in leads I and II: both upward = normal; I upward and II downward = left axis deviation; I downward = right axis deviation.

《房性心动过速》关键数值：150–250次\/分（心房率）: Key value of Atrial Tachycardia: 150–250 beats/min (atrial rate)
《新生儿心电图》学习目标：新生儿右室优势正常。: Learning objective of Neonatal ECG: right ventricular dominance is normal in neonates.
《游走性心房起搏点》的最具特异性的线索：同一导联 P 波形态 ≥3 种、PP 间: Most specific clues of Wandering Atrial Pacemaker: P-wave morphology in the same lead ≥3 types, unequal PP intervals, and rate not fast; QRS is mostly narrow.
《窦性心动过速》的最具特异性的线索：最具特异性的是“窦性 P 波 + 1:1 房: Most specific clues of Sinus Tachycardia: the most specific is “sinus P waves + 1:1 atrioventricular conduction + heart rate >100 beats/min”; normal P-wave morphology and relatively gradual onset/termination help differentiate from reentrant tachycardia.

《起搏器介导性心动过速》关键点：PMT：起搏钉 + 宽 QRS 心动过速。: Key point of Pacemaker-Mediated Tachycardia: PMT: pacing spikes + wide-QRS tachycardia.
《运动伪差》的最具特异性的线索：伪差与运动同步、多导联不规则；停止运动后恢复；患: Most specific clues of Motion Artifact: artifact synchronous with movement and irregular across multiple leads; resolves after stopping movement; patient consciousness/pulse inconsistent with the waveform.
《阵发性室上性心动过速》易错点：把窦性心动过速误认为 PSVT：窦速有 P 波且: Common pitfall of Paroxysmal Supraventricular Tachycardia: mistaking sinus tachycardia for PSVT: sinus tachycardia has P waves and gradual onset/termination.
《高钾血症》易错点：把高尖 T 波只归因于高钾而忽略早期复极、缺血或正常变异。: Common pitfall of Hyperkalemia: attributing peaked T waves only to hyperkalemia and ignoring early repolarization, ischemia, or normal variant.

右心负荷→RBBB、右胸 T 倒置。: Right heart strain → RBBB, T-wave inversion in right precordial leads.
同样有窦性 P 波，但频率 >100 次\/分。: Sinus P waves are also present, but the rate is >100 beats/min.
地高辛中毒：房速伴阻滞、室早。: Digoxin toxicity: atrial tachycardia with block, ventricular premature beats.
定标错误或纸速不明时，不应直接据此判断间期是否异常。: When calibration is incorrect or paper speed is unknown, one should not directly use this to judge whether intervals are abnormal.
常见于洋地黄中毒、心肌缺血、心肌炎、低钾，也可见于健康人。: Commonly seen in digitalis toxicity, myocardial ischemia, myocarditis, and hypokalemia; it can also be seen in healthy individuals.
心房内传导屏障使两个心房区域独立除极；可见于心房梗死、洋地黄中毒、严重心肌病。: An intra-atrial conduction barrier causes two atrial regions to depolarize independently; it can be seen in atrial infarction, digitalis toxicity, and severe cardiomyopathy.
心率增快本身增加心肌耗氧，若持续存在可诱发缺血或心动过速性心肌病。: An increased heart rate itself increases myocardial oxygen consumption; if persistent, it can induce ischemia or tachycardia-induced cardiomyopathy.
快速心室节律使房室结处于不应期，窦性 P 无法下传；不是房室结病变。: A rapid ventricular rhythm keeps the AV node in the refractory period, so sinus P waves cannot conduct; this is not AV node disease.
房扑 2:1 传导时心室率约 150 次\/分，F 波可能被误认为窦性 P 波。: In atrial flutter with 2:1 conduction, the ventricular rate is about 150 beats/min, and flutter waves (F waves) may be mistaken for sinus P waves.
把 P 波分成“右房前半段、左房后半段”来读，比背“二尖瓣型\/肺型”更接近机制: Reading the P wave as a "first half from the right atrium and second half from the left atrium" is closer to the mechanism than memorizing "mitral type/pulmonary type."
抗缺血：硝酸酯（无禁忌时）、β 受体阻滞剂，吸氧仅用于低氧血症，充分镇痛。: Anti-ischemia: nitrates (when not contraindicated), beta-blockers; oxygen only for hypoxemia, and adequate analgesia.
新发 LBBB 伴持续胸痛、肌钙蛋白升高或血流动力学不稳定。: New-onset LBBB with persistent chest pain, elevated troponin, or hemodynamic instability.
无症状 WPW 不等于低危；高风险职业、运动或家族史需进一步评估。: Asymptomatic WPW does not mean low risk; high-risk occupation, sports, or family history require further evaluation.
晕厥、黑矇、心室率 <40 次\/分或长间歇 >3 s。: Syncope, blackouts, ventricular rate <40 beats/min, or long pauses >3 s.
最后与旧图、症状、电解质\/药物对照。: Finally, correlate with prior ECGs, symptoms, electrolytes/drugs.
术后新发房室阻滞需起搏评估；房扑\/房速需抗凝与节律控制；室速需评估是否需要 I: New postoperative AV block requires pacing evaluation; atrial flutter/atrial tachycardia require anticoagulation and rhythm control; ventricular tachycardia requires assessment for ICD indication.
检查钾、镁、钙与甲状腺功能。: Check potassium, magnesium, calcium, and thyroid function.
每个 P′ 后可有 QRS，呈 1:1 传导；也可呈 2:1、3:1 或可变比例: Each P′ may be followed by a QRS with 1:1 conduction; it may also conduct 2:1, 3:1, or with a variable ratio.
电轴右偏\/V1 高 R 可为正常。: Right axis deviation/tall R in V1 may be normal.
癫痫抽搐时监护仪“室颤”，先摸脉；伪差和真室颤的处理完全不同。: When the monitor shows "ventricular fibrillation" during an epileptic seizure, check the pulse first; artifact and true ventricular fibrillation are managed completely differently.
看到正弦波不要等血钾结果；先静脉钙剂，再降钾。: When a sine wave is seen, do not wait for the potassium result; give intravenous calcium first, then lower potassium.
窦性 P 波 + 频率 >100 次\/分；它通常是某种问题的“结果”，而不是问: Sinus P waves + rate >100 beats/min; it is usually the "result" of an underlying problem, not the problem itself.
窦性心律，心率约 128 次\/分，P 波与 QRS 一一对应，QRS 窄。: Sinus rhythm, heart rate about 128 beats/min, one-to-one P-QRS association, narrow QRS.
纠正高钾、药物中毒和缺血等可逆病因；存活者评估永久起搏器。: Correct reversible causes such as hyperkalemia, drug toxicity, and ischemia; evaluate survivors for a permanent pacemaker.
缺血由心内膜向心外膜扩展，早期 T 波高尖（超急性期），随后 ST 段抬高、R: Ischemia extends from the endocardium to the epicardium; early T waves are tall and peaked (hyperacute phase), followed by ST-segment elevation, loss of R waves, and ultimately pathological Q waves.
肾上腺素 1 mg 每 3–5 分钟；难治性 VF\/pVT 加胺碘酮 300: Epinephrine 1 mg every 3–5 minutes; for refractory VF/pVT add amiodarone 300 mg (may repeat 150 mg) or lidocaine.
自动测量不能替代人工复核。: Automated measurements cannot replace manual review.
解释 V1–V3 ST 压低为何可能是后壁镜像而不是前壁缺血: Explain why ST depression in V1–V3 may be posterior wall reciprocal change rather than anterior ischemia
评估血压与灌注；AIVR 多稳定，但必须排除持续性室速。: Assess blood pressure and perfusion; AIVR is usually stable, but sustained ventricular tachycardia must be excluded.
运动负荷心电图用于评估可疑冠心病、运动相关心律失常与功能容量；阳性标准包括 ST: Exercise stress ECG is used to evaluate suspected coronary artery disease, exercise-related arrhythmias, and functional capacity; positive criteria include ST depression, symptoms, and abnormal blood pressure response.
透壁缺血导致损伤电流，面向缺血区域的导联出现 ST 抬高，对侧导联出现镜像压低。: Transmural ischemia causes injury current, with ST elevation in leads facing the ischemic region and reciprocal depression in opposite leads.
避免把正常变异误判为异常: Avoid misinterpreting normal variants as abnormalities
钉被误计为 QRS→心率假性增快。: Spikes miscounted as QRS → falsely increased heart rate.
长间歇 + P 波消失 = 窦性停搏；长间歇 + P 波仍规律 = 房室阻滞。: Long pause + absent P waves = sinus arrest; long pause + P waves still regular = AV block.
高危症状需观察\/负荷\/冠脉评估。: High-risk symptoms require observation/stress testing/coronary evaluation.
高钾降低膜电位、减慢传导；钙剂拮抗膜效应但不降钾，需同时清除钾。: Hyperkalemia lowers membrane potential and slows conduction; calcium antagonizes membrane effects but does not lower potassium, so potassium must also be eliminated.
ACLS 中心电图分“可除颤”（VF\/无脉 VT）与“不可除颤”（心搏停止\/: In ACLS, ECG rhythms are divided into “shockable” (VF/pulseless VT) and “non-shockable” (asystole/PEA); management pathways are completely different.
COPD 房颤不要只给 β 阻滞剂；先治低氧与感染，选药考虑支气管痉挛。: Do not give only beta-blockers for atrial fibrillation in COPD; treat hypoxia and infection first, and consider bronchospasm when choosing drugs.
I、II 主波向上 → 电轴正常: Predominant upward deflection in leads I and II → normal axis
LBBB 合并胸痛时，先算 Sgarbossa，再决定是否紧急再灌注。: When LBBB is accompanied by chest pain, calculate Sgarbossa first, then decide whether emergency reperfusion is needed.
POTS 指直立 10 分钟内心率增加 ≥30 次\/分（或 ≥40 次\/分青: POTS is defined as a heart rate increase of ≥30 beats/min (or ≥40 beats/min in adolescents) within 10 minutes of standing, accompanied by symptoms of orthostatic intolerance; blood pressure does not necessarily decrease.
P 波形态逐搏变化（≥3 种）。: P-wave morphology varies beat to beat (≥3 types).
QT(U) 间期延长；U 波可与 T 波融合形成宽大复极波。: QT(U) interval prolongation; the U wave may fuse with the T wave to form a broad repolarization wave.
RR 间期基本规则；允许与呼吸相关的轻度变异，但同一记录中最大与最小 RR 之差: The RR interval is basically regular; mild respiratory-related variation is allowed, but the difference between the maximum and minimum RR in the same recording is usually <0.12 s.
TdP 的“扭转”不是普通室速；先补镁，不要只补钾。: The “twisting” of TdP is not ordinary ventricular tachycardia; give magnesium first, not just potassium.
V1–V2 位于右胸，反映右室与室间隔；V3–V4 位于前胸，反映前壁；V5–V: V1–V2 are located on the right chest and reflect the right ventricle and interventricular septum; V3–V4 are located on the anterior chest and reflect the anterior wall; V5–V6 are located at the left anterior axillary line/midaxillary line and reflect the lateral wall.
“被闹钟吓晕”不是夸张病史，可能是 LQT2 的典型触发。: “Fainting from being startled by an alarm clock” is not an exaggerated history; it may be a typical trigger of LQT2.
不要一开始就盯着 ST 段；先确定节律与导联，否则可能把伪差\/错接当成心梗。: Do not focus on the ST segment from the outset; first determine the rhythm and leads, otherwise artifact/misconnection may be mistaken for myocardial infarction.
严重心动过缓\/三度 AVB、室速、广泛 ST 改变、低电压\/电交替、S1Q3: Severe bradycardia/third-degree AVB, ventricular tachycardia, widespread ST changes, low voltage/electrical alternans, S1Q3T3, and hyperkalemic sine waves all require immediate management.
伴晕厥、胸痛、呼吸困难、低血压时，即使节律“窦性”也需急诊评估。: When accompanied by syncope, chest pain, dyspnea, or hypotension, emergency evaluation is required even if the rhythm is “sinus.”
低镁常伴低钾，补钾不补镁难纠正。: Hypomagnesemia is often accompanied by hypokalemia; it is difficult to correct potassium without supplementing magnesium.
先天性 LQTS：β 受体阻滞剂、避免竞争性运动，评估 ICD；获得性者处理病因: Congenital LQTS: beta-blockers, avoid competitive sports, assess for ICD; for acquired cases, treat the underlying cause.
其后没有 QRS：PR 间期不存在或无法测量。: There is no subsequent QRS: the PR interval is absent or cannot be measured.
判断压低形态：水平型与下斜型更支持缺血，上斜型多见于心动过速。: Determine the morphology of depression: horizontal and downsloping types more strongly support ischemia, while upsloping type is more common in tachycardia.
右室：V3R–V5R，V4R ST 抬高 ≥1 mm 最有价值。: Right ventricle: V3R–V5R; ST elevation ≥1 mm in V4R is the most valuable.
回波搏动可诱发心动过速；不要把它当作孤立早搏。: Echo beats can induce tachycardia; do not treat it as an isolated premature beat.
孩子运动时晕倒，不要只说“低血糖”；查心电图和家族史。: If a child faints during exercise, don't just say "hypoglycemia"; check the ECG and family history.
宽 QRS + 50–110 次\/分 + 房室分离或融合波 = AIVR；频率: Wide QRS + 50–110 bpm + AV dissociation or fusion beats = AIVR; if the rate is faster, treat as VT first.
寻找间歇中的逸搏与 P 波，评估下级起搏点是否“接班”。: Look for escape beats and P waves during pauses to assess whether a lower pacemaker is "taking over."
小儿晕厥先查红线。: In pediatric syncope, check red flags first.
左束支阻滞或起搏心律下，按 Sgarbossa 等标准评估，不直接套用普通阈值。: In LBBB or paced rhythm, assess using Sgarbossa et al. criteria; do not directly apply standard thresholds.
并行心律：联律间期多变 + 公约数。: Parasystole: variable coupling intervals + common denominator.
忽略 QRS 终末的逆行 P，或把逆行 P 误认为 ST 段压低、T 波切迹或伪: Ignoring a retrograde P wave at the end of the QRS, or mistaking a retrograde P wave for ST-segment depression, a T-wave notch, or artifact.
房颤不是“心率越快越危险”；缓慢心室率 + 症状同样需要处理。: AF is not "the faster the rate, the more dangerous"; slow ventricular rate + symptoms also require management.
把 II 导联仍为正向的轻度电轴左偏（0～−30°）误诊为 LAFB。: Misdiagnosing mild left axis deviation (0 to −30°) with lead II still positive as LAFB.
抗栓：阿司匹林负荷加 P2Y12 抑制剂，加依诺肝素或普通肝素，按 ACS 流程: Antithrombotic therapy: aspirin loading plus a P2Y12 inhibitor, plus enoxaparin or unfractionated heparin, following the ACS protocol.
按摩前评估颈动脉。: Assess the carotid arteries before massage.
无脉性 VT：按心脏骤停处理，立即 CPR + 非同步除颤（双相 120–200: Pulseless VT: manage as cardiac arrest, immediate CPR + unsynchronized defibrillation (biphasic 120–200 J), epinephrine 1 mg every 3–5 minutes, add amiodarone 300 mg if refractory.
晕厥评估先排除心脏性原因，再做倾斜试验；不要本末倒置。: In syncope evaluation, first exclude cardiac causes, then perform tilt-table testing; do not reverse the order.
术前 ECG 按风险选择。: Preoperative ECG: select according to risk.
检查选择由临床问题决定。: Test selection is determined by the clinical question.
正常窦性心律是练习标准测量的最佳模板。: Normal sinus rhythm is the best template for practicing standard measurements.
漂移可让 ST 段看似抬高或压低；应在稳定段测量，并重复记录。: Drift can make the ST segment appear elevated or depressed; measure in stable segments and repeat the recording.
相邻导联 ST 抬高定位梗死区域：V1–V4 前壁、II\/III\/aVF 下: ST elevation in adjacent leads localizes the infarct area: V1–V4 anterior, II/III/aVF inferior, I/aVL/V5/V6 lateral.
睡眠呼吸暂停可致夜间心动过缓\/停搏。: Sleep apnea can cause nocturnal bradycardia/arrest.
确认每个 P 波形态一致、PR 固定，排除房性早搏或游走性心房起搏点。: Confirm that each P wave has a consistent morphology and a fixed PR interval, excluding atrial premature beats or wandering atrial pacemaker.
窦性 P 波规则出现，但频率 <60 次\/分。: Sinus P waves appear regularly, but the rate is <60 bpm.
窦性心律，约 70 次\/分，记录中一次提前的窄 QRS 前无窦性 P，符合交界: Sinus rhythm, about 70 bpm; in the recording, one premature narrow QRS without a preceding sinus P wave, consistent with a junctional premature contraction.
第三位 I\/T\/D 表示抑制\/触发\/双反应。: The third letter I/T/D indicates inhibition/triggering/dual response.
结合症状、肌钙蛋白与动态变化，不凭单次心电图独立诊断。: Combine symptoms, troponin, and dynamic changes; do not diagnose independently based on a single ECG.
计算心房率、心室率与传导比例。: Calculate the atrial rate, ventricular rate, and conduction ratio.
起搏频率滞后与模式转换: Pacemaker rate hysteresis and mode switching
运动中晕厥 + 心电图肥厚\/深 Q + 家族猝死 → 怀疑 HCM，停止运动并: Exertional syncope + ECG hypertrophy/deep Q + family sudden death → suspect HCM, stop exercise, and perform echocardiography/risk assessment.
选择基线平稳、波形清晰的导联；PR 从 P 起点到 QRS 起点，QRS 从第一: Select leads with a stable baseline and clear waveforms; PR from P onset to QRS onset, QRS from the first deflection to the final return to baseline.
钠通道功能异常在发热时加重，右室流出道复极异质性增加，诱发室颤。: Sodium channel dysfunction worsens with fever, increasing repolarization heterogeneity in the right ventricular outflow tract and inducing ventricular fibrillation.
需与心包炎、早期复极、左束支阻滞等鉴别。: Needs differentiation from pericarditis, early repolarization, left bundle branch block, etc.
静息可无预激；心动过速呈 LBBB 样。: May have no pre-excitation at rest; tachycardia shows an LBBB-like pattern.
ACLS 能量与药物速查: ACLS energy and drug quick reference
COPD 患者新发房颤，先看血气和感染；治肺比单纯降心率更重要。: In COPD patients with new-onset AF, first check blood gases and infection; treating the lungs is more important than simply lowering the heart rate.
Holter 用于阵发性心律失常与负荷评估。: Holter is used for paroxysmal arrhythmias and burden assessment.
LBBB 合并心梗：使用 Sgarbossa 等专门标准。: LBBB with MI: use dedicated criteria such as Sgarbossa.
PMT 多见于 DDD 起搏器：室性早搏或房性早搏被心房导线感知后触发心室起搏，: PMT is mostly seen with DDD pacemakers: a PVC or PAC sensed by the atrial lead triggers ventricular pacing, forming a reentrant tachycardia.
P 波在 I、II、aVF 直立，aVR 倒置，宽度 <0.12 s；PR 间期: P wave is upright in I, II, aVF and inverted in aVR, width <0.12 s; PR interval is from P onset to QRS onset, normal 0.12–0.20 s.
SVT 伴差异性传导可宽，需比较既往心电图。: SVT with aberrancy may be wide; compare with previous ECG.
T 波可呈双相、切迹、倒置或电交替。: T waves may be biphasic, notched, inverted, or show electrical alternans.
V7–V9 相邻导联 ST 抬高 ≥1 mm 可直接证实后壁梗死。: ST elevation ≥1 mm in contiguous leads V7–V9 directly confirms posterior wall infarction.
严重乏力、肌无力、肠麻痹或呼吸肌无力。: Severe fatigue, muscle weakness, ileus, or respiratory muscle weakness.
亚急性期：ST 回落、T 深倒置、Q 持续；陈旧期遗留 Q 波。: Subacute phase: ST resolves, deep T-wave inversion, Q persists; old phase leaves a Q wave.
低血压患者的心电图是“血流动力学线索”，不是单纯诊断题；先救命再解释。: The ECG in a hypotensive patient is a “hemodynamic clue,” not just a diagnostic question; save the life first, then interpret.
先判断患者有无脉搏与血流动力学稳定性，再分析心电图。: First determine whether the patient has a pulse and hemodynamic stability, then analyze the ECG.
再灌注：直接 PCI 为首选，目标 ≤120 分钟；不能及时 PCI 且无禁忌时: Reperfusion: primary PCI is the first choice, target ≤120 minutes; if timely PCI is unavailable and there are no contraindications, thrombolysis within 30 minutes.
前驱症状：恶心、出汗、苍白、视野模糊；晕厥时心动过缓\/低血压；心电图多正常。: Prodromal symptoms: nausea, sweating, pallor, blurred vision; bradycardia/hypotension during syncope; ECG often normal.
可伴窦性心动过速与低电压；肌钙蛋白可轻度升高，提示心肌心包炎。: May be accompanied by sinus tachycardia and low voltage; troponin may be mildly elevated, suggesting myopericarditis.
右室梗死合并后壁梗死时，V1 的 ST 改变可能不典型，需同时加做 V7–V9。: When right ventricular infarction is combined with posterior infarction, ST changes in V1 may be atypical; V7–V9 should also be recorded.
同一导联中 PVC 形态一致为单源，多种形态为多源；连续 ≥3 个为室速。: PVCs with identical morphology in the same lead are unifocal, multiple morphologies are multifocal; ≥3 consecutive PVCs indicate ventricular tachycardia.
多数良性；晕厥\/家族猝死需评估。: Mostly benign; syncope/family history of sudden cardiac death require evaluation.
妊娠期 D-二聚体升高、心电图正常不能排除 PE；临床概率与影像决策。: D-dimer rises during pregnancy; a normal ECG cannot exclude PE; clinical probability and imaging decisions.
宽 QRS 不一定是室早；房颤中出现长-短周期后的 RBBB 形态，先考虑 As: A wide QRS is not necessarily a premature ventricular beat; an RBBB morphology after a long–short cycle in atrial fibrillation should first suggest Ashman phenomenon rather than being managed directly as ventricular tachycardia.
寻找心动过缓、PR 延长等传导异常。: Look for conduction abnormalities such as bradycardia and PR prolongation.
小婴儿心率 260 + 肝大，先做心电图；SVT 可能已经引起心衰。: In a small infant with heart rate 260 and hepatomegaly, do an ECG first; SVT may already have caused heart failure.
年轻运动员晕倒，最危险的不是“没休息好”，而是 HCM\/离子通道病。: When a young athlete faints, the most dangerous consideration is not 'not rested enough' but HCM/channelopathy.
心包炎为弥漫凹面抬高伴 PR 压低，不符合单一血管分布。: Pericarditis shows diffuse concave elevation with PR depression, not conforming to a single vascular distribution.
急性右室心肌梗死多与下壁心肌梗死同时发生，常由右冠状动脉近端闭塞引起。右室心肌薄: Acute right ventricular myocardial infarction usually occurs together with inferior myocardial infarction and is often caused by proximal right coronary artery occlusion. The right ventricular wall is thin and low-pressure, and during ischemia it easily dilates and causes hypotension; on ECG, in addition to inferior ST elevation, ST elevation in V4R is the most valuable clue. Because standard 12-lead ECG lacks right precordial leads, relying on conventional leads alone can easily lead to missed diagnosis.
房早前有提前的 P′，PR 通常 ≥0.12 s。: Premature atrial contractions are preceded by a premature P′, with PR usually ≥0.12 s.
房颤患者头晕 + 心率 38，先看药；地高辛\/β阻滞剂可能过量。: In an AF patient with dizziness + HR 38, check medications first; digoxin/beta-blockers may be overdosed.
把 TdP 当成普通单形性 VT 使用同步电复律，可能无法同步。: Treating TdP as ordinary monomorphic VT with synchronized cardioversion may fail to synchronize.
新生儿 SVT 可能难以识别，需与哭闹\/发热鉴别；迷走刺激\/腺苷为急性处理。: Neonatal SVT may be difficult to recognize and must be differentiated from crying/fever; vagal maneuvers/adenosine are acute management.
最具特异性的是“ST 段延长导致 QT 延长，而 T 波形态相对正常”；与低钾不: The most specific finding is "ST segment prolongation causing QT prolongation, while T wave morphology is relatively normal"; unlike hypokalemia, hypocalcemia usually has no obvious U wave.
