S1Q3T3 不特异，但右心负荷图形 + 临床概率高 → 影像学确认；不稳定者考: S1Q3T3 is nonspecific, but right heart strain pattern + high clinical probability → confirm with imaging; consider reperfusion if unstable.
T 波与主波反向: T wave opposite to the main QRS deflection
V2–V3 thresholds by age and sex: men ≥40 years ≥2 mm, men <40 years ≥2.5 mm, women ≥1.5 mm; other leads ≥1 mm.
下壁 STEMI 忽略右室梗死，过量使用硝酸酯导致低血压。: In inferior STEMI, ignoring right ventricular infarction and overusing nitrates leads to hypotension.
不要因分析波形延误按压；除颤后立即恢复 CPR 2 分钟。: Do not delay compressions to analyze the waveform; resume CPR immediately for 2 minutes after defibrillation.
严重高钾先打钙，再降钾；钙剂不降低血钾，只保护心脏。: In severe hyperkalemia, give calcium first, then lower potassium; calcium does not lower serum potassium, it only protects the heart.
代码是理解起搏心电图的第一步：知道起搏腔和感知腔，才能预测起搏钉、P 波与 QR: The code is the first step to understanding paced ECGs: knowing the pacing chamber and sensing chamber allows one to predict pacing spikes and the relationship between P waves and QRS complexes.
低钙导致 ST 延长与 QT 延长，有血钙证据。: Hypocalcemia causes ST prolongation and QT prolongation, with evidence of low blood calcium.
依赖阿托品而延误起搏；阿托品可能提高心房率，却不改善房室传导。: Relying on atropine delays pacing; atropine may increase the atrial rate but does not improve AV conduction.
具体药物与剂量需由临床医生决定，本页仅作教学。: Specific drugs and doses must be determined by the clinician; this page is for teaching only.
动态变化比单次更重要。: Dynamic changes are more important than a single measurement.
危险因素包括高龄、结构性心脏病、高血压、心衰、甲亢、肺部疾病与心脏术后。: Risk factors include advanced age, structural heart disease, hypertension, heart failure, hyperthyroidism, pulmonary disease, and post-cardiac surgery.
右束支与左束支：看 V1 与 V6: Right bundle branch vs left bundle branch: look at V1 and V6.
在 II、V1 导联仔细辨认 P′ 波，比较其与窦性 P 的形态和电轴。: Carefully identify the P′ wave in leads II and V1, and compare its morphology and axis with the sinus P wave.
女性 ACS 症状可不典型。: Women with ACS may have atypical symptoms.
室早 QRS 宽大畸形，T 波方向相反。: Premature ventricular contractions have a wide, bizarre QRS complex and a T wave in the opposite direction.
宽 QRS 节律频率在 50–110 次\/分之间，伴房室分离和\/或室性融合波: A wide QRS rhythm at 50–110 beats/min with AV dissociation and/or ventricular fusion beats and capture beats is the most specific combination for AIVR; when the rate is >100 beats/min, it should first be evaluated as ventricular tachycardia.
将左室肥厚伴劳损（QRS 可增宽但 <0.12 s）与 LBBB 混淆。: Confusing left ventricular hypertrophy with strain (QRS may widen but <0.12 s) with LBBB.
左右上肢导联反接可造成假性电轴左偏与 I 导联倒置。: Reversal of the left and right upper limb leads can cause pseudo-left axis deviation and inversion in lead I.
常伴 T 波倒置、低平或双向；ST 压低可随症状动态变化。: Often accompanied by T-wave inversion, flattening, or biphasic T waves; ST depression may change dynamically with symptoms.
常见：II\/III\/aVF 高 P、电轴右偏、V1 高 R、V5\/V6 深: Common findings: tall P waves in II/III/aVF, right axis deviation, tall R in V1, deep S in V5/V6, and low voltage in precordial leads; may be accompanied by S1Q3T3.
当复极顺序异常（缺血、电解质、药物），T 波方向可与 QRS 不一致，ST 段也: When the repolarization sequence is abnormal (ischemia, electrolytes, drugs), the T-wave direction may be discordant with the QRS, and the ST segment may also be shifted.
心室肌细胞的动作电位分为 0–4 相：0 相 Na⁺ 快速内流（对应 QRS 上: The action potential of ventricular myocardial cells is divided into phases 0–4: phase 0 rapid Na⁺ influx (corresponding to the QRS upstroke); phase 1 brief K⁺ efflux; phase 2 Ca²⁺ influx and K⁺ efflux form the plateau (corresponding to the ST segment); phase 3 K⁺ efflux repolarization (corresponding to the T wave); phase 4 ion pumps restore the gradients.
心衰患者 QRS 160 ms + LBBB，不要只加利尿剂；问是否需要 CRT: In a heart failure patient with QRS 160 ms + LBBB, do not just add diuretics; ask whether CRT is indicated.
感知灵敏度过高、单极导线、电磁干扰、肌肉震颤或 T 波过感知导致起搏抑制。: Oversensing, unipolar leads, electromagnetic interference, muscle tremor, or T-wave oversensing can cause pacing inhibition.
房性二联律的提前搏动有 P′，QRS 多窄。: The premature beats of atrial bigeminy have a P′ wave, and the QRS is usually narrow.
把 QT 缩短误认为正常变异，忽略高钙。: Mistaking a shortened QT for a normal variant and overlooking hypercalcemia.
换算小格\/大格时间与电压: Convert small boxes/large boxes into time and voltage.
无脉、意识丧失——立即 CPR + 非同步除颤。: Pulseless, loss of consciousness—immediate CPR + asynchronous defibrillation.
有脉不稳定：同步电复律，单形性 VT 100 J 起始。: Unstable with pulse: synchronized cardioversion, starting at 100 J for monomorphic VT.
模式转换后可能出现房室不同步；患者可有心悸，需程控优化。: AV dyssynchrony may occur after mode switching; patients may have palpitations and require programming optimization.
洋地黄效应呈勺状 ST 压低、QT 缩短，伴洋地黄用药史。: Digitalis effect shows scooped ST depression and shortened QT, with a history of digitalis use.
滤波器去除噪声的同时也改变低频 ST 段与高频 QRS；自动增益会放大\/压缩波: Filters remove noise while also altering the low-frequency ST segment and high-frequency QRS; automatic gain can amplify/compress the waveform.
电轴不是孤立指标；先排除导联错接，再结合 QRS 形态与电压。: Axis is not an isolated indicator; first exclude lead misplacement, then consider QRS morphology and voltage.
看到电轴左偏先看 II：II 仍正则多为正常变异\/体位；II 负且下壁 rS，: When left axis deviation is seen, look at II first: if II remains positive, it is mostly a normal variant/body position; if II is negative with inferior rS, it is more like left anterior fascicular block.
磁铁模式常为固定频率起搏（如 85–100 次\/分），不再感知自身心律；可看到: Magnet mode is usually fixed-rate pacing (e.g., 85–100 bpm), no longer sensing intrinsic rhythm; regular pacing spikes can be seen.
窦性心律不齐是窦房结冲动频率随呼吸或迷走张力周期性变化，导致 RR 间期不规则，: Sinus arrhythmia is periodic variation in the SA node impulse rate with respiration or vagal tone, causing irregular RR intervals, while P-wave morphology and AV conduction relationship remain normal.
窦速、低电压、ST-T 改变。: Sinus tachycardia, low voltage, ST-T changes.
结合症状、肌钙蛋白与危险评分（GRACE、TIMI）进行分层。: Stratify based on symptoms, troponin, and risk scores (GRACE, TIMI).
肥厚心肌动作电位时程延长、复极顺序改变，导致 ST-T 与 QRS 向量不一致；: In hypertrophied myocardium, action potential duration is prolonged and repolarization sequence is altered, leading to discordance between ST-T and QRS vectors; ischemia may be superimposed.
解释 Q 波、ST 段与 T 波在不同阶段的演变规律: Explain the evolving patterns of Q waves, ST segments, and T waves at different stages
说明希氏束-浦肯野系统的同步激动作用: Explain the synchronous activation role of the His-Purkinje system.
转头\/衣领诱发晕厥。: Syncope induced by turning the head/collar.
连续 ≥3 个室性搏动、频率 >100 次\/分即为室速。: ≥3 consecutive ventricular beats at a rate >100 beats/min define ventricular tachycardia.
逐搏测量 PR，确认其恒定。: Measure PR beat by beat to confirm it is constant.
钉后无 P\/QRS=失夺获；钉后有过早\/异常波形=可能感知异常；钉被自身搏动: No P/QRS after the spike = failure to capture; premature/abnormal waveform after the spike = possible sensing abnormality; spike inhibited by intrinsic beat = normal.
阴性不能完全排除。: A negative result cannot completely exclude it.
需与干扰性房室分离鉴别：后者常发生于室速，P 率低于 QRS 率。: Must be differentiated from interference AV dissociation: the latter often occurs in VT, with a P rate lower than the QRS rate.
额面电轴 −45°～−90°，加 I、aVL 的 qR 与 II、III、aVF: Frontal plane axis −45° to −90°, plus qR in I and aVL and rS in II, III, and aVF, plus QRS <0.12 s and aVL R peak time ≥45 ms; mild left axis deviation of only 0 to −30° does not constitute the diagnosis.
高钾→T 波高尖\/QRS 增宽；低钾→U 波\/QT 延长；钠通道阻滞→QRS: Hyperkalemia → peaked T waves/QRS widening; hypokalemia → U waves/QT prolongation; sodium channel blockade → QRS widening.
32 岁男性，心悸、头晕；宽 QRS 不规则心动过速，RR 最短约 220 ms: 32-year-old man with palpitations and dizziness; irregular wide-QRS tachycardia, shortest RR approximately 220 ms, history of WPW.
AI 说“低 EF”，下一步是超声，不是直接开药。: AI says “low EF”; the next step is echocardiography, not prescribing medication directly.
COPD：低电压、右偏、右房增大、R 波递增不良。: COPD: low voltage, right axis deviation, right atrial enlargement, poor R-wave progression.
HCM 可猝死，尤其运动时。: HCM can cause sudden death, especially during exercise.
IKr 是复极快速成分；LQT2 复极储备下降，交感兴奋时易发生早期后除极。: IKr is the rapid component of repolarization; in LQT2, repolarization reserve is reduced, making early afterdepolarizations likely during sympathetic activation.
LQT1 患者不能用“没有晕厥”排除风险；运动前评估与治疗很重要。: In patients with LQT1, the absence of syncope cannot be used to exclude risk; pre-exercise evaluation and treatment are important.
P′ 常隐藏在前的 T 波中，只看 QRS 会把房早误判为窦性心律不齐。: P′ is often hidden in the preceding T wave; looking only at the QRS can misdiagnose premature atrial contractions as sinus arrhythmia.
QTc 延长 + 家族猝死。: Prolonged QTc + family history of sudden death.
QT 间期缩短，ST 段缩短，T 波形态多正常。: Shortened QT interval, shortened ST segment, and mostly normal T-wave morphology.
RVH：V1 高 R + 电轴右偏 + 右胸劳损。: RVH: tall R in V1 + right axis deviation + right precordial strain.
ST 抬高的相邻导联指向梗死部位，镜像压低帮助确认；V1–V3 压低伴高 R、直: The adjacent leads with ST elevation point to the infarct site, and reciprocal depression helps confirm it; ST depression in V1–V3 with tall R waves and upright T waves suggests posterior wall involvement; add V7–V9 and V3R–V5R to form an 18-lead ECG.
V1 深 S、V5\/V6 高 R，QRS 可增宽，但通常没有宽钝 S 与 R′: V1 deep S, V5/V6 high R, QRS may be widened, but usually no broad slurred S and R′.
V1–V3 穹隆型 ST 段抬高 ≥2 mm，伴 T 波倒置；发热\/药物可诱发: V1–V3 coved ST-segment elevation ≥2 mm, with T-wave inversion; fever/drugs can induce it, risk of sudden death.
aVR P 直立是错接线索。: Upright P wave in aVR is a clue to lead misplacement.
与旧图对比并动态复查；单次“正常”心电图不能排除早期心肌梗死。: Compare with old tracings and repeat dynamically; a single “normal” ECG cannot exclude early myocardial infarction.
事件记录器由患者触发记录，植入式循环记录器（ILR）连续记录并自动\/手动保存，: Event recorders are patient-triggered; implantable loop recorders (ILR) continuously record and automatically/manually save, suitable for infrequent paroxysmal syncope.
交界区起搏细胞固有频率约 40–60 次\/分；冲动沿希氏束-浦肯野系统下传，Q: Junctional pacemaker cells have an intrinsic rate of about 40–60 beats/min; impulses conduct down the His-Purkinje system, QRS is narrow, and they can also conduct retrogradely to the atria to form retrograde P waves.
低电压、肥胖、肺气肿、心包积液会降低振幅，影响电压标准；束支阻滞、起搏、预激会使: Low voltage, obesity, emphysema, and pericardial effusion reduce amplitude and affect voltage criteria; bundle branch block, pacing, and pre-excitation complicate QRS/QT measurement.
使用房室结阻滞剂后心动过速加重或心室率更快。: Tachycardia worsens or the ventricular rate becomes faster after using AV nodal blocking agents.
先心病术后可出现传导阻滞\/心律失常；需与术前对比。: Conduction block/arrhythmias can occur after congenital heart disease surgery; compare with preoperative findings.
冲动在心室肌细胞间传导速度慢，导致 QRS 宽大畸形，心室除极与复极顺序异常，T: Impulses conduct slowly between ventricular myocardial cells, causing a wide, bizarre QRS; the ventricular depolarization and repolarization sequence is abnormal, and the T wave is opposite in direction to the main QRS deflection.
判断心梗不要只看一张图：把首份心电图当作起点，追踪 ST-T 与 Q 波的动态演: Do not judge MI from a single tracing: use the first ECG as a starting point and track the dynamic evolution of ST-T and Q waves; clues to the culprit vessel come from lead combinations, not the elevation amplitude in a single lead.
动态复查心电图与肌钙蛋白，观察 ST-T 演变与再缺血。: Repeat ECG and troponin dynamically, and observe ST-T evolution and recurrent ischemia.
双分支阻滞伴晕厥者评估起搏器；无症状的双分支阻滞不常规起搏。: Evaluate for pacemaker in bifascicular block with syncope; asymptomatic bifascicular block is not routinely paced.
合并 RBBB 时 QRS ≥0.12 s，称为双分支阻滞，需评估房室传导风险。: When combined with RBBB, QRS ≥0.12 s is called bifascicular block, and AV conduction risk should be assessed.
回旋支：I、aVL、V5、V6；下壁导联 II>III；后壁受累常见。: Circumflex: I, aVL, V5, V6; inferior leads II>III; posterior involvement is common.
复极钾通道功能增强使动作电位时程缩短、复极离散增加，易形成折返。: Enhanced function of repolarizing potassium channels shortens action potential duration and increases repolarization dispersion, predisposing to reentry.
女性、左室肥厚、洋地黄、低钾可导致假阳性；运动试验阴性也不能完全排除冠心病。: Female sex, left ventricular hypertrophy, digitalis, and hypokalemia can cause false positives; a negative exercise test also cannot completely exclude coronary artery disease.
宽 QRS 心动过速先按室速处理；Brugada 四步法帮助区分室速与室上速伴差: Treat wide QRS tachycardia as ventricular tachycardia first; the Brugada four-step method helps distinguish ventricular tachycardia from supraventricular tachycardia with aberrant conduction.
寻找突然脱漏的 P 波，比较脱漏前后的 PR。: Look for a suddenly dropped P wave and compare the PR interval before and after the dropped beat.
屏气试验只能辅助，不能替代对 P 波形态的逐搏确认。: The breath-holding test is only adjunctive and cannot replace beat-by-beat confirmation of P wave morphology.
左室肥厚、预激、下壁起搏均可模拟 LAFB 图形。: Left ventricular hypertrophy, pre-excitation, and inferior wall pacing can all mimic a LAFB pattern.
年轻人运动时宽 QRS 心动过速 + V1–V3 T 倒置，要想到 ARVC。: In a young person with wide QRS tachycardia during exercise plus T wave inversion in V1–V3, consider ARVC.
心室率 <40 次\/分、长间歇 >3 s、晕厥或低血压。: Ventricular rate <40 bpm, long pauses >3 s, syncope, or hypotension.
急性缺血与再灌注使心室浦肯野纤维自律性增高，超过窦房结频率，形成加速性室性节律。: Acute ischemia and reperfusion increase the automaticity of ventricular Purkinje fibers, exceeding the sinus node rate and producing accelerated ventricular rhythm.
房性心动过速是起源于心房（窦房结以外）的异位快速节律，频率通常在 150–250: Atrial tachycardia is an ectopic rapid rhythm originating from the atrium (outside the sinoatrial node), with a rate usually 150–250 bpm; the P′ wave morphology differs from the sinus P wave, and the QRS complex is usually narrow.
手术室监护仪“室速” + 电刀正在工作，先看患者和脉搏；可能是干扰。: When the operating room monitor shows “ventricular tachycardia” while the electrocautery is active, check the patient and pulse first; it may be interference.
把窦性心律不齐误诊为房颤：后者无 P 波，前者有清晰窦性 P。: Misdiagnosing sinus arrhythmia as atrial fibrillation: the latter has no P waves, while the former has clear sinus P waves.
支持室速诊断。: Supports the diagnosis of ventricular tachycardia.
旁路绕过房室结，缺乏生理性过滤；房颤时冲动可经旁路快速下传，诱发室颤。: An accessory pathway bypasses the AV node and lacks physiologic filtering; during atrial fibrillation, impulses can conduct rapidly down the accessory pathway and induce ventricular fibrillation.
显示心率约为真实两倍。: Shows a heart rate approximately twice the true rate.
有症状或负荷高者：β 受体阻滞剂为首选；结构性心脏病患者避免Ⅰ类抗心律失常药。: For symptomatic patients or those with a high burden: beta-blockers are first-line; avoid class I antiarrhythmic drugs in patients with structural heart disease.
正常 ECG 不排除心律失常。: A normal ECG does not exclude arrhythmia.
电压是“筛查信号”，不是“诊断结论”；把体型、导联和传导因素先排除。: Voltage is a "screening signal," not a "diagnostic conclusion"; first exclude body habitus, lead, and conduction factors.
症状性心动过缓：阿托品 1 mg 静脉推注，每 3–5 分钟可重复，最大 3 m: Symptomatic bradycardia: atropine 1 mg IV push, may repeat every 3–5 minutes, maximum 3 mg; often effective in those with increased vagal tone.
看 ST 抬高的分布是否“弥漫”：多个血管区域同时受累提示心包炎。: Check whether the distribution of ST elevation is "diffuse": simultaneous involvement of multiple vascular territories suggests pericarditis.
稳定单形性 VT：胺碘酮等；不明原因时避免房室结阻滞剂。: Stable monomorphic VT: amiodarone, etc.; avoid AV nodal blockers when the cause is unknown.
窦性心律，II、V5、V6 导联勺状 ST 段压低，QT 缩短，T 波低平，符合: Sinus rhythm, scooped ST-segment depression in leads II, V5, V6, shortened QT, flattened T waves, consistent with digitalis effect.
窦速有正常 P 波，起止渐缓，频率随病因波动。: Sinus tachycardia has normal P waves, gradual onset and offset, and rate fluctuates with the cause.
若为药物、甲状腺功能异常、贫血、发热等引起，处理原发病。: If caused by drugs, thyroid dysfunction, anemia, fever, etc., treat the underlying disease.
观察 QRS 宽度，若宽需考虑差异性传导或原有束支阻滞。: Observe QRS width; if wide, consider aberrant conduction or preexisting bundle branch block.
评估电轴、QRS 时限与左房扩大（P 波终末负向）。: Assess axis, QRS duration, and left atrial enlargement (terminal negative P wave).
起搏时也可见融合。: Fusion can also be seen during pacing.
这会产生“电轴右偏”“侧壁缺血”等假象；重新连接后图形恢复正常。: This can produce artifacts such as "right axis deviation" and "lateral ischemia"; the tracing returns to normal after reconnection.
逸搏是长间歇后的保护性搏动，早搏是提前的异位搏动。: Escape beats are protective beats after a long pause; premature beats are early ectopic beats.
阿托品无效或不适用时，经皮起搏可作为过渡；也可使用多巴胺或肾上腺素泵入维持血压与: When atropine is ineffective or unsuitable, transcutaneous pacing can serve as a bridge; dopamine or epinephrine infusion can also be used to maintain blood pressure and heart rate. In high-grade block, wide QRS, or hemodynamic instability, prepare for transvenous temporary pacing as soon as possible and look for reversible causes.
预激合并心动过速时，避免单纯房室结阻滞剂。: In preexcitation with tachycardia, avoid AV nodal blockers alone.
高钾降低膜电位、减慢传导；新生儿心肌对高钾更敏感。: Hyperkalemia lowers membrane potential and slows conduction; neonatal myocardium is more sensitive to hyperkalemia.
HCM 心肌肥厚、纤维化与微血管缺血导致运动时心律失常；是年轻运动员猝死的重要原: In HCM, myocardial hypertrophy, fibrosis, and microvascular ischemia cause arrhythmias during exercise; it is an important cause of sudden death in young athletes.
P 波=心房除极，QRS=心室除极，T 波=心室复极；ST 段是复极早期，T 波: P wave = atrial depolarization, QRS = ventricular depolarization, T wave = ventricular repolarization; the ST segment represents early repolarization and the T wave late repolarization, and the two usually have the same direction.
QRS 宽度与形态都要看。: Both QRS width and morphology must be assessed.
RBBB 有 rSR′，PR 正常，无 delta 波。: RBBB has rSR′, normal PR, and no delta wave.
ST 抬高的相邻导联定位梗死区域，镜像压低帮助确认。: Adjacent leads with ST elevation localize the infarct territory; reciprocal depression helps confirm.
V1–V3 压低伴下壁抬高但未加做后壁导联，容易漏诊后壁梗死。: V1–V3 depression with inferior ST elevation but no additional posterior leads makes posterior infarction easy to miss.
“窦性心律”只说明起搏点，不等于心电图完全正常；仍需检查间期、电压与 ST-T。: “Sinus rhythm” only indicates the pacemaker origin; it does not mean the ECG is completely normal; intervals, voltages, and ST-T still need to be checked.
三度阻滞伴晕厥：直接准备起搏，经皮起搏桥接并尽快永久起搏，不要等待阿托品起效。: Third-degree block with syncope: prepare for pacing directly, bridge with transcutaneous pacing and proceed to permanent pacing as soon as possible; do not wait for atropine to take effect.
不要只追新技术而忽略基础；也不要因 AI 而放弃系统判读。: Do not chase new technology while ignoring the basics; nor abandon systematic interpretation because of AI.
严重时立即静脉钙剂。: In severe cases, give intravenous calcium immediately.
二联律 = 正常与 PVC 的 1:1 双人舞；先数比例，再看形态。: Bigeminy = a 1:1 duet of normal beats and PVCs; count the ratio first, then assess morphology.
传导阻滞专题：从右束支到三分支: Conduction Block Topic: From Right Bundle Branch to Trifascicular Block
低钾\/低镁延长复极，早期后除极触发 TdP；心动过缓与药物进一步增加风险。: Hypokalemia/hypomagnesemia prolong repolarization, early afterdepolarizations trigger TdP; bradycardia and drugs further increase risk.
体表波形 = 心电向量在导联轴上的投影。: Surface waveform = projection of the cardiac electrical vector onto the lead axis.
先复苏与查感染，同时排除 ACS。: First resuscitate and evaluate for infection, while ruling out ACS.
刺激迷走神经或 Adenosine 常可终止。: Vagal stimulation or Adenosine can often terminate it.
危急值需要立即报告并启动相应流程；报告内容包含心律、频率、关键改变、患者状态与已: Critical values require immediate reporting and initiation of the corresponding workflow; the report should include rhythm, rate, key changes, patient status, and measures already taken.
发热 + 晕厥 + 右胸导联 ST 抬高：想到 Brugada，别只当感染。: Fever + syncope + ST elevation in right precordial leads: think of Brugada, don't just treat it as infection.
可伴窦性心动过缓、房室阻滞与室性早搏。: May be accompanied by sinus bradycardia, AV block, and premature ventricular contractions.
右冠近端闭塞占比: Proportion of proximal right coronary artery occlusion
同一导联中最大与最小 RR 间期之差 >0.12 s（或变异 >10%）。: Difference between the longest and shortest RR intervals in the same lead >0.12 s (or variation >10%).
婴儿猝死家族史 + QTc 延长，需遗传与儿科心脏评估。: Family history of sudden infant death syndrome + prolonged QTc requires genetic and pediatric cardiology evaluation.
宽 QRS 节律里突然出现一个窄 QRS，先找 P；可能是夺获，不是早搏。: A narrow QRS suddenly appearing in a wide-QRS rhythm: look for a P wave first; it may be a capture beat, not a premature beat.
小儿宽 QRS 心动过速，不要随意用维拉帕米；可能是预激伴房颤。: In pediatric wide-QRS tachycardia, do not use verapamil indiscriminately; it may be pre-excitation with atrial fibrillation.
左房增大→P 波增宽、V1 终末负向。: Left atrial enlargement → widened P wave with terminal negative deflection in V1.
常见于病态窦房结综合征、下壁心肌梗死、心肌炎、洋地黄或 β 受体阻滞剂过量、高钾: Commonly seen in sick sinus syndrome, inferior myocardial infarction, myocarditis, digitalis or beta-blocker overdose, hyperkalemia, and increased vagal tone; physiologic findings can also be seen during sleep and in athletes.
延长记录时间提高阵发性事件检出率；患者日志与症状时间戳是解读关键。: Prolonging recording time improves detection of paroxysmal events; patient logs and symptom timestamps are key to interpretation.
心律失常\/缺血\/梗阻性原因导致心输出量下降；心电图是快速鉴别工具之一。: Arrhythmia/ischemia/obstructive causes lead to decreased cardiac output; the ECG is one of the rapid diagnostic tools.
心电图呈大小、形态、频率完全不规则的混沌波形，无可见 P-QRS-T。: The ECG shows chaotic waveforms completely irregular in amplitude, morphology, and rate, with no visible P-QRS-T.
心脏记忆指心室激动顺序改变后，T 波在恢复正常传导后仍持续倒置一段时间；常见于起: Cardiac memory refers to persistent T-wave inversion for a period after ventricular activation sequence changes and normal conduction resumes; commonly seen after pacing, pre-excitation, and ventricular tachycardia.
慢快综合征：快速房性心律失常 + 慢窦性。: Brady-tachy syndrome: rapid atrial arrhythmia + slow sinus rhythm.
房速 P′ 可见且形态异常，Adenosine 可能仅暂时阻滞房室结。: In atrial tachycardia, P′ waves are visible and abnormal in morphology; adenosine may only temporarily block the AV node.
所有间期都必须结合心率、年龄、导联与测量方法；QT 必须校正，PR 与 QRS: All intervals must be interpreted in the context of heart rate, age, leads, and measurement method; QT must be corrected, and PR and QRS should be assessed by overall morphology rather than a single number.
把波形当成“电活动的时间轴”，而不是孤立图形；这能解释为什么同一病变在不同导联方: Treat the waveform as a 'timeline of electrical activity,' not an isolated pattern; this explains why the same pathology has different orientations in different leads.
提前的窄 QRS + 前无 P + 后有逆行 P = 交界性早搏。: Premature narrow QRS + no preceding P + retrograde P afterward = junctional premature beat.
未下传的房早可表现为“长间歇”，易误诊为窦性停搏，需寻找 T 波上的 P′。: Non-conducted atrial premature beats can present as a “long pause” and are easily misdiagnosed as sinus arrest; look for a P′ on the T wave.
检查 ST 形态：凹面向上、J 点抬高，而非弓背向上。: Check ST morphology: concave upward with J-point elevation, not convex upward.
测量 QT 与 QU 间期，避免把 U 波误并入 T 波。: Measure the QT and QU intervals; avoid mistakenly incorporating the U wave into the T wave.
电轴左偏 + II\/III\/aVF rS：考虑 LAFB。: Left axis deviation + rS in II/III/aVF: consider LAFB.
确认提前的 QRS 形态是否与窦性一致。: Confirm whether the premature QRS morphology matches the sinus QRS.
窄 QRS 规则→AVNRT\/AVRT\/房速；窄 QRS 不规则→房颤\/房: Narrow QRS regular → AVNRT/AVRT/atrial tachycardia; narrow QRS irregular → atrial fibrillation/atrial flutter with variable conduction; wide QRS → ventricular tachycardia/pre-excitation/aberrancy.
窦性心律，心房率约 82 次\/分，PR 恒定 0.18 s，每 3 个 P 波: Sinus rhythm, atrial rate about 82 beats/min, constant PR 0.18 s, 1 of every 3 P waves is non-conducted, QRS shows an RBBB pattern, consistent with second-degree type II AV block.
窦缓、窦停、窦房阻滞、慢快综合征。: Sinus bradycardia, sinus arrest, sinoatrial block, tachy-brady syndrome.
老年人常见窦缓、传导阻滞、房颤、早搏、ST-T 改变；也更容易受药物\/电解质影: Older adults commonly have sinus bradycardia, conduction block, atrial fibrillation, premature beats, and ST-T changes; they are also more susceptible to medication/electrolyte effects.
血钾 >6.5 mmol\/L，尤其伴 QRS 增宽、P 波消失或正弦波。: Serum potassium >6.5 mmol/L, especially with QRS widening, loss of P waves, or sine wave.
计算模型可探索折返、消融靶点与药物反应，但不能完全替代真实心脏。: Computational models can explore reentry, ablation targets, and drug responses, but cannot fully replace the real heart.
说明右胸导联的适应证: Explain the indications for right-sided chest leads.
起搏点位于希氏束分叉以下，QRS 宽；当窦性与室性频率接近时，出现等频房室分离、: The pacing site is below the bifurcation of the bundle of His, with a wide QRS; when sinus and ventricular rates are close, isorhythmic AV dissociation, fusion beats, or capture beats occur.
运动员、LBBB、WPW 是常见混杂因素。: Athletes, LBBB, and WPW are common confounders.
连续监测能捕捉短暂缺血；但 Holter 导联有限，不能等同 12 导联或运动试: Continuous monitoring can capture transient ischemia; however, Holter leads are limited and cannot be equated with a 12-lead ECG or exercise testing.
阿托品无效或出现高度房室阻滞：经皮起搏，或肾上腺素 2–10 μg\/min 泵: If atropine is ineffective or high-grade AV block occurs: transcutaneous pacing, or epinephrine infusion at 2–10 μg/min to maintain blood pressure and tissue perfusion.
需与后壁 MI、WPW、RBBB 鉴别。: Must be differentiated from posterior MI, WPW, and RBBB.
预激伴房颤：宽 QRS、极快且不规则心室率，是急症。: Pre-excitation with atrial fibrillation: wide QRS, extremely fast and irregular ventricular rate; it is an emergency.
首次医疗接触至导丝通过: First medical contact to guidewire crossing
高钾看 T 与 QRS；低钾看 U 与 QT；钙看 QT 长短。: For hyperkalemia, look at T waves and QRS; for hypokalemia, look at U waves and QT; for calcium, look at QT length.
18 导联：加做哪些、放在哪里: 18-lead ECG: which additional leads and where to place them
Brugada 综合征表现为右胸导联穹隆型 ST 抬高与 T 波倒置，可导致多形: Brugada syndrome presents with coved ST elevation and T-wave inversion in the right precordial leads, can cause polymorphic ventricular tachycardia/ventricular fibrillation, with a structurally normal heart.
I、aVF 均负向：极度右偏，需排除导联错接与室速。: Both I and aVF negative: extreme right axis deviation; rule out lead reversal and ventricular tachycardia.
NBG 代码用 5 个位置描述起搏心腔、感知心腔、反应方式、频率适应与多部位起搏: The NBG code uses 5 positions to describe paced chamber, sensed chamber, response mode, rate adaptation, and multisite pacing; e.g., VVI, DDD, CRT.
P′ 波形态与同导联窦性 P 不同，频率通常 150–250 次\/分。: The P′ wave morphology differs from the sinus P wave in the same lead; the rate is usually 150–250 beats/min.
QTc 延长（男 >450 ms、女 >460 ms），T 波异常；是尖端扭转型: Prolonged QTc (men >450 ms, women >460 ms) and abnormal T waves; this is the substrate for torsades de pointes.
ST 段：位于 2 相平台期，损伤电流与缺血是最常见解释。: ST segment: located in the phase 2 plateau; injury current and ischemia are the most common explanations.
V1 主要看右室与室间隔，V5\/V6 主要看左室；胸导联 R 波递增不良、V1: V1 mainly reflects the right ventricle and interventricular septum, V5/V6 mainly reflect the left ventricle; poor R-wave progression in precordial leads, tall R in V1, and deep S in V6 all have localizing significance.
WPW：短 PR、delta 波、宽 QRS。: WPW: short PR, delta wave, wide QRS.
不一致时以影像与临床为准。: When inconsistent, imaging and clinical findings take precedence.
不要用同一数据集训练与验证；AI 论文要外部验证。: Do not use the same dataset for training and validation; AI papers require external validation.
二联律时心室充盈时间与每搏量交替变化，可出现脉搏强弱交替，但不等同于交替脉。: In bigeminy, ventricular filling time and stroke volume alternate, which may cause alternating pulse strength, but this is not equivalent to pulsus alternans.
交界性逸搏心律 QRS 窄、常无 P；三度阻滞有独立窦性 P，QRS 常宽。: Junctional escape rhythm has a narrow QRS and often no P wave; third-degree block has independent sinus P waves and usually a wide QRS.
低血压、心动过缓、室性心律失常或心脏骤停。: Hypotension, bradycardia, ventricular arrhythmias, or cardiac arrest.
卒中后房颤检出率随监测时间增加。: The detection rate of atrial fibrillation after stroke increases with monitoring duration.
反复症状性交界性逸搏心律，尤其病态窦房结综合征：评估永久起搏器。: Recurrent symptomatic junctional escape rhythm, especially in sick sinus syndrome: evaluate for permanent pacemaker.
可与缺血\/心梗相似，需结合电压、动态变化与临床。: May mimic ischemia/myocardial infarction; correlate with voltage, dynamic changes, and clinical findings.
右胸导联出现继发性 ST-T 改变：ST 压低、T 波倒置，方向与 QRS 终末: Secondary ST-T changes in right precordial leads: ST depression and T-wave inversion, directed opposite to the terminal QRS vector.
在 II、aVF、V4–V6 找 PR 压低，在 aVR 找 PR 抬高。: Look for PR depression in II, aVF, and V4–V6, and PR elevation in aVR.
婴儿心率 >220、窄 QRS 规则。: Infant heart rate >220, narrow QRS, regular.
宽 QRS 不规则心动过速 + 预激病史，先按预激伴房颤处理，不要给维拉帕米。: Irregular wide-complex tachycardia + history of pre-excitation: manage initially as pre-excited atrial fibrillation; do not give verapamil.
导联脱落可产生平线，伪装成心搏停止；CPR、电刀、手机振动可产生高幅伪差。: A detached lead can produce a flat line, mimicking asystole; CPR, electrocautery, and mobile phone vibration can produce high-amplitude artifact.
左室肥厚伴劳损表现为侧壁导联 ST 段压低、T 波倒置，常呈不对称、下斜型；对应: Left ventricular hypertrophy with strain shows ST-segment depression and T-wave inversion in lateral leads, often asymmetric and downsloping; reciprocal ST elevation may occur in right precordial leads.
心内电图记录局部心肌的除极时间与电压，用于标测心律失常起源、旁路位置与消融靶点。: Intracardiac electrograms record local myocardial depolarization timing and voltage, and are used to map arrhythmia origins, accessory pathway locations, and ablation targets.
心室电活动完全紊乱，无可见 P-QRS-T，符合心室颤动；患者应无脉，立即 CP: Completely disorganized ventricular electrical activity with no visible P-QRS-T, consistent with ventricular fibrillation; the patient should be pulseless; start CPR immediately and perform unsynchronized defibrillation.
心肌与传导系统发育未成熟，间期随年龄增长；心率快时 QT 测量更困难。: The myocardium and conduction system are immature, and intervals increase with age; QT measurement is more difficult when the heart rate is fast.
急性后壁 ST 段抬高型心肌梗死: Acute posterior ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction
房室分离、心室率慢（常 <55–70 次\/分）、QRS 可窄；胎儿超声可发现心: AV dissociation, slow ventricular rate (often <55–70 bpm), QRS may be narrow; fetal ultrasound may reveal bradycardia/hydrops.
房颤伴三度房室阻滞时心室率慢而规则，可出现晕厥。: In atrial fibrillation with third-degree AV block, the ventricular rate is slow and regular, and syncope may occur.
手足抽搐、喉痉挛、癫痫或意识改变。: Tetany, laryngeal spasm, seizures, or altered consciousness.
把心房扑动伴规则心室率误认为三度阻滞：房扑的 F 波可能被误读为 P 波，需观察: Mistaking atrial flutter with a regular ventricular rate for third-degree block: flutter F waves may be misread as P waves; observe the baseline sawtooth waves and atrial rate; atrial flutter with a regular slow ventricular rate may suggest drug effect or AV block.
按急性冠脉综合征处理：心电监护、抗血小板与抗凝评估，尽快再灌注。: Manage as acute coronary syndrome: ECG monitoring, antiplatelet and anticoagulation assessment, and reperfusion as soon as possible.
新发室速、室颤或高度房室阻滞；前壁心梗易并发束支阻滞。: New-onset ventricular tachycardia, ventricular fibrillation, or high-grade AV block; anterior myocardial infarction is prone to bundle branch block.
无症状且诱因可逆者：纠正病因，停用减慢房室结传导的药物，持续监护。: Asymptomatic with reversible triggers: correct the cause, discontinue drugs that slow AV nodal conduction, and continue monitoring.
晕厥、胸痛、心悸，尤其年轻运动员或肥厚型心肌病家族史。: Syncope, chest pain, palpitations, especially in young athletes or with a family history of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.
有猝死家族史时需遗传\/专科评估。: A family history of sudden death warrants genetic/specialist evaluation.
查起搏器记录确认模式。: Check pacemaker records to confirm the mode.
每个 P 波都下传，但 PR 恒定 >0.20 s；多数无症状，重点找病因并监测: Every P wave is conducted, but the PR interval is constant >0.20 s; most are asymptomatic; focus on finding the cause and monitor for progression.
特殊高危图形：Wellens 综合征（V2–V3 深倒 T）与 De Winte: Special high-risk patterns: Wellens syndrome (deeply inverted T waves in V2–V3) and De Winter pattern (upsloping depression plus tall peaked T waves) suggest proximal left anterior descending artery occlusion.
电生理检查通过心内电极记录局部电活动并进行程序刺激，评估窦房结、房室结、旁路与心: Electrophysiology study uses intracardiac electrodes to record local electrical activity and perform programmed stimulation, assessing the sinus node, AV node, accessory pathways, and arrhythmia mechanisms.
看到“房颤负荷 2%”不要只说“很少”；要结合卒中风险与症状决定是否抗凝。: When seeing “atrial fibrillation burden 2%,” do not just say “very little”; combine stroke risk and symptoms to decide whether to anticoagulate.
程控是金标准。: Device programming/interrogation is the gold standard.
窦性心律，心房率约 88 次\/分，PR 由 0.18 s 逐搏延长至 0.34: Sinus rhythm, atrial rate about 88 bpm, PR prolongs beat by beat from 0.18 s to 0.34 s, QRS is dropped after the 4th P wave, consistent with second-degree type I AV block.
窦速是表现，不是病因；肺栓塞可表现为窦速。: Sinus tachycardia is a manifestation, not an etiology; pulmonary embolism can present with sinus tachycardia.
细颤、除颤无效、长时间缺氧——预后差，需高质量 CPR。: Fine VF, ineffective defibrillation, prolonged hypoxia—poor prognosis; high-quality CPR is required.
背出成人核心正常值: Recall the core normal adult values
若 P′ 后无 QRS，为未下传房早；若 QRS 宽大畸形，为房早伴室内差异性传: If no QRS follows P′, it is a non-conducted premature atrial contraction; if the QRS is wide and bizarre, it is a premature atrial contraction with aberrant ventricular conduction.
观察 T 波是否与 QRS 主波反向，辅助判断室性起源。: Observe whether the T wave is discordant with the main QRS deflection to help determine a ventricular origin.
记录 24–72 h，捕捉阵发性事件。: Record for 24–72 h to capture paroxysmal events.
起搏决策的边界：先处理可逆病因，再由心内科\/电生理团队评估；本文提供教学框架，: Boundaries of pacing decisions: first address reversible causes, then evaluate by the cardiology/electrophysiology team; this article provides a teaching framework and does not replace individualized clinical judgment or local guidelines.
透析快速改变钾、钙、镁与容量，影响膜电位与复极；心肌肥厚\/冠心病常见。: Dialysis rapidly changes potassium, calcium, magnesium, and volume, affecting membrane potential and repolarization; myocardial hypertrophy/coronary artery disease are common.
钾影响 T 波\/QRS，钙影响 ST\/QT，镁影响 QT\/TdP；电解质紊: Potassium affects the T wave/QRS, calcium affects ST/QT, magnesium affects QT/TdP; electrolyte disturbances often coexist and require integrated interpretation.
需与未下传房早鉴别：后者有提前的 P′ 波，且无 PR 逐搏延长。: Must be differentiated from a non-conducted PAC: the latter has an early P′ wave and no progressive PR prolongation.
静脉回流减少触发迷走张力增高，导致血管扩张与心动过缓；脑灌注下降致晕厥。: Reduced venous return triggers increased vagal tone, leading to vasodilation and bradycardia; decreased cerebral perfusion causes syncope.
高负荷 PVC 可导致心动过速性心肌病，别只当成“良性早搏”。: A high PVC burden can cause tachycardia-induced cardiomyopathy; do not regard it merely as a “benign premature beat.”
18 导联 = 12 导联 + V7–V9 + V3R–V5R；V4R 对右室梗: 18-lead = 12-lead + V7–V9 + V3R–V5R; V4R is most sensitive for right ventricular infarction.
LVH 劳损可模拟侧壁缺血，缺血也可叠加在 LVH 上；新发、动态、伴症状的 S: LVH strain can mimic lateral ischemia, and ischemia can be superimposed on LVH; new, dynamic ST-T changes accompanied by symptoms must be evaluated as ischemia.
PR 间期恒定，无进行性延长，也无 QRS 脱漏。: The PR interval is constant, with no progressive prolongation and no dropped QRS complexes.
P 波形态受导联位置、房内传导和药物影响；双房增大的心电图标准敏感性低，超声更可: P-wave morphology is affected by lead position, intra-atrial conduction, and drugs; ECG criteria for biatrial enlargement have low sensitivity, and echocardiography is more reliable.
QRS 波群多窄（<0.12 s），除非伴室内差异性传导或原有束支阻滞。: QRS complexes are usually narrow (<0.12 s), unless accompanied by intraventricular aberrant conduction or preexisting bundle branch block.
V1–V3 ST 压低、R 波增高、T 波直立提示后壁心梗；加做 V7–V9 可: ST depression in V1–V3, tall R waves, and upright T waves suggest posterior myocardial infarction; additional V7–V9 leads may show ST elevation, often coexisting with inferior infarction.
aVR 抬高是高风险信号。: aVR elevation is a high-risk signal.
三度阻滞伴晕厥者直接准备起搏。: For third-degree block with syncope, prepare for pacing directly.
不同起源的心室激动顺序产生不同 QRS 形态；体表心电图是三维激动顺序的投影。: Different ventricular activation sequences from different origins produce different QRS morphologies; the surface ECG is a projection of the three-dimensional activation sequence.
不要根据手表提示直接抗凝；确认心律、症状与卒中风险。: Do not anticoagulate directly based on a watch alert; confirm the rhythm, symptoms, and stroke risk.
二度 II 型房室阻滞：P 波按时出现、形态正常，PR 固定后突然脱漏。: Second-degree type II AV block: P waves occur on time with normal morphology, and after a fixed PR interval there is sudden dropout.
伴二度 II 型或三度房室阻滞、宽 QRS 逸搏、长间歇 >3 s。: Accompanied by second-degree type II or third-degree AV block, wide QRS escape beats, pauses >3 s.
侧壁心梗因侧壁向量丢失，向量向右偏移；导联错接（左右臂反接）也可产生“假性右偏”: Lateral myocardial infarction causes rightward axis shift due to loss of lateral vectors; lead misplacement (left/right arm reversal) can also produce "pseudo-right axis deviation."
先天性长 QT 综合征（LQTS）与获得性因素（低钾、低镁、低钙、心动过缓、药物: Congenital long QT syndrome (LQTS) and acquired factors (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia, hypocalcemia, bradycardia, drugs) can both cause it.
卒中患者的心电图有两个任务：找房颤，别漏心梗。: ECG in stroke patients has two tasks: look for atrial fibrillation and do not miss myocardial infarction.

测量 QRS 宽度、频率、规则性，寻找房室分离、夺获\/融合波。: Measure QRS width, rate, and regularity; look for AV dissociation and capture/fusion beats.
理解传导路径，才能解释为什么房室结病变产生 PR 延长、束支病变产生 QRS 增: Understanding the conduction pathway is necessary to explain why AV node disease causes PR prolongation, bundle branch disease causes QRS widening, and Purkinje disease causes intraventricular conduction delay.
电轴估计：I 与 aVF 均正为正常；I 正、aVF 负时看 II；II 负提示: Axis estimation: positive in both I and aVF is normal; when I is positive and aVF is negative, look at II; negative II suggests pathologic left axis deviation; negative I suggests right axis deviation.
看到长间歇先找前一个 T 波：可能藏着一个未下传的 P′。: When you see a long pause, first look at the preceding T wave: a non-conducted P′ may be hidden there.
稳定单形性 VT：胺碘酮或普罗帕酮（无结构性心脏病）等；寻找并纠正缺血、电解质、: Stable monomorphic VT: amiodarone or propafenone (in the absence of structural heart disease), etc.; identify and correct ischemia, electrolytes, and drugs.
窦房结与交界区起搏点均失效，或心房冲动在房室交界区被完全阻断，心室浦肯野纤维以极: Both the sinus node and junctional pacemakers have failed, or atrial impulses are completely blocked at the AV junction, and ventricular Purkinje fibers discharge passively at a very low rate.
窦速与发热\/低血压程度不相称、新发房颤、缺血性 ST 改变提示病情重；需结合乳: Sinus tachycardia disproportionate to the degree of fever/hypotension, new-onset atrial fibrillation, and ischemic ST changes suggest severe disease; lactate, infection markers, and ultrasound should be incorporated.
结合症状、药物和缺血评估；新发宽 QRS 或脱漏比例增加需升级处理。: Integrate symptoms, medications, and ischemia assessment; new-onset wide QRS or an increased proportion of dropped beats requires escalation of management.
肥厚心肌复极异常与心内膜下缺血共同导致 ST-T 改变；劳损图形通常与 QRS: Abnormal repolarization of hypertrophied myocardium and subendocardial ischemia together cause ST-T changes; strain patterns are usually opposite in direction to the main QRS deflection.
自动心率算法依赖 R 波检测阈值；高 T 波、起搏钉、伪差可触发误计数。: Automated heart rate algorithms rely on R-wave detection thresholds; tall T waves, pacing spikes, and artifacts can trigger erroneous counts.
血管迷走性晕厥是“良性但烦人”；运动中晕厥则不是它，必须查心脏。: Vasovagal syncope is “benign but annoying”; syncope during exercise is not vasovagal and mandates a cardiac workup.
解释房颤不规则\/PR 突变。: Explain atrial fibrillation irregularity/abrupt PR changes.
钙剂稳定心肌 + 降钾。: Calcium to stabilize the myocardium + lower potassium.
陈旧期（数周至数月后）：ST 段回到基线，T 波可恢复正常或持续倒置，遗留病理性: Old phase (weeks to months later): the ST segment returns to baseline, T waves may normalize or remain inverted, with residual pathological Q waves or QS waves. Q waves do not always represent transmural necrosis; correlate with imaging and history.
额面电轴是 QRS 主向量在额面的方向；先用 I 与 aVF 判断象限，再用 I: The frontal plane axis is the direction of the main QRS vector in the frontal plane; first use I and aVF to determine the quadrant, then use II to distinguish physiological left axis deviation from pathological left axis deviation.
高钾可导致宽 QRS 心动过缓\/正弦波，需查血钾。: Hyperkalemia can cause wide-QRS bradycardia/sine wave; check serum potassium.
35 岁女性，进食后全身荨麻疹、喉紧、低血压；心电图窦速、ST 压低、T 倒置。: 35-year-old woman with generalized urticaria, throat tightness, and hypotension after eating; ECG shows sinus tachycardia, ST depression, and T-wave inversion.
ARVC：右胸 T 倒置 + epsilon + LBBB 型 VT。: ARVC: right precordial T-wave inversion + epsilon waves + LBBB-type VT.
CPR 伪差高幅、节律性。: CPR artifact is high-amplitude and rhythmic.
HCM：高电压、深窄 Q、T 倒置。: HCM: high voltage, deep narrow Q waves, T-wave inversion.
I、V6 S 波时限: S-wave duration in I and V6
LQT3 与 LQT1\/2 的诱因不同；不能统一用运动诱发来筛查。: Triggers differ between LQT3 and LQT1/2; exercise provocation cannot be used uniformly for screening.
P 与 QRS 无固定关系、心室率 > 心房率、可见 P 波逐渐“穿行”；常见于: No fixed relationship between P waves and QRS complexes, ventricular rate > atrial rate, and P waves can be seen gradually "marching through"; commonly seen in VT and junctional tachycardia.
QTc 延长、T 波宽大\/双峰；运动或情绪激动诱发晕厥\/室颤；家族史常见。: Prolonged QTc, broad/bifid T waves; syncope/VF induced by exercise or emotional stress; family history is common.
QT 间期缩短，T 波低平或倒置。: Shortened QT interval, flat or inverted T waves.
RVH：电轴右偏 + 右房增大 + 右胸劳损。: RVH: right axis deviation + right atrial enlargement + right precordial strain.
V1 高 R、V6 深 S 常见。: Tall R in V1 and deep S in V6 are common.
aVR 抬高 + 广泛压低→左主干\/多支。: aVR elevation + widespread depression → left main/multivessel disease.
下壁 STEMI 伴低血压、肺清时应加做 V4R 评估右室梗死；V1–V3 ST: In inferior STEMI with hypotension and clear lungs, add V4R to assess right ventricular infarction; ST depression in V1–V3 with upright T waves should raise suspicion of posterior infarction.
不要仅凭“ST 抬高”诊断 STEMI；也不要仅凭“年轻”忽略持续胸痛与危险因素: Do not diagnose STEMI based solely on “ST elevation”; do not ignore persistent chest pain and risk factors solely because the patient is “young.”
与运动同步的高幅不规则波。: High-amplitude irregular waves synchronous with movement.
二度 I 型 PR 渐长后脱漏；二度 II 型 PR 恒定、脱漏突然。: Second-degree type I: PR progressively lengthens before a dropped beat; second-degree type II: PR remains constant with sudden dropped beats.
交界性心律是持续的交界区起搏节律，频率较慢。: Junctional rhythm is a continuous junctional pacing rhythm with a relatively slow rate.
低血压、颈静脉怒张、肺部清晰，或右心衰表现。: Hypotension, jugular venous distension, clear lungs, or signs of right heart failure.
侧壁导联 ST 下斜型压低、T 倒置。: Downsloping ST depression and T-wave inversion in lateral leads.
先找 P 波，标记其频率与规律性。: First look for P waves and mark their rate and regularity.
冲动在心室肌间缓慢传导，QRS 宽大畸形；房室分离常见，但约 30% 可有室房逆: The impulse conducts slowly through ventricular myocardium, with a wide, bizarre QRS; AV dissociation is common, but about 30% may have ventriculoatrial retrograde conduction.
判读顺序永远是：定标 → 节律 → 频率 → 间期 → 形态。: The interpretation sequence is always: calibration → rhythm → rate → intervals → morphology.
双室起搏钉后 QRS 变窄。: QRS narrows after biventricular pacing spikes.
围术期 ECG 按风险选择。: Perioperative ECG is selected according to risk.
定位前先排除左束支阻滞、预激、心室起搏、左室肥厚与心包炎等会改变 ST-T 的图: Before localization, first exclude patterns that alter ST-T, such as left bundle branch block, pre-excitation, ventricular pacing, left ventricular hypertrophy, and pericarditis; then interpret in conjunction with symptoms, troponin, and dynamic changes.
宽 QRS 心动过速：先当室速，除非有确凿证据排除。: Wide QRS tachycardia: treat as ventricular tachycardia first unless there is conclusive evidence to exclude it.
寻找诱因：贫血、感染、快速心律失常、低血压、药物依从性差。: Look for triggers: anemia, infection, tachyarrhythmia, hypotension, poor medication adherence.
左主干提示 aVR 抬高: aVR elevation suggests left main disease.
希氏束穿过纤维三角后分为左、右束支。右束支细长，易受右室压力负荷影响；左束支分为: The bundle of His passes through the fibrous triangle and then divides into the left and right bundle branches. The right bundle branch is long and thin and is susceptible to right ventricular pressure overload; the left bundle branch divides into anterior and posterior fascicles, forming the anatomical basis for left anterior/left posterior fascicular block.
年轻运动员晕厥 + 高电压 + 深 Q 波，必须想到 HCM，不能只当作“运动员: Syncope in a young athlete + high voltage + deep Q waves must raise suspicion of HCM; it should not be dismissed merely as “athlete’s heart.”
心室率约 32 次\/分的宽 QRS 节律，QRS 0.16 s，P 波缺失，T: A wide QRS rhythm with a ventricular rate of about 32 beats/min, QRS 0.16 s, absent P waves, and T waves opposite in direction to the main QRS deflection suggests an idioventricular escape rhythm.
心电向量、波形与导联理论: Theory of ECG vectors, waveforms, and leads.
心肌肌钙蛋白动态升高，符合急性心肌梗死定义。: A dynamic rise in cardiac troponin meets the definition of acute myocardial infarction.
恢复窦性后逐渐正常。: Gradually normalizes after restoration of sinus rhythm.
房扑伴可变传导时易误诊为房颤；房颤无规则 F 波，RR 绝对不规则。: Atrial flutter with variable conduction is easily misdiagnosed as atrial fibrillation; atrial fibrillation has no regular F waves, and the RR interval is absolutely irregular.
手术瘢痕与补片形成折返环路；传导系统损伤导致房室阻滞。: Surgical scars and patches form reentrant circuits; conduction system injury leads to atrioventricular block.
把粗大伪差当成 VF 而错误除颤；反之，把细颤当成停搏而漏除颤。: Mistaking coarse artifact for VF and defibrillating inappropriately; conversely, mistaking fine fibrillation for asystole and failing to defibrillate.
新发 LBBB 伴缺血症状：按 ACS 流程评估，动态心电图与肌钙蛋白，必要时冠: New-onset LBBB with ischemic symptoms: evaluate according to ACS protocol, with serial ECGs and troponin, and coronary angiography if necessary; do not give thrombolysis for LBBB alone.
有症状或频发者：首选 β 受体阻滞剂；避免在结构性心脏病中随意使用Ⅰ类抗心律失常: For symptomatic or frequent events: beta-blockers are first-line; avoid arbitrary use of class I antiarrhythmic drugs in structural heart disease.
正常成人：P 波 <0.12 s、PR 0.12–0.20 s、QRS <0.1: Normal adults: P wave <0.12 s, PR 0.12–0.20 s, QRS <0.12 s, QTc <0.44 s (men)/<0.46 s (women); heart rate 60–100 beats/min.
注意频发、多源、成对房早或房早诱发房颤，这些更具临床意义。: Pay attention to frequent, multifocal, paired atrial premature beats or atrial premature beats that trigger atrial fibrillation; these are more clinically significant.
电轴左偏短期内明显加重并伴心力衰竭，提示心肌病变进展。: Marked worsening of left axis deviation over a short period accompanied by heart failure suggests progression of myocardial disease.
症状性或进展性者准备起搏；经皮起搏桥接，必要时永久起搏。: Symptomatic or progressive patients should be prepared for pacing; use transcutaneous pacing as a bridge and, if necessary, permanent pacing.
看到 T 波和 QT，不要只想“复极异常”，要想到具体离子通道与药物；看到 QR: When you see T waves and QT, don't just think 'repolarization abnormality'; think of specific ion channels and drugs. When you see QRS widening, also ask whether it is a sodium channel or conduction system problem.
窦性心律，QT 间期缩短至约 0.28 s，ST 段缩短，T 波形态正常，符合高: Sinus rhythm, QT interval shortened to about 0.28 s, ST segment shortened, T wave morphology normal, consistent with ECG changes of hypercalcemia.
肌钙蛋白升高为 NSTEMI，正常为不稳定型心绞痛，需结合临床综合判断。: Elevated troponin indicates NSTEMI; normal troponin indicates unstable angina; need comprehensive judgment combined with clinical findings.
观察 ST 段形态是穹隆型还是马鞍型，测量 J 点抬高。: Observe whether ST segment morphology is coved or saddle-shaped, and measure J-point elevation.
远程监测数据可能有延迟\/伪差；紧急症状仍需现场评估。: Remote monitoring data may have delays/artifacts; emergency symptoms still require on-site assessment.
钉突然消失\/心率慢=感知过度或电池。: Spike suddenly disappears/slow heart rate = oversensing or battery.
除极顺序改变导致复极顺序改变：QRS 主波向上的 I、aVL、V5、V6 出现: Altered depolarization sequence leads to altered repolarization sequence: ST depression and T inversion in I, aVL, V5, V6 where the main QRS deflection is positive, and ST elevation and upright T waves in V1–V3 where the main deflection is negative, i.e., 'discordant' ST-T changes.
预激时 delta 波方向反映旁路插入心室的位置；胸导联 R 波递增不良提示前壁: During pre-excitation, the direction of the delta wave reflects the location of accessory pathway insertion into the ventricle; poor R-wave progression in precordial leads suggests anterior wall disease or lead placement problems.
高钙可增强洋地黄毒性，需询问地高辛使用。: Hypercalcemia can enhance digitalis toxicity; ask about digoxin use.
ATP 可见快速起搏钉。: ATP may show rapid pacing spikes.
LQT1 的典型场景是“游泳时晕厥”；问病史比只看 QTc 更有价值。: The typical scenario of LQT1 is “syncope while swimming”; taking a history is more valuable than just looking at the QTc.
P-QRS 频率接近但无固定 PR。: P-QRS rates are close but there is no fixed PR.
P 波一会儿一个样但心率不快，先想游走性起搏点；心率快则想多源性房速。: If P waves vary from beat to beat but the heart rate is not fast, think first of a wandering pacemaker; if the heart rate is fast, think of multifocal atrial tachycardia.
QRS 形态介于窦性与室性之间、PR 间期可变；室速中可见融合波\/夺获波，支持: QRS morphology is between sinus and ventricular, and the PR interval is variable; fusion beats/capture beats may be seen in VT, supporting VT.
T 高尖、QRS 宽、正弦波。: Tall peaked T waves, wide QRS, sine wave.
V1–V6 位于水平面，反映心室除极向量在前后、左右方向的投影；正常 R 波从: V1–V6 are in the horizontal plane and reflect the projection of the ventricular depolarization vector in the anteroposterior and left-right directions; normally the R wave gradually increases from V1 to V5, and the S wave gradually becomes shallower.
三度阻滞时 P 波仍按规律出现，只是与 QRS 分离。: In third-degree block, P waves still appear regularly, but they are dissociated from the QRS.
不要因症状不典型延误。: Do not delay because symptoms are atypical.
五导联可同时监测肢体与胸导联，但位置仍非标准 12 导联；不能把监护图形直接当成: Five-lead monitoring can simultaneously monitor limb and chest leads, but the positions are still not those of a standard 12-lead; do not directly treat the monitor tracing as a complete 12-lead diagnosis.
传导阻滞的定位可以从两个问题开始：PR 是否延长，QRS 是否增宽。PR 延长而: Localization of conduction block can begin with two questions: is the PR prolonged, and is the QRS widened. If the PR is prolonged and the QRS is narrow, the lesion is usually in the AV node; if the PR is normal and the QRS is widened with a bundle-branch pattern, the lesion is in the bundle branch; if the PR is prolonged and the QRS is also widened, the lesion may involve both the AV node and the bundle branch, or be located below the His bundle.
先天性 LQTS 是遗传性复极异常，QTc 延长、晕厥\/猝死风险；家族成员需心: Congenital LQTS is an inherited repolarization abnormality with QTc prolongation and risk of syncope/sudden death; family members need ECG and genetic screening.
先确认血钾\/血钙与白蛋白校正值。: First confirm serum potassium/calcium and albumin-corrected values.
前壁 STEMI 为相邻导联抬高加镜像压低，心包炎为弥漫抬高且无镜像。: Anterior STEMI shows elevation in adjacent leads plus reciprocal depression, whereas pericarditis shows diffuse elevation without reciprocal changes.
右室梗死时右室充盈依赖容量，硝酸酯\/利尿剂可导致严重低血压；下壁常由右冠闭塞。: In right ventricular infarction, RV filling is volume-dependent; nitrates/diuretics can cause severe hypotension; inferior infarction is often due to right coronary artery occlusion.
同时评估出血风险与患者偏好。: Assess both bleeding risk and patient preference.
孤立的 LAFB 本身无需治疗，处理基础疾病与心血管危险因素即可。: Isolated LAFB itself requires no treatment; management of underlying disease and cardiovascular risk factors is sufficient.
室早联律间期不固定、异位间期有公约数、融合波；异位频率通常 20–40 次\/分: PVC coupling intervals are variable, ectopic intervals have a common divisor, and fusion beats occur; ectopic rate is usually 20–40 beats/min.
小儿心肌炎可表现为窦速、低电压、ST-T 改变、心律失常、QRS 增宽；暴发性心: Pediatric myocarditis may present with sinus tachycardia, low voltage, ST-T changes, arrhythmias, and QRS widening; fulminant myocarditis can rapidly cause heart failure/shock.
左房增大：P 宽、双峰，V1 终末负向增大。: Left atrial enlargement: broad, notched P waves, with an enlarged terminal negative deflection in V1.
常见于结构性心脏病、慢性肺病、洋地黄中毒、低钾、心肌炎；也可见于无结构性心脏病者: Commonly seen in structural heart disease, chronic lung disease, digitalis toxicity, hypokalemia, and myocarditis; it can also occur in individuals without structural heart disease.
异常 Q 波可不代表梗死。: Abnormal Q waves do not necessarily indicate infarction.
心悸时心电图正常很常见；需要事件记录器\/可穿戴设备，不能一次正常就结束。: A normal ECG during palpitations is common; event recorders/wearable devices are needed, and a single normal ECG should not end the evaluation.
心电图异常往往不止一个；系统化阅读把“图形”转化为结构化报告，减少遗漏。: ECG abnormalities are often multiple; systematic reading converts "patterns" into a structured report and reduces omissions.
心衰合并窦性心律、QRS ≥150 ms、EF ≤35% 的 LBBB 是 CR: In heart failure with sinus rhythm, QRS ≥150 ms, and EF ≤35%, LBBB is a strong indication for CRT; QRS 120–149 ms requires individualized consideration.
房室分离、夺获搏动、融合波支持室速，但敏感性有限。: AV dissociation, capture beats, and fusion beats support VT, but sensitivity is limited.
把 2:1 阻滞直接归为二度 I 型或 II 型：单凭 2:1 无法分型，需结合: Classifying 2:1 block directly as second-degree type I or type II: 2:1 alone cannot determine the type; it requires correlation with QRS width, whether the PR interval is fixed, response to activity or drugs, and electrophysiologic study when necessary.
把测量值与临床背景结合，不用单一数字替代整体判断。: Integrate measurements with the clinical context; do not substitute a single number for overall judgment.
数据量与依从性是挑战。: Data volume and adherence are challenges.
早期复极的“良性”是概率，不是保证；有晕厥\/家族猝死时需电生理评估。: The "benign" nature of early repolarization is a probability, not a guarantee; electrophysiologic evaluation is needed when there is syncope/family history of sudden death.
术后房扑\/房速常见。: Postoperative atrial flutter/atrial tachycardia is common.
正常传导顺序保证心房收缩先于心室，PR 间期与 QRS 时限处于生理范围内。: Normal conduction sequence ensures atrial contraction precedes ventricular contraction, and the PR interval and QRS duration are within physiologic ranges.
测量代偿间歇是否完全。: Measure whether the compensatory pause is complete.
电压受体型、传导、阻抗影响。: Voltage is affected by body habitus, conduction, and impedance.
相邻导联 ST 压低 ≥0.05–0.1 mV、T 波倒置、动态变化；aVR S: ST depression ≥0.05–0.1 mV in adjacent leads, T-wave inversion, dynamic changes; aVR ST elevation suggests left main/multivessel disease.
窄 QRS 规则：迷走→腺苷。: Narrow QRS regular: vagal maneuvers → adenosine.
窦性心律，心率约 72 次\/分，PR 0.16 s，QRS 0.08 s，电轴: Sinus rhythm, heart rate about 72 beats/min, PR 0.16 s, QRS 0.08 s, normal axis, no ST-T abnormalities seen.
胎儿监护的核心是“模式与背景”，不是单个心率数字。: The core of fetal monitoring is "pattern and background," not a single heart rate number.
自身心房活动可触发心室起搏。: Intrinsic atrial activity can trigger ventricular pacing.
血钾正常不能排除组织间钾升高；临床与心电图需综合判断。: Normal serum potassium cannot exclude elevated interstitial potassium; clinical and ECG findings must be interpreted together.
记录器不能治疗心律失常；发现异常后仍需评估病因与治疗。: A recorder cannot treat arrhythmias; after an abnormality is detected, the cause and treatment still need to be evaluated.
运动员、年轻人可生理性高电压。: Athletes and young people may have physiologic high voltage.
适应证：反复不明原因晕厥、心悸、隐匿性癫痫\/卒中；ILR 电池可维持数年。: Indications: recurrent unexplained syncope, palpitations, occult epilepsy/stroke; the ILR battery can last for several years.
避免常规使用利多卡因或胺碘酮等抗心律失常药，可能抑制心室起搏点，导致停搏或诱发室: Avoid routine use of antiarrhythmic drugs such as lidocaine or amiodarone; they may suppress ventricular pacemaker sites, causing asystole or inducing ventricular fibrillation.
阿托品无效时首选经皮起搏，或肾上腺素 2–10 μg\/min 泵入维持灌注，并: When atropine is ineffective, first choice is transcutaneous pacing, or epinephrine infusion at 2–10 μg/min to maintain perfusion, and prepare for transvenous pacing.
预激合并房扑\/房颤时，冲动可经旁路快速下传，有室颤风险，禁用单纯房室结阻滞剂。: In pre-excitation with atrial flutter/atrial fibrillation, impulses can conduct rapidly via the accessory pathway, with risk of ventricular fibrillation; pure AV nodal blockers are contraindicated.
验证与监管重要。: Validation and regulatory oversight are important.
80 岁心衰患者，恶心、视物发黄；心电图房速伴 2:1 阻滞、室早，血钾 5.8: An 80-year-old heart failure patient with nausea and yellow vision; ECG shows atrial tachycardia with 2:1 block, premature ventricular contractions, serum potassium 5.8, poor renal function.
CPVT 是运动\/情绪诱发的双向性或多形性室速，静息心电图常正常；多见于儿童\: CPVT is exercise/emotion-induced bidirectional or polymorphic ventricular tachycardia; resting ECG is often normal; mostly seen in children/young adults.
I 导联为左臂-右臂，II 为左腿-右臂，III 为左腿-左臂；aVR、aVL、: Lead I is left arm–right arm, II is left leg–right arm, III is left leg–left arm; aVR, aVL, aVF are augmented unipolar leads.
NSTEMI 的心电图可能“不夸张”，但风险不低；动态复查与肌钙蛋白是关键。: The ECG in NSTEMI may be 'unremarkable,' but the risk is not low; serial follow-up and troponin are key.
P 与 QRS 无固定关系: No fixed relationship between P waves and QRS complexes
P 波高尖也可见于低钾\/先心病。: Tall peaked P waves can also be seen in hypokalemia/congenital heart disease.
QT 在 II 或 V5 导联测量，T 波终点用切线法；房颤、束支阻滞、起搏心律: Measure QT in lead II or V5, using the tangent method for the end of the T wave; QT interpretation is limited in atrial fibrillation, bundle branch block, and paced rhythms.
V1 高 R 的常见原因：右室肥厚、后壁心肌梗死、WPW A 型、RBBB、肥厚: Common causes of tall R in V1: right ventricular hypertrophy, posterior myocardial infarction, WPW type A, RBBB, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, normal variant.
三度房室阻滞伴晕厥者直接准备起搏，不要用单纯阿托品替代起搏。: For third-degree AV block with syncope, prepare for pacing directly; do not substitute atropine alone for pacing.
亚急性期：ST 回落、T 深倒置、Q 波持续。: Subacute phase: ST segment resolves, deep T-wave inversion, persistent Q waves.
任何一层改变都会体现在最终曲线上：钠通道阻滞改变动作电位上升支，传导阻滞改变激动: Any layer of change will be reflected in the final waveform: sodium channel blockade alters the action potential upstroke, conduction block alters the activation sequence, myocardial hypertrophy alters the magnitude and direction of vectors, and electrode position determines "from which angle" it is viewed.
低通\/高通滤波、基线校正与自动增益可改变 ST 段与 QRS 形态；不同设备设: Low-pass/high-pass filtering, baseline correction, and automatic gain can alter the ST segment and QRS morphology; different device settings may cause "pseudo ST elevation/depression."
偶发无症状：观察，纠正诱因即可。: Occasional asymptomatic: observe and correct triggers.
前壁 STEMI 有相邻导联 ST 抬高与下壁镜像压低，LBBB 为不一致性抬高: Anterior STEMI has ST elevation in adjacent leads and reciprocal depression in inferior leads; LBBB has discordant elevation and no reciprocity.
卒中患者 ST 抬高需按 ACS 评估，不能都归为脑心综合征；同时寻找房颤。: ST elevation in stroke patients should be evaluated as ACS and not all attributed to cerebrocardiac syndrome; also look for atrial fibrillation.
发热 + 晕厥 + V1 穹隆型 ST，先按 Brugada 处理，不要只当热性: Fever + syncope + coved-type ST in V1: manage as Brugada first, do not treat only as febrile seizure.
可发生多形性室速\/室颤，常在夜间或休息时发作。: Polymorphic VT/VF can occur, often at night or at rest.
合并主动脉瓣狭窄、心肌病等按指南处理；避免使用可能加重传导阻滞的药物。: Manage comorbid aortic stenosis, cardiomyopathy, etc. according to guidelines; avoid drugs that may worsen conduction block.
在 I、aVL 找 qR，在下壁导联找 rS，确认“上左向量”模式。: Look for qR in I, aVL and rS in inferior leads to confirm "superior-left vector" pattern.
多导联比单导联更能识别 P 波与 ST 改变；但佩戴依从性、数据量与报警管理是挑: Multi-lead is better than single-lead for identifying P waves and ST changes; however, wearing compliance, data volume, and alarm management are challenges.
室性并行：联律间期多变 + 公约数。: Ventricular parasystole: variable coupling interval + common divisor.
宽 QRS 心动过速中出现融合波，支持室速；但融合波消失不能排除室速。: Fusion beats during wide QRS tachycardia support VT; however, absence of fusion beats cannot exclude VT.
导联轴的方向决定同一心电向量在不同导联上的振幅与极性；这就是为什么 II 与 a: Direction of lead axis determines amplitude and polarity of the same cardiac vector in different leads; this is why II and aVR often point in opposite directions.
左束支阻滞：QRS ≥120 ms，V1 呈 QS 或 rS，V6 呈宽大 R: Left bundle branch block: QRS ≥120 ms, QS or rS in V1, broad R wave without q wave in V6, and broad R in I/aVL as well. LBBB can mask infarction patterns and should be assessed using Sgarbossa or modified criteria; new-onset LBBB with ischemic symptoms should be evaluated via STEMI pathway.
常见设计：诊断准确性、预后队列、随机试验、回顾性数据库；需避免数据泄漏与过拟合。: Common designs: diagnostic accuracy, prognostic cohort, randomized trial, retrospective database; need to avoid data leakage and overfitting.
心室肥厚常伴继发性复极异常：ST 段与 T 波方向与 QRS 主波相反，称为“劳: Ventricular hypertrophy often accompanied by secondary repolarization abnormalities: ST segment and T wave direction opposite to main QRS wave, called "strain pattern" changes.
心率 <40 次\/分，或出现低血压、意识改变、晕厥、胸痛、心力衰竭。: Heart rate <40 beats/min, or hypotension, altered consciousness, syncope, chest pain, heart failure.
心肌炎心电图可模拟心梗；儿童胸痛\/心衰 + 病毒前驱史需警惕。: Myocarditis ECG can mimic MI; in children, chest pain/heart failure + viral prodrome warrants vigilance.
房早伴室内差异性传导时可出现宽 QRS，容易与室早混淆；未下传时则只剩 P 波。: Premature atrial contractions with aberrant intraventricular conduction can produce a wide QRS and are easily confused with premature ventricular contractions; when nonconducted, only a P wave remains. Consecutive nonconducted PACs can produce paired or short-run atrial tachycardia-like patterns and must be differentiated from atrial tachycardia with AV block.
把 Brugada 波误认为右束支阻滞或正常变异。: Mistaking a Brugada wave for right bundle branch block or a normal variant.
把电轴与分支阻滞\/心室肥厚联系: Relating axis to fascicular block/ventricular hypertrophy
新发晕厥\/跌倒、房颤、长间歇、三度 AVB、QT 延长需要重视；老化可解释部分: New-onset syncope/falls, atrial fibrillation, long pauses, third-degree AVB, and QT prolongation require attention; aging can explain some changes but not all.
无脉\/不稳定：立即非同步除颤，按心脏骤停流程处理；不要使用同步电复律。: Pulseless/unstable: immediate asynchronous defibrillation and manage per cardiac arrest protocol; do not use synchronized cardioversion.
晕厥反复、Holter 正常时，ILR 比反复住院更能抓到“那一刻”。: With recurrent syncope and a normal Holter, an ILR is better than repeated hospitalizations for capturing “that moment.”
有脉不稳定快速心律：同步电复律；房颤 120–200 J，房扑\/SVT 50–: Unstable tachyarrhythmia with a pulse: synchronized cardioversion; AF 120–200 J, atrial flutter/SVT 50–100 J, monomorphic VT 100 J.
检查导线阻抗、阈值、电池。: Check lead impedance, threshold, and battery.
洋地黄中毒的“背景音乐”常是交界性早搏\/交界性心动过速。: The “background music” of digitalis toxicity is often junctional premature beats/junctional tachycardia.
用 50 mm\/s 的图纸按 25 mm\/s 读数，会把间期算短一半。: Reading a 50 mm/s tracing at 25 mm/s will halve the calculated intervals.
症状性心动过缓可试用阿托品 1 mg 静脉推注，每 3–5 分钟重复，最大 3: For symptomatic bradycardia, atropine 1 mg IV push may be tried, repeated every 3–5 minutes, up to a maximum of 3 mg; however, it is often ineffective in third-degree block and cannot replace pacing.
看到宽 QRS 就诊断室速而忽略预激、高钾、药物。: Diagnosing VT on seeing a wide QRS and ignoring pre-excitation, hyperkalemia, and drugs.
稳定患者：按肺栓塞危险分层抗凝（低分子肝素\/直接口服抗凝药）。: Stable patients: anticoagulate according to pulmonary embolism risk stratification (LMWH/direct oral anticoagulants).
窦性心律，心率约 42 次\/分，PR 0.18 s，QRS 窄，未见 P 波脱: Sinus rhythm, heart rate about 42 beats/min, PR 0.18 s, narrow QRS, no dropped P waves.
立即启动 STEMI 再灌注：首选急诊 PCI，无法及时 PCI 时考虑溶栓。: Immediately initiate STEMI reperfusion: emergency PCI is preferred; consider thrombolysis when timely PCI is not available.
结合劳损、左房增大与超声。: Correlate with strain pattern, left atrial enlargement, and echocardiography.
缺血性卒中后房颤检出率随监测时间增加；ST 改变可能来自卒中本身或合并冠心病。: After ischemic stroke, the detection rate of atrial fibrillation increases with monitoring duration; ST changes may originate from the stroke itself or from concomitant coronary artery disease.
胸导联异常先确认位置与导联错接，再谈病理；V1 高 R 不等于右室肥厚。: For abnormal precordial leads, first confirm lead position and misconnection before discussing pathology; a tall R in V1 does not equal right ventricular hypertrophy.
若频率过快、血压下降或退化为室速\/室颤，按室速或心脏骤停处理，必要时同步电复律: If the rate is too fast, blood pressure drops, or it degenerates into ventricular tachycardia/ventricular fibrillation, manage as ventricular tachycardia or cardiac arrest, with synchronized cardioversion or defibrillation if necessary.
观察发作是否短阵、是否与窦性频率竞争。: Observe whether the episodes are short-lived and whether they compete with the sinus rate.
过敏反应优先肾上腺素。: For anaphylaxis, epinephrine is the priority.
逐搏寻找 QRS 前后的 P 波，特别是 QRS 终末部的伪 r′ 或伪 s 波: Look beat by beat for P waves before and after the QRS, especially pseudo-r′ or pseudo-s waves at the end of the QRS.
钾改变静息膜电位与复极速度；高钾先兴奋后抑制，低钾延长复极并增加兴奋性。: Potassium alters the resting membrane potential and repolarization velocity; hyperkalemia first excites then depresses, while hypokalemia prolongs repolarization and increases excitability.
额面向量→肢体导联，水平面向量→胸导联。: Frontal plane vector → limb leads; horizontal plane vector → precordial leads.
高钙 QT 短；低钙 QT 长；低镁 TdP。: Hypercalcemia shortens QT; hypocalcemia lengthens QT; hypomagnesemia causes TdP.
18 导联 = 常规 12 导联 + V7–V9（后壁）+ V3R–V5R（右室: 18 leads = standard 12 leads + V7–V9 (posterior wall) + V3R–V5R (right ventricle). V7 is at the 5th intercostal space on the left posterior axillary line, V8 at the left midscapular line, and V9 at the left paravertebral line, all at the same level as V4–V6; V3R–V5R are placed symmetrically on the right chest relative to V3–V5.
CRT 心电图不能仅凭 QRS 变窄判断疗效；需超声、临床与起搏器参数综合评估。: CRT efficacy cannot be judged by QRS narrowing on ECG alone; it requires comprehensive assessment with echocardiography, clinical status, and pacemaker parameters.
ICD 患者发生电击后，需评估意识、心律、诱因与设备；反复电击可能是电风暴。: After an ICD shock, assess consciousness, rhythm, triggers, and the device; repeated shocks may indicate electrical storm.
LBBB 也表现为左室高电压与宽 QRS，但 QRS ≥0.12 s、侧壁无 Q: LBBB also presents with left ventricular high voltage and wide QRS, but QRS ≥0.12 s and no Q waves in lateral leads.
LVH 可有侧壁 ST 压低与 T 倒置（劳损型），无勺状形态。: LVH may have lateral ST depression and T-wave inversion (strain pattern), without a scooped morphology.
PSVT 的“突发突止”比频率更有辨识度。: The abrupt onset and termination of PSVT are more distinctive than the rate.
P 波形态还受房内传导阻滞、洋地黄、低钾和导联位置影响；不能把 P 波改变简单等: P-wave morphology is also affected by intra-atrial conduction block, digitalis, hypokalemia, and lead position; P-wave changes cannot be simply equated with atrial size.
V1–V3 呈 rS 或 QS，S 波深而宽，R 波递增不良；电轴可正常或左偏。: V1–V3 show rS or QS complexes, with deep and wide S waves and poor R-wave progression; the axis may be normal or leftward.
一个 AI ECG 模型在单中心很准，不代表能用于另一个医院；外部验证是关键。: An AI ECG model being very accurate at a single center does not mean it can be used at another hospital; external validation is key.
三度阻滞时 P 与 QRS 分离，心室率慢但 P 频率正常。: In third-degree block, P waves and QRS complexes are dissociated; the ventricular rate is slow but the P-wave rate is normal.
不要根据监护仪数字给抗心律失常药；先手动数 RR 或听诊。: Do not give antiarrhythmic drugs based on monitor numbers; first manually count the RR interval or auscultate.
交感激活、低灌注、炎症介质与电解质紊乱共同影响心肌电活动；脓毒症心肌病可致 ST: Sympathetic activation, hypoperfusion, inflammatory mediators, and electrolyte disturbances jointly affect myocardial electrical activity; septic cardiomyopathy can cause ST-T changes.
低体温、电解质紊乱、药物中毒等特殊病因需同步处理。: Special causes such as hypothermia, electrolyte disturbances, and drug poisoning must be treated concurrently.
侧壁：I、aVL、V5、V6；高侧壁以 I、aVL 为主。: Lateral wall: I, aVL, V5, V6; high lateral wall mainly I and aVL.
先心病术后常见房扑\/房速、房室阻滞、室速；Mustard\/Senning 术: After congenital heart disease surgery, atrial flutter/atrial tachycardia, atrioventricular block, and ventricular tachycardia are common; after the Mustard/Senning procedure, the risk of atrial flutter is high, and after tetralogy of Fallot repair, the risk of ventricular tachycardia is high.
先问“这个搏动是提前还是迟到”，再问“它是谁发出的”；这一顺序能避免把逸搏误当早: First ask “is this beat early or late,” then ask “where is it coming from”; this sequence helps avoid mistaking an escape beat for a premature beat.
前有 P、PR 合适。: Preceded by a P wave, with an appropriate PR interval.
单个导联异常、其他导联正常；轻压\/重新贴电极后恢复；患者生命体征与波形不一致。: A single lead is abnormal while other leads are normal; it resolves after gentle pressure/reapplying the electrode; the patient's vital signs are inconsistent with the waveform.
只看 QRS 宽度：部分 VT 可相对窄，部分 SVT 伴束支阻滞可宽。: Looking only at QRS width: some VTs can be relatively narrow, and some SVTs with bundle branch block can be wide.
可除颤心律的典型代表。: A typical representative of a shockable rhythm.
右心负荷提示高风险。: Right heart strain indicates high risk.
后壁：V7–V9 抬高；V1–V3 镜像压低、高 R、直立 T。: Posterior wall: V7–V9 elevation; V1–V3 reciprocal depression, tall R, upright T.
基础与临床整合仍是核心。: Integration of basics and clinical practice remains central.
宽 QRS 心动过速鉴别之一。: One of the differential diagnoses of wide QRS tachycardia.
小儿心肌炎：窦速、低电压、ST-T、心律失常。: Pediatric myocarditis: sinus tachycardia, low voltage, ST-T changes, arrhythmias.
常见于 COPD\/心衰\/电解质紊乱。: Commonly seen in COPD/heart failure/electrolyte disturbances.
心内电图解读依赖术者经验与电生理知识；不能把单点电位直接等同于心律失常机制。: Interpretation of intracardiac electrograms depends on operator experience and electrophysiologic knowledge; a single-point potential cannot be directly equated with the arrhythmia mechanism.
心电成像的“漂亮三维图”不等于临床可用的靶点；需验证。: A "beautiful 3D map" from electroanatomic imaging does not equal a clinically usable target; validation is required.
怀疑导联错接时重新做图并核对电极位置。: When lead misconnection is suspected, repeat the ECG and verify electrode positions.
房室旁路绕过房室结，提前激动部分心室肌，形成 delta 波；心室除极由旁路与正: An AV bypass tract bypasses the AV node, pre-excites part of the ventricular myocardium, and forms a delta wave; ventricular depolarization results from fusion of conduction via the bypass tract and the normal conduction system.
手术应激、麻醉、液体 shifts、电解质变化可诱发心律失常\/缺血；基线 EC: Surgical stress, anesthesia, fluid shifts, and electrolyte changes can induce arrhythmias/ischemia; a baseline ECG is useful for comparison.
把电轴与左前分支阻滞、右室肥厚、下壁\/侧壁心梗联系起来: Link the axis to left anterior fascicular block, right ventricular hypertrophy, and inferior/lateral myocardial infarction.
按顺序复述“离子通道 → 动作电位 → 空间向量 → 导联投影”: Recite in order: "ion channels → action potential → spatial vectors → lead projections."
新生儿高钾可因溶血、肾功能不全、肾上腺皮质增生、标本溶血等；心电图 T 高尖、Q: Neonatal hyperkalemia can be due to hemolysis, renal insufficiency, adrenal hyperplasia, sample hemolysis, etc.; ECG shows tall peaked T waves, wide QRS, and sine wave.
最具特异性的是“I 与 aVF 导联 QRS 主波方向组合”：I 正、aVF 正: The most specific is the "combination of QRS main wave directions in leads I and aVF": I positive and aVF positive is normal; I positive, aVF negative, and II negative is left axis deviation; I negative is right axis deviation.
有症状或长间歇：阿托品可试用，但病态窦房结综合征常反应不佳；准备经皮起搏。: Symptomatic or long pauses: atropine may be tried, but sick sinus syndrome often responds poorly; prepare for transcutaneous pacing.
测量 QRS 宽度；超过 0.12 s 需考虑合并 RBBB 或其他原因。: Measure QRS width; if > 0.12 s, consider concomitant RBBB or other causes.
电磁场被导线拾取，尤其在高阻抗\/长导线时；现代设备屏蔽较好但仍可能干扰。: Electromagnetic fields are picked up by leads, especially with high impedance/long leads; modern equipment is better shielded but interference can still occur.
直接 PCI 为首选，目标首次医疗接触至导丝通过 ≤120 分钟；不能及时 PC: Primary PCI is preferred, with a target of ≤120 minutes from first medical contact to wire crossing; evaluate thrombolysis when timely PCI is not available.
看电轴（右偏→RVH；左偏→后壁 MI\/WPW）、看 ST-T（后壁 MI V: Assess axis (right axis deviation → RVH; left axis deviation → posterior MI/WPW), assess ST-T (posterior MI shows depression in V1–V3), and assess delta wave and PR.
确认 P 波是否消失，V1 导联最易看到 f 波。: Confirm whether P waves are absent; f waves are easiest to see in lead V1.
窦性停搏为 P 波消失的长间歇，不是渐进的 RR 变异。: Sinus arrest is a long pause with absent P waves, not progressive RR variation.
紧急症状不能等传输。: Emergency symptoms cannot wait for transmission.
缺血时为什么 ST 段会偏移: Why the ST segment shifts during ischemia
胰岛素+葡萄糖、透析降钾。: Insulin + glucose, dialysis to lower potassium.
证明房室传导并非完全阻断。: Demonstrates that AV conduction is not completely blocked.
起搏器通过感知心房率判断房性心律失常，自动切换模式以保护心室率；心电图可显示起搏: The pacemaker detects atrial arrhythmias by sensing the atrial rate and automatically switches modes to protect the ventricular rate; the ECG can show changes in pacing mode.
运动试验诱发双向性室速（QRS 轴逐搏交替）或多形性室速；静息 QTc 正常；晕: Exercise testing induces bidirectional VT (QRS axis alternating beat-to-beat) or polymorphic VT; resting QTc is normal; family history of syncope/sudden death.
逸搏频率：房室交界区约 40–60 次\/分，心室约 20–40 次\/分；逸搏: Escape rates: AV junctional about 40–60 beats/min, ventricular about 20–40 beats/min; escape beats indicate upstream failure but are themselves a protective mechanism.
青少年情绪性“抽搐”，查心电图；LQTS 被误诊癫痫并不罕见。: In adolescents with emotional “convulsions,” perform an ECG; LQTS misdiagnosed as epilepsy is not uncommon.
颈动脉窦综合征：诱因 + 按摩阳性。: Carotid sinus syndrome: trigger + positive carotid sinus massage.
高危（休克\/低血压）：全身溶栓或导管\/手术取栓，必要时 ECMO。: High risk (shock/hypotension): systemic thrombolysis or catheter-directed/surgical thrombectomy; ECMO if necessary.
高钾降低静息电位、加快复极，早期 T 波高尖，严重时 QRS 增宽、P 波消失、: Hyperkalemia lowers the resting membrane potential and accelerates repolarization; early tall peaked T waves, and in severe cases QRS widening, loss of P waves, and sine wave; hypokalemia prolongs repolarization, with ST depression, flattened T waves, and U waves.
28 岁跑者，高温运动后意识障碍、体温 41°C；心电图宽 QRS、T 高尖，血: A 28-year-old runner with altered consciousness and body temperature 41°C after exercising in heat; ECG shows wide QRS and tall peaked T waves, serum potassium 6.5.
AAI：心房起搏，钉后 P 波。: AAI: atrial pacing, P wave after the spike.
Brugada 标准在预激性心动过速中可靠性下降。: The Brugada criteria have reduced reliability in pre-excited tachycardia.
Holter 连续记录 24–72 小时心电图，用于捕捉阵发性心律失常、评估负荷: Holter continuously records ECG for 24–72 hours to capture paroxysmal arrhythmias and assess burden and ST-segment trends; it cannot replace 12-lead diagnosis.
I、aVL 呈 qR 型（小 q、高 R）；II、III、aVF 呈 rS 型（: Leads I and aVL show qR pattern (small q, tall R); leads II, III, and aVF show rS pattern (small r, deep S).
MAT 的治疗以纠正诱因、控制心率为主；不宜盲目复律。: Treatment of MAT mainly involves correcting triggers and controlling heart rate; blind cardioversion is not advisable.
PR 段压低（II、aVF、V4–V6），aVR PR 段抬高；可见 Spodi: PR-segment depression (II, aVF, V4–V6), PR-segment elevation in aVR; Spodick sign may be seen.
P 波缺失，或窦性 P 与 QRS 分离；可见室性融合波或夺获波。: Absent P waves, or sinus P waves dissociated from QRS; ventricular fusion beats or capture beats may be seen.
STEMI 导联定位与罪犯血管: STEMI lead localization and culprit vessel
VVI 单腔心室；AAI 单腔心房；DDD 双腔。: VVI single-chamber ventricular; AAI single-chamber atrial; DDD dual-chamber.
一度、无症状二度 I 型：多数可观察，先处理病因。: First-degree and asymptomatic type I second-degree AV block: most can be observed; treat the underlying cause first.
三度：P 与 QRS 分离，房率>室率。: Third-degree: P waves and QRS complexes are dissociated; atrial rate > ventricular rate.

低钾伴尖端扭转、室速或洋地黄中毒。: Hypokalemia with torsades de pointes, ventricular tachycardia, or digitalis toxicity.

45 岁男性，突发偏瘫；窦性心律，Holter 24 小时未见房颤，超声正常。: A 45-year-old man with sudden hemiplegia; sinus rhythm, 24-hour Holter showed no atrial fibrillation, and echocardiography was normal.

RBBB：V1 rsR′、V6 宽钝 S；LBBB：V1 QS\/rS、V6 宽: RBBB: rsR′ in V1 and broad slurred S in V6; LBBB: QS/rS in V1, broad R in V6, no q wave. QRS is ≥120 ms in both.

一个窦性搏动后跟一个室早，周而复始；成对出现时听诊可似“二音律”。: One sinus beat followed by one premature ventricular contraction, repeating continuously; when they occur in pairs, auscultation may resemble a “two-tone rhythm.”
下壁心梗不是“只做 12 导联”就结束；临床不稳定时，扩展导联能改变处理方向。: Inferior myocardial infarction does not end with “just a 12-lead ECG”; when the patient is clinically unstable, extended leads can change the direction of management.
不要只凭“心率 <60”诊断病态窦房结综合征；运动员与睡眠中的 40–50 次\: Do not diagnose sick sinus syndrome based solely on a “heart rate <60”; 40–50 beats/min in athletes and during sleep can be normal.
两个起搏点频率相近但独立，形成“看似有关系、实际分离”的现象。: Two pacemakers have similar rates but are independent, creating a phenomenon that “appears related but is actually dissociated.”
二度 I 型房室传导阻滞是房室结传导逐渐延迟，PR 间期逐搏延长，直至一个心房冲: Second-degree type I AV block is progressive delay in AV nodal conduction, with the PR interval lengthening beat by beat until an atrial impulse fails to conduct and a QRS is dropped; the PR then shortens and a new cycle begins. The dropped beat makes the ventricular rate lower than the atrial rate; typical cases show 4:3 or 3:2 conduction, the QRS is usually narrow, and it is mostly intranodal AV block, often related to increased vagal tone or drugs.
交界性逸搏心律，心室率约 48 次\/分，QRS 0.08 s，窦性 P 波消失: Junctional escape rhythm, ventricular rate about 48 beats/min, QRS 0.08 s, absent sinus P waves, and retrograde P waves visible after the QRS.

冲动经房室结下传，QRS 多窄；房室结的生理性过滤可形成 2:1 或可变比例传导: Impulses conduct down through the AV node, and the QRS is usually narrow; physiological filtering by the AV node can produce 2:1 or variable-ratio conduction, making the ventricular rate lower than the atrial rate.
前壁 STEMI 为 ST 抬高而非压低，并伴下壁镜像改变。: Anterior STEMI shows ST elevation rather than depression, with reciprocal changes in the inferior leads.
劳损型 ST-T 与 QRS 主波方向相反。: Strain-pattern ST-T changes are opposite in direction to the main QRS deflection.
反复低氧与迷走张力增高导致夜间心动过缓\/停搏；交感激活与胸腔压力变化促发房颤。: Recurrent hypoxia and increased vagal tone cause nocturnal bradycardia/pauses; sympathetic activation and changes in intrathoracic pressure precipitate atrial fibrillation.
右室梗死与后壁梗死常同源于右冠，附加导联一起评估。: Right ventricular infarction and posterior infarction often both arise from the right coronary artery and should be assessed together with additional leads.
