房颤心室率不规则。: Irregular ventricular rate in atrial fibrillation.
报告不要写“建议进一步检查”就结束；要说明“怀疑什么、多紧急、下一步做什么”。: Do not end the report with “suggest further examination” alone; state “what is suspected, how urgent it is, and what to do next.”
提前出现的 QRS 波群，时限 ≥0.12 s，形态宽大畸形。: Premature QRS complex, duration ≥0.12 s, wide and bizarre in morphology.
新生儿三度 AVB 是急症；心率 <55 或灌注差需立即起搏\/转诊。: Third-degree AVB in a neonate is an emergency; if heart rate <55 or perfusion is poor, immediate pacing/referral is required.
无脉、低血压、意识丧失、胸痛、心衰——立即 CPR\/电复律。: Pulselessness, hypotension, loss of consciousness, chest pain, heart failure—immediate CPR/cardioversion.
晚钠电流；QT 显著延长。: Late sodium current; markedly prolonged QT.
未下传房早为单个提前 P′ 后无 QRS，不是规律性周期脱漏。: A non-conducted premature atrial contraction is a single early P′ with no following QRS, not regular cyclic dropout.
检查灵敏度、导线、电磁环境。: Check sensitivity, leads, and electromagnetic environment.
洋地黄效应本身无需停药，但需评估是否中毒。: Digitalis effect itself does not require drug discontinuation, but toxicity must be assessed.
用 II 区分正常与左偏: Use lead II to distinguish normal from left axis deviation
电解质异常的心电图改变不是线性的，必须结合化验。: ECG changes of electrolyte abnormalities are not linear and must be interpreted with laboratory tests.
症状明显者可试用 β 受体阻滞剂；频发且症状严重者转诊心内科。: For patients with obvious symptoms, a β-blocker may be tried; for frequent and severe symptoms, refer to cardiology.
窦性心律，心率约 50 次\/分，P 波低平，PR 延长，QRS 增宽，T 波高: Sinus rhythm, heart rate about 50 beats/min, flattened P waves, prolonged PR, widened QRS, tall peaked symmetrical T waves, consistent with ECG changes of hyperkalemia.
结合程控与起搏器记录。: Correlate with device programming and pacemaker records.
罕见；常伴严重心房病变。: Rare; often accompanied by severe atrial disease.
融合波=两种激动同时心室。: Fusion beat = two impulses activating the ventricles simultaneously.
观察频率是否随呼吸、疼痛或体位变化，支持窦性而非折返性心动过速。: Observe whether the rate varies with respiration, pain, or posture, supporting sinus rather than reentrant tachycardia.
诊断需满足以下 4 项中的 2 项：心包性胸痛、心包摩擦音、新出现弥漫 ST 抬: Diagnosis requires meeting 2 of the following 4 criteria: pericarditic chest pain, pericardial friction rub, new diffuse ST elevation or PR depression, new or worsening pericardial effusion.
起搏器不是“装上就一劳永逸”；晕厥 + 无夺获是急症。: A pacemaker is not "fit once and forget"; syncope + failure to capture is an emergency.
过敏性休克的心电图“缺血”可能是结果，不是原因；先抗过敏复苏。: ECG "ischemia" in anaphylactic shock may be a consequence, not the cause; treat anaphylaxis and resuscitate first.
逐搏测量 PR，确认没有固定关系。: Measure PR beat by beat to confirm there is no fixed relationship.
钾钙心电图速查: Potassium and calcium ECG quick reference
预激+房颤：宽 QRS、不规则、极快。: Pre-excitation + atrial fibrillation: wide QRS, irregular, very fast.
食管导联与动态心电图的选择: Choice between esophageal lead and ambulatory ECG
高钾可致宽 QRS 缓慢节律，但 T 波高尖、P 波低平，血钾可确诊。: Hyperkalemia can cause a slow rhythm with wide QRS, but peaked T waves and flattened P waves, and serum potassium confirms the diagnosis.
78 岁女性，反复晕厥；P 波与 QRS 分离，心室率 28 次\/分，QRS: 78-year-old woman with recurrent syncope; P waves and QRS are dissociated, ventricular rate 28 bpm, wide QRS.
Cornell：R aVL + S V3 >28 mm（男）或 >20 mm（女: Cornell: R aVL + S V3 >28 mm (men) or >20 mm (women).
ICD 的起搏功能类似起搏器；ATP 时可见快速起搏钉；除颤后心电图可短暂平直，: The pacing function of an ICD is similar to a pacemaker; rapid pacing spikes may be seen during ATP; after defibrillation, the ECG may be briefly flat and then recover.
LGL 表现为短 PR、正常 QRS、阵发性室上速；传统认为存在 James 束: LGL presents with short PR, normal QRS, and paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia; traditionally attributed to a James bundle, but its anatomic basis remains controversial.
LVH：侧壁 ST 压低、T 倒置；RVH：右胸 ST 压低、T 倒置；改变通常: LVH: lateral ST depression, T inversion; RVH: right precordial ST depression, T inversion; changes are usually opposite to the main QRS direction.
P′ 可能隐藏在 T 波中，仅凭心室率会漏诊。: P′ may be hidden in the T wave; relying only on ventricular rate will miss it.
P 波振幅反映右房向量，P 波时间与终末负向反映左房向量；V1 是观察左房终末向: P wave amplitude reflects the right atrial vector; P wave duration and terminal negativity reflect the left atrial vector; V1 is the key lead for observing the left atrial terminal vector.
QT 受心率影响，必须用 Bazett\/Fridericia 等公式校正为 Q: QT is affected by heart rate and must be corrected to QTc using formulas such as Bazett/Fridericia; the faster the heart rate, the shorter QT should be.
RVH：V1 R\/S>1、电轴右偏、右胸 ST 压低；后壁 MI：V1–V3: RVH: V1 R/S>1, right axis deviation, right precordial ST depression; posterior MI: V1–V3 ST depression, increased R wave height, upright T wave, V7–V9 ST elevation.
T 波高尖 + P 波变平: Tall peaked T waves + flattened P waves
V1–V3 的 ST 压低也可来自前壁心内膜下缺血、右室肥厚劳损或洋地黄效应，必: ST depression in V1–V3 can also come from anterior subendocardial ischemia, RV hypertrophy with strain, or digitalis effect; it must be interpreted together with inferior leads, R wave height, and T wave direction. Isolated V1–V3 depression without the posterior triad should not lead directly to a diagnosis of posterior infarction.
一个搏动后紧跟回波。: One beat followed immediately by an echo beat.
不稳定：同步电复律，房扑通常 50–100 J 起始，必要时递增；有意识者镇静。: Unstable: synchronized cardioversion; for atrial flutter, usually start at 50–100 J and increase if necessary; sedate if conscious.
交界性逸搏心律是窦房结发放冲动过慢或冲动不能传出时，房室交界区作为后备起搏点被动: Junctional escape rhythm occurs when the sinus node fires too slowly or its impulses cannot be conducted out; the AV junction acts as a backup pacemaker and passively fires impulses, forming a regular rhythm at about 40–60 beats/min. The impulses are conducted downward through the His-Purkinje system, so the QRS is usually narrow; there may be no P waves, or retrograde conduction may produce P waves that are inverted in II, III, and aVF and upright in aVR.
低血压、颈静脉怒张而肺部清晰：右室梗死，硝酸酯与利尿剂禁忌。: Hypotension, jugular venous distension, and clear lungs: right ventricular infarction; nitrates and diuretics are contraindicated.
倾斜试验通过被动\/药物激发直立应激，评估血管迷走性晕厥；阳性表现为症状伴血压\: The tilt-table test assesses vasovagal syncope by passively/drug-induced upright stress; a positive response is symptoms accompanied by a fall in blood pressure/heart rate.
前降支完全闭塞后，前壁与室间隔发生透壁性缺血；心肌细胞膜离子泵失能，损伤电流使: After complete occlusion of the left anterior descending artery, transmural ischemia occurs in the anterior wall and interventricular septum; failure of myocardial cell membrane ion pumps causes injury current that shifts the ST segment toward the ischemic area.
单导联“室颤”先看其他导联与患者；不要立即电击。: For “ventricular fibrillation” in a single lead, first look at the other leads and the patient; do not shock immediately.
只看 ST 压低而忽略 aVR 抬高与广泛分布，低估左主干病变。: Looking only at ST depression while ignoring aVR elevation and widespread distribution underestimates left main disease.
右冠状动脉近端闭塞同时累及右室支与下壁供血，导致右室游离壁缺血、收缩力下降与右心: Proximal right coronary artery occlusion simultaneously involves the right ventricular branch and the blood supply to the inferior wall, causing right ventricular free wall ischemia, decreased contractility, and reduced right cardiac output.
右房除极向量向前下，II\/III\/aVF 面向下壁，因而记录到高尖 P 波；: Right atrial depolarization vector is directed anteriorly and inferiorly; II/III/aVF face the inferior wall, so tall peaked P waves are recorded; upright P waves may be seen in V1.
向量环、电轴与导联投影: Vector loop, axis, and lead projection
女性可无典型胸痛。: Women may have no typical chest pain.
室速有可辨宽 QRS；无脉性 VT 处理与 VF 相同。: VT has a discernible wide QRS; pulseless VT is managed the same as VF.
宽 QRS 心动过速，可见房室分离，按室速处理。: Wide QRS tachycardia with visible AV dissociation; manage as VT.
小儿晕厥多为血管迷走性，但运动中晕厥、无前驱、家族猝死、心电图异常提示心脏性原因: Syncope in children is mostly vasovagal, but syncope during exercise, absence of prodrome, family history of sudden death, and abnormal ECG suggest a cardiac cause.
心内膜下心肌对缺血最敏感，供氧与需氧失衡时首先出现复极异常；损伤电流背离缺血区、: The subendocardial myocardium is most sensitive to ischemia; when oxygen supply and demand are imbalanced, repolarization abnormalities appear first; injury current directed away from the ischemic area and toward the ventricular cavity produces ST-segment depression.
心电图反映电活动，不直接测量心肌厚度；纤维化、传导阻滞和体型都会改变电压。: ECG reflects electrical activity and does not directly measure myocardial thickness; fibrosis, conduction block, and body habitus all alter voltage.
心肌梗死分期与罪犯血管判断: Myocardial infarction staging and culprit vessel determination
急性前壁 ST 段抬高型心肌梗死: Acute anterior ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction
房室结不应期较长，可过滤过快的房性冲动，避免心室率过快；房颤时房室结的过滤作用决: The AV node has a relatively long refractory period and can filter overly rapid atrial impulses to prevent an excessive ventricular rate; in atrial fibrillation, the filtering effect of the AV node determines the ventricular rate.
把 II、III、aVF 的早期复极或正常变异当作下壁 STEMI：需有相邻导联: Mistaking early repolarization or normal variants in II, III, and aVF for inferior STEMI: contiguous leads, reciprocal changes, and dynamic evolution are required.
把高钾\/低钾\/钙通道阻滞与心电图对应: Correlate hyperkalemia/hypokalemia/calcium channel blockade with ECG findings
提前出现的窄 QRS，前面没有窦性 P；逆行 P 可藏在 QRS 中或出现在其后: Premature narrow QRS complex without a preceding sinus P wave; a retrograde P wave may be hidden in the QRS or appear after it.
无提前出现的异位 P 波，无代偿间歇。: No premature ectopic P wave and no compensatory pause.
最具特异性的是“勺状 ST 段压低（scooped ST）+ QT 缩短 + T: The most specific finding is the combination of "scooped ST depression + shortened QT + flat/inverted T waves"; however, this effect cannot distinguish therapeutic levels from toxicity, and toxicity requires correlation with serum drug levels and arrhythmias.
有脉患者使用非同步电击，或未镇静即同步复律。: Using unsynchronized shocks in patients with a pulse, or synchronized cardioversion without sedation.
正常年轻人 V1 高 R 可为变异；没有其他异常时不要过度诊断。: A high R wave in V1 can be a variant in normal young people; do not overdiagnose when there are no other abnormalities.
浦肯野系统病变、束支阻滞或心室肌起源的激动会改变除极顺序，使 QRS 增宽并出现: Disease of the Purkinje system, bundle branch block, or impulses originating from ventricular myocardium alter the depolarization sequence, causing QRS widening and morphologic changes.
电轴与 delta 波方向都可用向量解释。: Both the electrical axis and the direction of the delta wave can be explained by vectors.
症状性三度、二度 II 型\/高度阻滞：评估永久起搏。: Symptomatic third-degree, second-degree type II/high-grade block: evaluate for permanent pacing.
看钉与波形关系、起搏频率、自身搏动是否被感知、是否有噪声\/电磁干扰；结合程控与: Examine the relationship between pacing spikes and waveforms, pacing rate, whether intrinsic beats are sensed, and presence of noise/electromagnetic interference; correlate with programming and impedance.
确认相邻导联、J 点抬高与年龄\/性别阈值。: Confirm adjacent leads, J-point elevation, and age/sex thresholds.
窦性停搏是窦房结暂时不能发出冲动，心电图上出现 P 波消失的长间歇；若为窦房传导: Sinus arrest is the temporary failure of the sinus node to generate impulses, with a long pause and absent P waves on the ECG; if it is sinoatrial exit block, the pause is often an integer multiple of the basic PP interval.
窦速、电轴左偏常见。: Sinus tachycardia and left axis deviation are common.
纠正高钾、药物中毒、缺血等可逆病因；存活者评估永久起搏器。: Correct reversible causes such as hyperkalemia, drug toxicity, and ischemia; evaluate survivors for a permanent pacemaker.
罪犯血管判断必须结合造影、超声与临床，不凭心电图单独决定治疗。: Identification of the culprit vessel must be combined with angiography, ultrasound, and clinical findings; do not decide treatment based on ECG alone.
血压不一定下降。: Blood pressure does not necessarily decrease.
评估房颤负荷、早搏负荷、ST 趋势。: Assess atrial fibrillation burden, premature beat burden, and ST-segment trends.
起搏钉—P 波固定关系；P 波后 QRS 窄且 PR 正常；自身 P 波出现时起: Fixed relationship between pacing spike and P wave; QRS after the P wave is narrow with normal PR; pacing is inhibited when intrinsic P waves occur.
钙延长或缩短动作电位平台期，分别导致 QT 延长或缩短。: Calcium prolongs or shortens the action potential plateau, leading to QT prolongation or shortening, respectively.
阿司匹林负荷、抗凝、他汀；根据血压与症状使用硝酸酯\/β 阻滞剂。: Aspirin loading, anticoagulation, statins; use nitrates/beta-blockers according to blood pressure and symptoms.
需排除左室肥厚劳损、洋地黄效应、低钾血症、预激与心动过速相关改变。: Must exclude left ventricular hypertrophy with strain, digitalis effect, hypokalemia, pre-excitation, and tachycardia-related changes.
静息心率持续 <50 或 >110 次\/分，需寻找原因而非直接归为正常。: Persistent resting heart rate <50 or >110 beats/min requires seeking a cause rather than directly classifying it as normal.
频发或症状明显：查电解质、甲状腺功能、贫血与药物史。: Frequent or markedly symptomatic: check electrolytes, thyroid function, anemia, and medication history.
高尖 T 波、宽 QRS、P 波低平，无 PR 压低与弥漫 ST 抬高。: Tall peaked T waves, wide QRS, flattened P waves, without PR depression or diffuse ST elevation.
鱼钩样 ST 改变不等同中毒；中毒诊断结合血药浓度、症状、肾功能与心律失常。: Fishhook-like ST changes are not equivalent to toxicity; diagnosis of toxicity combines serum drug concentration, symptoms, renal function, and arrhythmias.
ICD 电击不是“治疗结束”，而是“开始评估”：查诱因、查设备、查可逆原因。: An ICD shock is not the "end of treatment" but the "start of evaluation": check triggers, check the device, and check reversible causes.
I 导联 QRS 净正向、aVF 净正向：正常电轴；I 正、aVF 负：可能左偏: Net positive QRS in lead I and net positive in aVF: normal axis; positive I and negative aVF: possible left axis deviation, need to see whether II is negative; negative I and positive aVF: right axis deviation; both negative: extreme right axis deviation.
Mahaim 旁路多位于右房-右束支区域，激动右室较晚，形成 LBBB 形态；与: Mahaim pathways are mostly located in the right atrium–right bundle branch region, activate the right ventricle relatively late, and produce an LBBB morphology; unlike typical WPW.
PR 缩短、delta 波、QRS 增宽；旁路可引发 AVRT，合并房颤时有室颤: Shortened PR, delta wave, widened QRS; accessory pathways can cause AVRT, and with concomitant atrial fibrillation there is a risk of ventricular fibrillation.
QRS 增宽、aVR R 波增高。: Widened QRS, increased R wave in aVR.
QT 延长导致复极不均一，早期后除极（EAD）触发多形性室速；常见诱因包括低钾、: QT prolongation causes repolarization heterogeneity, and early afterdepolarizations (EADs) trigger polymorphic ventricular tachycardia; common triggers include hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia, hypocalcemia, bradycardia, and drugs (amiodarone, quinolones, macrolides, antipsychotics, etc.).
ST 段与 T 波方向通常与 QRS 主波相反（继发性 ST-T 改变）。: The ST segment and T wave direction are usually opposite to the main QRS deflection (secondary ST-T changes).
V1 高 R + 胸痛 + V1–V3 ST 压低，先按后壁 STEMI 处理，: Tall R in V1 + chest pain + ST depression in V1–V3: manage first as posterior STEMI, rather than first diagnosing RVH.
X 轴大致左右，Y 轴上下，Z 轴前后；三个轴互相垂直，便于重建三维向量环。: The X axis is roughly left-right, the Y axis up-down, and the Z axis anterior-posterior; the three axes are mutually perpendicular, facilitating reconstruction of the three-dimensional vector loop.
一度与无症状二度 I 型通常不需要紧急起搏，但不能漏掉进展。: First-degree AV block and asymptomatic type I second-degree AV block usually do not require emergency pacing, but progression must not be missed.
下壁 STEMI 先看血压，再想右室梗死。: In inferior STEMI, check blood pressure first, then consider right ventricular infarction.
不应期随动作电位时程改变，QT 延长增加早期后除极风险。: Refractoriness changes with action potential duration; QT prolongation increases the risk of early afterdepolarizations.
体表心电图是“地图”，心内电图是“街道”；电生理检查把机制从推测变成测量。: Surface ECG is a "map", intracardiac electrograms are "streets"; electrophysiology study turns mechanism from speculation into measurement.
儿童运动晕厥、静息 ECG 正常，别漏 CPVT；运动试验是钥匙。: Exercise-induced syncope in children with normal resting ECG: don't miss CPVT; exercise testing is the key.
前壁 STEMI 有 ST 抬高与动态变化，不是单纯电压增高。: Anterior STEMI has ST elevation and dynamic changes, not merely increased voltage.
危急值电话闭环。: Closed-loop telephone notification of critical values.
发热 + 晕厥 + V1 穹隆型 ST，先按 Brugada 处理并避免诱发药物: Fever + syncope + coved-type ST in V1: manage as Brugada first and avoid trigger drugs.
可穿戴单导联易伪差。: Wearable single-lead ECG is prone to artifact.
右束支细长易阻滞；左束支分前、后分支。: The right bundle branch is long and thin and prone to block; the left bundle branch divides into anterior and posterior fascicles.
呼吸引起的低频漂移通常周期与呼吸一致；电极松动、皮肤准备不足或出汗也会造成漂移。: Low-frequency drift caused by respiration usually has a period consistent with breathing; loose electrodes, inadequate skin preparation, or sweating can also cause drift.
填塞行心包穿刺引流；反复复发者考虑激素、免疫抑制或心包切除。: For tamponade, perform pericardiocentesis and drainage; for recurrent cases, consider corticosteroids, immunosuppression, or pericardiectomy.
大量输血、急性胰腺炎、甲状旁腺术后低钙危象。: Massive transfusion, acute pancreatitis, post-parathyroidectomy hypocalcemic crisis.
宽 QRS、起搏钉规律出现。: Wide QRS with regular pacing spikes.
小儿晕厥\/抽搐需查 ECG；癫痫诊断前应排除长 QT。: Syncope/seizures in children require ECG; long QT should be excluded before diagnosing epilepsy.
左前分支传导阻滞是左束支前分支传导中断，左心室激动先从后下分支区域开始，再向上、: Left anterior fascicular block is interruption of the anterior fascicle of the left bundle branch. Left ventricular activation begins in the posteroinferior fascicular region and then slowly conducts superiorly and leftward anteriorly, causing marked left axis deviation, rS in inferior leads, qR in lateral leads, and usually normal QRS duration. It is one of the most common intraventricular conduction blocks.
幼稚型 T 波指 V1–V3 T 波倒置，在儿童和年轻女性中可见；体位改变可引起: Juvenile T-wave pattern refers to T-wave inversion in V1–V3, seen in children and young women; changes in position can cause mild ST-T changes.
心室扑动呈规则正弦波、频率约 200–300 次\/分，处理与 VF 相同。: Ventricular flutter shows a regular sine wave at about 200–300 beats/min; management is the same as VF.
心房率高于心室率，常见 3:2、4:3 或 2:1 传导。: Atrial rate is higher than ventricular rate; common conduction ratios are 3:2, 4:3, or 2:1.
忽略发热、药物等诱因与家族史。: Ignoring triggers such as fever and drugs and family history.
急性透壁缺血使损伤区静息膜电位降低，收缩期损伤电流导致 ST 段抬高；心内膜下缺: Acute transmural ischemia lowers the resting membrane potential in the injured area, and systolic injury current causes ST-segment elevation; subendocardial ischemia manifests as ST-segment depression.
所有下壁 STEMI 常规加做 V4R，不要等低血压出现才加做。: Add V4R routinely in all inferior STEMIs; do not wait for hypotension to appear before adding it.
Mistaking junctional escape rhythm for sinus bradycardia: in the latter, P waves are upright in lead II and PR ≥0.12 s.
持续 SVT 可心衰\/休克。: Sustained SVT can cause heart failure/shock.
数天-数周恢复。: Recovery occurs over days to weeks.
新生儿标本溶血可造成假性高钾；需复查并同时看心电图。: Hemolysis in neonatal specimens can cause pseudohyperkalemia; repeat testing and review the ECG at the same time.
早搏\/非特异 ST-T 可见。: Premature beats/nonspecific ST-T changes may be seen.
有脉\/无脉决定同步或非同步。: Presence/absence of a pulse determines synchronized versus unsynchronized.
标准定标为 10 mm\/mV、纸速 25 mm\/s；改变增益或纸速会改变波形: Standard calibration is 10 mm/mV and paper speed 25 mm/s; changing gain or paper speed alters waveform height/width but should not change the true time of intervals.
正常 ECG 需动态监测。: A normal ECG requires dynamic monitoring.
洋地黄效应 = 勺状 ST + 短 QT + T 低平；中毒 = 心律失常。: Digitalis effect = scooped ST + short QT + flattened T; toxicity = arrhythmias.

The posterior injury vector is directed away from V1–V3, so on the standard 12-lead ECG it manifests as ST depression in V1–V3, tall R waves, and upright T waves rather than direct ST elevation. After adding V7–V9, ST elevation can be seen in the posterior leads. Posterior infarction rarely occurs in isolation and often coexists with inferior or lateral infarction, and is easily misjudged as anterior ischemia.
